func _draw() -> void:
	var size := _size_px()
	var scale: float = data["scale"]
	var cell := Vector2i(int(data["cell"]), int(data["cell"]))
	var tint := Color(3, 3, 3) if flash > 0.0 else Color.WHITE
	var sheet := Art.tex(data["sheet"])
	var shadow: float = data["shadow"]
	var chasing: bool = player != null and active and _to_player().length() < float(data["sight"])

	match data["behavior"]:
		"ad_crab", "ad_wisp", "ad_keeper":
			CoastalAI.draw(self,sheet,tint)
		"hb_root", "hb_moth":
			HabitatAI.draw(self,sheet,tint)
		"cv_ram", "cv_slinger":
			CombatAI.draw(self,sheet,tint)
		"rf_ambush", "rf_listen":
			preload("res://scripts/entities/route_enemy.gd").draw(self,sheet,tint)
		"lw_guard", "lw_flank", "lw_support":
			LivingAI.draw(self, sheet, tint)
		"echo_charge", "echo_volley":
			EchoAI.draw(self, sheet, tint)
		"animal":
			# Wild dier: twee stapplaatjes, twee vluchtplaatjes (het kijkt naar rechts, net als de slijmen)
			DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, size * 0.44), Vector2(shadow, shadow * 0.35), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
			var column := int(anim * 0.9) % 2 + (2 if fleeing else 0)
			DrawUtil.sprite(self, sheet, column, 0, Vector2.ZERO, cell, scale, tint)
		"chase":
			DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, size * 0.44), Vector2(shadow, shadow * 0.35), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
			var column := int(anim * 0.6) % 2 + (2 if chasing else 0)
			DrawUtil.sprite(self, sheet, column, 0, Vector2.ZERO, cell, scale, tint)
		"bat":
			var hover := -6.0 + sin(t * 6.0) * 3.0
			DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, size * 0.44), Vector2(shadow, shadow * 0.35), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.25))
			var column := 2 if state == "dash" else int(t * 12.0) % 2
			if state == "telegraph" and int(t * 20.0) % 2 == 0:
				tint = Color(2.5, 1.2, 1.2)
			DrawUtil.sprite(self, sheet, column, 0, Vector2(0, hover), cell, scale, tint)
		"archer":
			DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, size * 0.44), Vector2(shadow, shadow * 0.35), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
			var face := _to_player() if player else Vector2.DOWN
			var row := 0
			if absf(face.y) > absf(face.x):
				row = 0 if face.y > 0.0 else 1
			else:
				row = 2 if face.x > 0.0 else 3
			var column := 3 if state == "aim" else (1 + int(anim * 0.8) % 2 if desired != Vector2.ZERO else 0)
			DrawUtil.sprite(self, sheet, column, row, Vector2.ZERO, cell, scale, tint)
			if state == "aim":
				DrawUtil.prompt(self, Vector2(0, -size * 0.55), t, "!")
		"mage":
			var hover := -5.0 + sin(t * 3.0) * 2.0
			var puffing := state == "vanish" or state == "appear"
			DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, size * 0.44), Vector2(shadow * (0.6 if puffing else 1.0), shadow * 0.3), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.2))
			var column := int(t * 2.2) % 2
			var sprite_scale := scale
			if puffing:
				# Het wolkje zwelt aan en vervaagt bij het verdwijnen en krimpt weer bij het verschijnen.
				var p := clampf(state_time / float(data["vanish_time" if state == "vanish" else "appear_time"]), 0.0, 1.0)
				column = 3
				hover = -2.0
				sprite_scale = scale * ((1.0 + 0.4 * p) if state == "vanish" else (1.4 - 0.4 * p))
				tint.a = (1.0 - 0.5 * p) if state == "vanish" else (0.5 + 0.5 * p)
			elif state == "cast" or action_flash > 0.0:
				column = 2 # handen omhoog, ook nog heel even na het schot
			DrawUtil.sprite(self, sheet, column, 0, Vector2(0, hover), cell, sprite_scale, tint)
			if state == "cast":
				_draw_mage_charge(hover)
		"spitter":
			DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, size * 0.44), Vector2(shadow * (1.0 - air_height / 40.0), shadow * 0.35), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
			var column := int(anim * 0.6) % 2
			var offset := Vector2(0, -air_height)
			var sprite_scale := scale
			if state == "windup":
				# Hij blaast zich op en trilt: nu komt er een waaier aan.
				var p := clampf(state_time / float(data["windup"]), 0.0, 1.0)
				column = 2
				offset.x = randf_range(-1.0, 1.0) * p * 1.5
				sprite_scale = scale * (1.0 + 0.12 * p)
				_draw_fan_hint(p)
			elif state == "hop":
				column = 4
			elif action_flash > 0.0:
				column = 3
			DrawUtil.sprite(self, sheet, column, 0, offset, cell, sprite_scale, tint)
		"golem":
			DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, size * 0.44), Vector2(shadow, shadow * 0.35), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
			var column := int(anim * 0.4) % 2
			if state == "windup":
				column = 2
			elif state == "recover" and state_time < 0.4:
				column = 3
			var offset := Vector2.ZERO
			if state == "windup":
				offset = Vector2(randf_range(-1.0, 1.0), 0.0) * 1.5
				draw_arc(Vector2(0, size * 0.3), 56.0 * clampf(state_time / 0.9, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0, TAU, 32, Color(1, 0.3, 0.3, 0.6), 3.0)
			DrawUtil.sprite(self, sheet, column, 0, offset, cell, scale, tint)
		"king":
			var lift := air_height
			DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, size * 0.44), Vector2(shadow * (1.0 - lift / 160.0), shadow * 0.35), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
			var column := int(anim * 0.5) % 2
			if state == "crouch" or state == "land":
				column = 2
			elif state == "hop":
				column = 3
			if _king_phase() == 3 and active and int(t * 6.0) % 2 == 0 and flash <= 0.0:
				tint = Color(1.5, 0.8, 0.8)
			DrawUtil.sprite(self, sheet, column, 0, Vector2(0, -lift), cell, scale, tint)


## De aanloop van de Magiër: zijn handen gloeien en boven zijn hoofd groeit een bol.

_draw_fan_hint

proceduralSources.source:
extends CharacterBody2D
## Een vijand. Het soort (kind) bepaalt de eigenschappen (scripts/data/enemies.gd) en het gedrag:
## chase (slijm), bat (vleermuis), archer (skelet), mage (Magiër), spitter (Slijmspuwer),
## golem (minibaas) en king (eindbaas).

signal died

const DrawUtil := preload("res://scripts/core/draw_util.gd")
const Art := preload("res://scripts/core/art.gd")
const Util := preload("res://scripts/core/util.gd")
const Enemies := preload("res://scripts/data/enemies.gd")
const HabitatAI := preload("res://scripts/entities/habitat_enemy.gd")
var habitat_origin := Vector2.ZERO
var habitat_length := 0.0
var habitat_traveled := 0.0
var habitat_hit := false
var habitat_distracted := false

const CoastalAI := preload("res://scripts/entities/coastal_enemy.gd")
var ad_origin:=Vector2.ZERO
var ad_radius:=0.0
var ad_hit:=false
var ad_combo:=0

const CombatAI := preload("res://scripts/entities/combat_enemy.gd")
const LivingAI := preload("res://scripts/entities/living_enemy.gd")
var guard_broken := 0.0
var defend_target: Node2D

const EchoAI := preload("res://scripts/entities/echo_enemy.gd")

const FIRST_DELAY := 1.2 # seconden tussen "hij ziet je" en de eerste teleport of spuugbeurt
const SPITTER_AFTER_HOP := 0.7 # na een hupje spuugt hij pas even later
const STUCK_WINDOW := 0.5 # elke zoveel seconden kijkt de Magiër of hij van zijn plek is gekomen...
const STUCK_DISTANCE := 10.0 # ...en anders zit hij vast (muur, hoek) en teleporteert hij weg
const LOOKAHEAD := 22.0 # zo ver vooruit kijken ze of er een muur aankomt
const SPOT_TRIES := 24 # pogingen om een vrije plek te vinden voor een teleport
const HOP_TURNS: Array[float] = [0.0, 0.5, -0.5, 1.0, -1.0, 1.5, -1.5] # hoeken (radialen) waarin de Slijmspuwer wegspringt
const MAGE_ORB_HEIGHT := -14.0 # de bol ontstaat boven de handen van de Magiër
const MAGE_AIM := Vector2(0, 4) # de bol mikt op het midden van de speler
const HINT_DELAY := 3.5 # na de tip bij de eerste ontmoeting wacht hij even met aanvallen (de tip staat 3,2 s in beeld)
const SPITTER_CREEP := 0.8 # staat de speler verder dan 80% van zijn bereik, dan schuifelt de Slijmspuwer naar hem toe
const SOLID_LAYER := 1 # botsingslaag van muren en van vaste dingen zoals kisten, borden, poortjes en personages
const MAGE_COLOR := Color(0.85, 0.6, 1.0)
const SPIT_COLOR := Color(0.65, 0.95, 0.35)

var kind := "slime"
var data: Dictionary = {}
var world: Node
var unique_flag := "" # deze vlag wordt gezet als de vijand verslagen is (voor bazen)
var hp := 1
var max_hp := 1
var radius := 7.0
var active := true # bazen wachten tot ze geactiveerd worden
var player: Node2D
var knockback := Vector2.ZERO
var desired := Vector2.ZERO
var flash := 0.0
var touch_cooldown := 0.0
var anim := randf() * TAU
var t := 0.0
var state := "idle"
var state_time := randf_range(0.0, 1.0)
var aim_dir := Vector2.DOWN
var wander_dir := Vector2.ZERO
var wander_timer := 0.0
var home_position := Vector2.ZERO
var patrol_radius := 0.0 # opt-in for ordinary outdoor spawns; bosses/trials stay unrestricted
var strafe := 1.0
var air_height := 0.0
var hop_from := Vector2.ZERO
var hop_to := Vector2.ZERO
var hop_count := 0
var slam_ring := 0.0
var dead := false
var hop_phase := 1
# Wilde dieren (gedrag "animal"): vreedzaam wild dat wegrent als je te dichtbij komt of het raakt
var panic := 0.0 # hoe lang het dier nog vlucht na een klap
var fleeing := false # rent het dier nu weg (voor het plaatje)
# Magiër en Slijmspuwer
var special_timer := FIRST_DELAY # tijd tot de volgende teleport (Magiër) of spuugbeurt (Slijmspuwer)
var hop_cooldown := 0.0 # de Slijmspuwer hupt niet meteen weer
var action_flash := 0.0 # korte tijd na een schot of spuugbeurt: toont het "actie"-plaatje
var stuck_time := 0.0 # hoe lang de Magiër al probeert te verplaatsen zonder ver te komen
var stuck_anchor := Vector2.ZERO # waar hij stond toen dat begon
var glow: PointLight2D # de Magiër geeft zelf licht in donkere gebieden


func setup(enemy_kind: String, flag := "") -> void:
	kind = enemy_kind
	data = Enemies.info(kind)
	unique_flag = flag
	max_hp = GameState.ng_hp(int(data["hp"])) # sterkere vijanden bij Nieuw spel+
	hp = max_hp
	radius = data["radius"]
	active = not data.get("start_inactive", false)


func _ready() -> void:
	if data.is_empty():
		setup(kind)
	add_to_group("enemies")
	home_position=global_position
	if data.get("boss", false):
		add_to_group("boss")
	collision_layer = 4
	collision_mask = 1
	motion_mode = MOTION_MODE_FLOATING

	var shape := CollisionShape2D.new()
	var circle := CircleShape2D.new()
	circle.radius = radius
	shape.shape = circle
	shape.position = Vector2(0, _size_px() * 0.28)
	add_child(shape)
	if data.behavior in ["hb_root","hb_moth"]:
		var warning:=preload("res://scripts/entities/habitat_warning.gd").new()
		warning.enemy=weakref(self)
		world.ground.add_child(warning)
	if data.behavior in ["ad_crab","ad_wisp","ad_keeper"]:
		ad_origin=position
		var mark:=preload("res://scripts/entities/coastal_warning.gd").new()
		mark.enemy=weakref(self);world.ground.add_child(mark)
	if kind=="king":
		var warning:=preload("res://scripts/entities/king_warning.gd").new()
		warning.king=weakref(self)
		world.ground.add_child(warning)

	if data["behavior"] == "mage" and world != null and world.darkness > 0.0:
		# In donkere gebieden is de Magiër zelf een lichtje (en zie je de aanloop goed).
		glow = PointLight2D.new()
		glow.texture = Art.light_texture()
		glow.texture_scale = 0.9
		glow.color = MAGE_COLOR
		glow.energy = 0.6
		add_child(glow)


func _size_px() -> float:
	return float(data["cell"]) * float(data["scale"])


func activate() -> void:
	active = true


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	t += delta
	guard_broken = maxf(guard_broken - delta, 0.0)
	anim += delta * 5.0
	flash = maxf(flash - delta, 0.0)
	touch_cooldown = maxf(touch_cooldown - delta, 0.0)
	slam_ring = maxf(slam_ring - delta, 0.0)
	action_flash = maxf(action_flash - delta, 0.0)
	if player == null:
		player = Util.player(self)
	if dead or player == null or GameState.ended or not active:
		velocity = Vector2.ZERO
		queue_redraw()
		return

	state_time += delta
	desired = Vector2.ZERO
	match data["behavior"]:
		"ad_crab", "ad_wisp", "ad_keeper":
			CoastalAI.update(self,delta)
		"hb_root", "hb_moth":
			HabitatAI.update(self,delta)
		"cv_ram", "cv_slinger":
			CombatAI.update(self, delta)
		"rf_ambush", "rf_listen":
			preload("res://scripts/entities/route_enemy.gd").update(self,delta)
		"lw_guard", "lw_flank", "lw_support":
			LivingAI.update(self, delta)
		"echo_charge", "echo_volley":
			EchoAI.update(self, delta)
		"chase":
			_ai_chase(delta)
		"bat":
			_ai_bat(delta)
		"archer":
			_ai_archer(delta)
		"mage":
			_ai_mage(delta)
		"spitter":
			_ai_spitter(delta)
		"golem":
			_ai_golem(delta)
		"king":
			_ai_king(delta)
		"animal":
			_ai_animal(delta)

	velocity = desired + knockback
	knockback = knockback.move_toward(Vector2.ZERO, 700.0 * delta)
	var before:=global_position
	move_and_slide()
	if data.behavior in ["hb_root","hb_moth"]:HabitatAI.after_move(self,before)
	if data.behavior in ["ad_crab","ad_wisp","ad_keeper"]:CoastalAI.after_move(self,before)

	var touch_range: float = radius + 9.0
	if data["behavior"] in ["cv_ram","cv_slinger"] and state != "cv_charge": touch_range = 0.0
	if data.behavior in ["hb_root","hb_moth","ad_crab","ad_wisp","ad_keeper"]:touch_range=0.0
	if state in ["hop", "vanish", "appear"] or data["behavior"] == "animal":
		touch_range = 0.0 # in de lucht, als rookwolkje of als vreedzaam dier kan hij niemand raken
	if global_position.distance_to(player.global_position) < touch_range and touch_cooldown <= 0.0:
		touch_cooldown = 0.8
		player.hurt(global_position, data["damage"], data["name"])
	queue_redraw()


func _to_player() -> Vector2:
	return player.global_position - global_position


func _wander(delta: float) -> void:
	if patrol_radius>0 and global_position.distance_to(home_position)>patrol_radius*0.45:
		desired=_free_direction((home_position-global_position).normalized())*data["speed"]
		return
	wander_timer -= delta
	if wander_timer <= 0.0:
		wander_timer = randf_range(0.8, 2.0)
		wander_dir = Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) if randf() < 0.7 else Vector2.ZERO
	desired = wander_dir * data["speed"]


# --- Gedrag ---------------------------------------------------------------------

func _ai_chase(delta: float) -> void:
	var to_player := _to_player()
	if to_player.length() < data["sight"] and (patrol_radius<=0 or home_position.distance_to(player.global_position)<patrol_radius):
		desired = to_player.normalized() * data["chase_speed"]
	else:
		_wander(delta)


## Vreedzaam wild: het draalt wat rond, maar schrikt en rent weg als je te dichtbij komt of het raakt.
## Een klap (ook een pijl uit de verte) zet `panic`: dan vlucht het nog even nadat je stopt met achtervolgen.
func _ai_animal(delta: float) -> void:
	preload("res://scripts/core/homestead.gd").animal_drop(self)
	panic = maxf(panic - delta, 0.0)
	var to_player := _to_player()
	fleeing = panic > 0.0 or to_player.length() < float(data.get("panic_range", 90.0))
	if fleeing:
		var away: Vector2=-to_player.normalized()
		if kind.begins_with("trail_") and position.distance_to(home_position)>patrol_radius:
			away=(home_position-position).normalized()
		desired = away * float(data["chase_speed"])
	else:
		_wander(delta)


func _ai_bat(delta: float) -> void:
	var to_player := _to_player()
	match state:
		"idle":
			if to_player.length() > data["sight"]:
				_wander(delta)
			else:
				# Eromheen cirkelen tot de bat besluit aan te vallen.
				var around := to_player.orthogonal().normalized() * strafe
				desired = (around * 0.8 + to_player.normalized() * (0.3 if to_player.length() > 90.0 else -0.4)).normalized() * data["speed"]
				if state_time > randf_range(1.2, 2.2):
					state = "telegraph"
					state_time = 0.0
					aim_dir = to_player.normalized()
		"telegraph":
			aim_dir = to_player.normalized()
			if state_time > 0.35:
				state = "dash"
				state_time = 0.0
		"dash":
			desired = aim_dir * 210.0
			if state_time > 0.45:
				state = "retreat"
				state_time = 0.0
				strafe = -strafe
		"retreat":
			desired = -to_player.normalized() * data["speed"]
			if state_time > 0.7:
				state = "idle"
				state_time = 0.0


func _ai_archer(delta: float) -> void:
	var to_player := _to_player()
	var dist := to_player.length()
	match state:
		"idle":
			if dist > data["sight"]:
				_wander(delta)
				return
			if dist < 75.0:
				desired = -to_player.normalized() * data["speed"] * 1.4
			elif dist > 150.0:
				desired = to_player.normalized() * data["chase_speed"]
			else:
				desired = to_player.orthogonal().normalized() * strafe * data["speed"] * 0.8
				if randf() < 0.01:
					strafe = -strafe
			if state_time > 2.2:
				state = "aim"
				state_time = 0.0
		"aim":
			aim_dir = to_player.normalized()
			if state_time > 0.55:
				Sound.play("arrow", -4.0)
				world.spawn_projectile("arrow", global_position, aim_dir, 150.0, data["damage"], data["name"] + " (pijl)")
				state = "idle"
				state_time = 0.0


# --- Magiër ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Houdt afstand, teleporteert elke paar seconden naar een plek vlak bij je en schiet na een duidelijke aanloop
# een trage arcane bol af. Toestanden: idle -> vanish (rookwolkje) -> appear -> cast (aanloop) -> idle.

func _ai_mage(delta: float) -> void:
	var to_player := _to_player()
	var dist := to_player.length()
	special_timer -= delta
	match state:
		"idle":
			if dist > data["sight"]:
				# Hij ziet je niet: rondzweven, maar wel klaar om meteen te beginnen zodra je in zicht komt.
				_wander(delta)
				special_timer = FIRST_DELAY
				return
			_show_hint()
			var stuck := _mage_kite(to_player, dist, delta)
			if special_timer <= 0.0 or stuck:
				_mage_vanish()
		"vanish":
			if state_time >= data["vanish_time"]:
				_mage_appear()
		"appear":
			aim_dir = to_player.normalized()
			if state_time >= data["appear_time"]:
				state = "cast"
				state_time = 0.0
				Sound.play("mage_charge", -5.0)
		"cast":
			aim_dir = to_player.normalized()
			if state_time >= data["cast_time"]:
				_mage_shoot()
				state = "idle"
				state_time = 0.0
	_update_glow()


## Kiten: te dichtbij is wegzweven, te ver weg is naderen, daartussen rustig heen en weer.
## Geeft true als hij vastzit (hij wil weg of dichterbij, maar komt niet van zijn plek).
func _mage_kite(to_player: Vector2, dist: float, delta: float) -> bool:
	var keep: Array = data["keep_distance"]
	if dist < keep[0]:
		desired = _free_direction(-to_player.normalized()) * float(data["speed"]) * 1.3
	elif dist > keep[1]:
		desired = _free_direction(to_player.normalized()) * float(data["chase_speed"])
	else:
		desired = _free_direction(to_player.orthogonal().normalized() * strafe) * float(data["speed"]) * 0.5
		if randf() < 0.01:
			strafe = -strafe
	# Zit hij vast tegen een muur of in een hoek? Dan is wegteleporteren het enige wat helpt.
	if dist >= keep[0] and dist <= keep[1]:
		stuck_time = 0.0
		stuck_anchor = global_position
		return false
	stuck_time += delta
	if stuck_time < STUCK_WINDOW:
		return false
	var stuck := global_position.distance_to(stuck_anchor) < STUCK_DISTANCE
	stuck_time = 0.0
	stuck_anchor = global_position
	return stuck


func _mage_vanish() -> void:
	state = "vanish"
	state_time = 0.0
	special_timer = data["teleport_every"]
	stuck_time = 0.0
	stuck_anchor = global_position
	Sound.play("mage_teleport", -3.0)
	_smoke_puff()


func _mage_appear() -> void:
	var spot := _mage_pick_spot()
	if spot != Vector2.INF:
		global_position = spot
		knockback = Vector2.ZERO
	stuck_anchor = global_position
	_smoke_puff()
	state = "appear"
	state_time = 0.0


## Een plek 100-140 px van de speler waar de Magiër past (niet in of tegen een muur, niet op een kist of poortje) en
## waar zijn bol vrij zicht op de speler heeft: de bol ontstaat niet in een muur en vliegt nergens tegenaan.
## Geeft Vector2.INF als er geen plek is (bijvoorbeeld in een heel smalle gang): dan blijft hij staan.
func _mage_pick_spot() -> Vector2:
	var span: Array = data["teleport_range"]
	var target := player.global_position + MAGE_AIM
	var without_view := Vector2.INF
	for i in SPOT_TRIES:
		var spot: Vector2 = player.global_position + Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * randf_range(span[0], span[1])
		if not _fits_at(spot):
			continue
		var orb_start := spot + Vector2(0, MAGE_ORB_HEIGHT)
		if not world.is_solid(orb_start) and _clear_line(orb_start, target):
			return spot
		if without_view == Vector2.INF:
			without_view = spot
	return without_view


func _mage_shoot() -> void:
	var origin := global_position + Vector2(0, MAGE_ORB_HEIGHT)
	var direction := (player.global_position + MAGE_AIM - origin).normalized()
	Sound.play("mage_orb", -3.0)
	world.spawn_projectile("arcane_orb", origin, direction, data["orb_speed"], data["damage"], data["name"] + " (tovervonk)")
	world.burst(origin, MAGE_COLOR, 6)
	action_flash = 0.15


## Raak je hem tijdens de aanloop, dan mislukt de toverspreuk.
func _mage_interrupt() -> void:
	state = "idle"
	state_time = 0.0
	world.burst(global_position, MAGE_COLOR, 8)
	world.damage_number(global_position + Vector2(0, -_size_px() * 0.9), tr("Mislukt!"), MAGE_COLOR)


## Eenmalig een tip als je deze soort vijand voor het eerst tegenkomt (de vlag wordt mee opgeslagen).
## Zijn eerste aanval komt pas als de tip weer weg is: de tip staat onderin beeld en mag de aanloop niet verbergen.
func _show_hint() -> void:
	var hint: String = data.get("hint", "")
	var seen_flag := "vijanden_hint_" + kind
	if hint != "" and not GameState.flag(seen_flag):
		GameState.set_flag(seen_flag)
		GameState.toast.emit(tr(hint))
		special_timer = maxf(special_timer, HINT_DELAY)


func _smoke_puff() -> void:
	world.burst(global_position, Color(0.8, 0.72, 1.0), 12)
	world.ring(global_position, 28.0, MAGE_COLOR)


func _update_glow() -> void:
	if glow == null:
		return
	var charge := clampf(state_time / float(data["cast_time"]), 0.0, 1.0) if state == "cast" else 0.0
	glow.energy = 0.6 + charge * 0.7


# --- Slijmspuwer ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Staat bijna stil en spuugt een waaier van slijmballen zodra je dichtbij komt. Wordt het hem te gezellig
# (dichterbij dan flee_range), dan hupt hij weg. Toestanden: idle -> windup -> idle, of idle -> hop -> idle.

func _ai_spitter(delta: float) -> void:
	var to_player := _to_player()
	var dist := to_player.length()
	special_timer -= delta
	hop_cooldown = maxf(hop_cooldown - delta, 0.0)
	match state:
		"idle":
			if dist > data["spit_range"]:
				_wander(delta)
				special_timer = FIRST_DELAY # pas als je dichtbij komt begint hij te spuwen
				return
			_show_hint()
			if dist > float(data["spit_range"]) * SPITTER_CREEP:
				# Aan de rand van zijn bereik schuifelt hij naar je toe, anders duwt het spugen hem langzaam weg.
				desired = _free_direction(to_player.normalized()) * float(data["speed"])
			else:
				_wander(delta)
			if dist < data["flee_range"] and hop_cooldown <= 0.0:
				_spitter_hop(to_player, dist)
			elif special_timer <= 0.0:
				state = "windup"
				state_time = 0.0
				special_timer = data["spit_every"]
				aim_dir = to_player.normalized()
		"windup":
			# Richten tot vlak voor het spuwen, zodat je nog kunt uitwijken.
			if state_time < data["windup"] - 0.15:
				aim_dir = to_player.normalized()
			if state_time >= data["windup"]:
				_spitter_spit()
				state = "idle"
				state_time = 0.0
		"hop":
			var p := clampf(state_time / float(data["hop_time"]), 0.0, 1.0)
			air_height = sin(p * PI) * 14.0
			global_position = hop_from.lerp(hop_to, p)
			if p >= 1.0:
				air_height = 0.0
				world.burst(global_position + Vector2(0, 10), SPIT_COLOR, 6)
				hop_cooldown = data["hop_cooldown"]
				special_timer = maxf(special_timer, SPITTER_AFTER_HOP)
				state = "idle"
				state_time = 0.0


func _spitter_spit() -> void:
	var mouth := global_position + Vector2(0, 6)
	Sound.play("spitter_spit", 0.0, randf_range(0.95, 1.05))
	var fan: int = data["fan"]
	for i in fan:
		var spread := (float(i) - float(fan - 1) / 2.0) * float(data["fan_spread"])
		world.spawn_projectile("slimeball", mouth, aim_dir.rotated(spread), data["ball_speed"], data["damage"], data["name"] + " (slijmbal)")
	world.burst(mouth, SPIT_COLOR, 8)
	knockback = -aim_dir * 90.0 # een beetje terugslag
	action_flash = 0.2


## Hupt van de speler weg naar een vrije plek (nooit door of in een muur). Lukt dat niet, dan blijft hij staan.
func _spitter_hop(to_player: Vector2, dist: float) -> void:
	var away := -to_player.normalized()
	# Eerst recht weg en ver, daarna steeds schuiner en korter.
	for shrink: float in [1.0, 0.8, 0.6, 0.45]:
		for turn: float in HOP_TURNS:
			var spot: Vector2 = global_position + away.rotated(turn) * float(data["hop_distance"]) * shrink
			if spot.distance_to(player.global_position) > dist + 15.0 and _fits_at(spot) and _body_clear(global_position, spot):
				hop_from = global_position
				hop_to = spot
				hop_count += 1
				state = "hop"
				state_time = 0.0
				Sound.play("spitter_hop", -3.0, randf_range(0.95, 1.1))
				return
	hop_cooldown = 0.5 # geen plek: even niet opnieuw proberen


# --- Hulpjes voor kiten en hupjes ---------------------------------------------------------

## De plek van het botsingsrondje (de voeten) voor een vijand die op `pos` staat.
func _feet(pos: Vector2) -> Vector2:
	return pos + Vector2(0, _size_px() * 0.28)


## Past een vijand op `pos` zonder een muur of iets anders vasts (kist, bord, poortje, personage) te raken?
## `margin` is de ruimte die hij minstens rondom wil hebben.
func _fits_at(pos: Vector2, margin := 2.0) -> bool:
	if world.is_solid(pos):
		return false
	var reach := radius + margin
	var feet := _feet(pos)
	for offset: Vector2 in [Vector2.ZERO, Vector2(reach, 0), Vector2(-reach, 0), Vector2(0, reach), Vector2(0, -reach),
			Vector2(reach, reach) * 0.7, Vector2(-reach, reach) * 0.7, Vector2(reach, -reach) * 0.7, Vector2(-reach, -reach) * 0.7]:
		if world.is_solid(feet + offset):
			return false
	var circle := CircleShape2D.new()
	circle.radius = reach
	var query := PhysicsShapeQueryParameters2D.new()
	query.shape = circle
	query.transform = Transform2D(0.0, feet)
	query.collision_mask = SOLID_LAYER
	return get_world_2d().direct_space_state.intersect_shape(query, 1).is_empty()


## Ligt er niets vasts tussen `from` en `to`: geen muur, maar ook geen kist, poortje of personage?
func _clear_line(from: Vector2, to: Vector2) -> bool:
	var steps := int(from.distance_to(to) / 8.0)
	for i in range(1, steps + 1):
		if world.is_solid(from.lerp(to, float(i) / float(steps))):
			return false
	var query := PhysicsRayQueryParameters2D.create(from, to, SOLID_LAYER)
	return get_world_2d().direct_space_state.intersect_ray(query).is_empty()


## Past een vijand overal langs de rechte lijn van `from` naar `to` (hij schuurt niet langs een hoek en springt niet
## over een kist of poortje)?
func _body_clear(from: Vector2, to: Vector2) -> bool:
	var steps := maxi(int(from.distance_to(to) / 8.0), 1)
	for i in range(1, steps + 1):
		if not _fits_at(from.lerp(to, float(i) / float(steps)), 0.0):
			return false
	return true


## De richting die het dichtst bij `dir` ligt en niet tegen een muur aan loopt (zo glijdt hij langs muren).
func _free_direction(dir: Vector2) -> Vector2:
	for turn: float in [0.0, 0.6, -0.6, 1.2, -1.2, 1.8, -1.8]:
		var candidate := dir.rotated(turn)
		if not world.is_solid(_feet(global_position) + candidate * LOOKAHEAD):
			return candidate
	return Vector2.ZERO


func _ai_golem(delta: float) -> void:
	var to_player := _to_player()
	var enraged := hp * 2 < max_hp
	match state:
		"idle":
			if to_player.length() < data["sight"]:
				desired = to_player.normalized() * data["chase_speed"] * (1.4 if enraged else 1.0)
			else:
				_wander(delta)
			if to_player.length() < 66.0 and state_time > 1.2:
				state = "windup"
				state_time = 0.0
		"windup":
			if state_time > (0.65 if enraged else 0.9):
				_golem_slam(enraged)
				state = "recover"
				state_time = 0.0
		"recover":
			if state_time > 0.9:
				state = "idle"
				state_time = 0.0


func _golem_slam(enraged: bool) -> void:
	Sound.play("slam")
	world.shake(6.0)
	world.burst(global_position + Vector2(0, 14), Color(0.8, 0.85, 1.0), 14)
	world.ring(global_position + Vector2(0, 14), 56.0, Color(0.7, 0.85, 1.0))
	slam_ring = 0.3
	if global_position.distance_to(player.global_position) < 56.0:
		player.hurt(global_position, int(data.get("slam_damage", data["damage"])), data["name"] + " (klap)")
	if enraged:
		for i in 6:
			world.spawn_projectile("rock", global_position, Vector2.from_angle(TAU * float(i) / 6.0 + 0.3), 95.0, 1, data["name"] + " (steen)")


# --- De Slijmkoning ---------------------------------------------------------------

func _king_phase() -> int:
	var ratio := float(hp) / float(max_hp)
	if ratio > 0.65:
		return 1
	if ratio > 0.3:
		return 2
	return 3


func _ai_king(_delta: float) -> void:
	var phase := _king_phase()
	match state:
		"idle":
			if state_time > (0.9 if phase == 1 else 0.6 if phase == 2 else 0.4):
				hop_phase=phase
				hop_to=_king_destination(player.global_position+player.velocity*0.2)
				state = "crouch"
				state_time = 0.0
		"crouch":
			if state_time > king_charge_time():
				state = "hop"
				state_time = 0.0
				hop_from = global_position
		"hop":
			var duration := king_hop_time()
			var p := clampf(state_time / duration, 0.0, 1.0)
			air_height = sin(p * PI) * 52.0
			global_position = hop_from.lerp(hop_to, p)
			if p >= 1.0:
				air_height = 0.0
				_king_land(hop_phase)
				state = "land"
				state_time = 0.0
		"land":
			if state_time > 0.65:
				state = "idle"
				state_time = 0.0

func king_charge_time() -> float:
	return 0.65 if hop_phase==1 else 0.6 if hop_phase==2 else 0.5

func king_hop_time() -> float:
	return 0.8 if hop_phase<3 else 0.6

func king_shock() -> float:
	return 64.0 if hop_phase==1 else 74.0 if hop_phase==2 else 86.0

func _king_destination(proposed: Vector2) -> Vector2:
	var goal: Vector2=world.clamp_to_map(proposed)
	if _fits_at(goal):return goal
	for radius in range(1,5):
		for i in 8:
			var candidate:=goal+Vector2.from_angle(i*TAU/8)*radius*24
			if _fits_at(candidate):return candidate
	return global_position


func _king_land(phase: int) -> void:
	hop_count += 1
	var shock := 64.0 if phase == 1 else 74.0 if phase == 2 else 86.0
	Sound.play("slam")
	world.shake(7.0)
	world.burst(global_position + Vector2(0, 30), Color(0.5, 0.95, 0.55), 16)
	world.ring(global_position, shock, Color(0.5, 0.95, 0.55))
	slam_ring = 0.35
	if global_position.distance_to(player.global_position) < shock:
		player.hurt(global_position, 1 if phase == 1 else int(data.get("slam_damage", 2)), data["name"] + " (landing)")
	var minions := 0
	for enemy: Node in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		if enemy != self and enemy.kind == "slime_mini":
			minions += 1
	if (phase == 1 and hop_count % 4 == 0) or (phase == 3 and hop_count % 3 == 0):
		if minions < 3:
			for i in 2:
				world.spawn_enemy("slime_mini", world.clamp_to_map(global_position + Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * 60.0))
	if phase >= 2:
		var bullets := 3 if phase == 2 else 5
		var to_player := _to_player().normalized()
		for i in bullets:
			var spread := (float(i) - float(bullets - 1) / 2.0) * 0.3
			world.spawn_projectile("slimeball", global_position, to_player.rotated(spread), 115.0, 1, data["name"] + " (slijmbal)")


# --- Schade en dood ---------------------------------------------------------------

## Wordt aangeroepen door het zwaard van de speler.
func hurt(damage: int, direction: Vector2) -> void:
	if dead or not active:
		return
	if kind == "king" and state == "hop":
		return # in de lucht
	if HabitatAI.blocks(self):
		world.ring(global_position,14,Color("b3ab7e"))
		Sound.play("hit",-14.0,0.7)
		return
	if data.behavior in ["hb_root","hb_moth"]:HabitatAI.interrupt(self)
	if data.behavior in ["ad_crab","ad_wisp","ad_keeper"] and state not in ["ad_swing","ad_pulse"]:CoastalAI.change(self,"ad_rest")
	if LivingAI.blocks(self, direction):
		world.ring(global_position, 18, Color(0.7, 0.9, 1))
		Sound.play("hit", -10.0, 1.5)
		return
	if data["behavior"] == "lw_support":
		state = "idle"
		state_time = 0.0
	if data["behavior"] in ["rf_ambush","rf_listen"]:
		state="rf_rest"
		state_time=0
	if data["behavior"] in ["cv_ram","cv_slinger"]:
		CombatAI.transition(self,"cv_rest")
	hp -= damage
	knockback = direction.normalized() * float(data.get("knockback", 240.0))
	flash = 0.15
	if data["behavior"] == "animal":
		panic = 5.0 # een geraakt dier vlucht, ook als de pijl van ver kwam
	if data["behavior"] == "mage" and (state == "appear" or state == "cast"):
		_mage_interrupt()
	if data["behavior"] == "echo_volley" and state == "echo_warn":
		state = "echo_rest"
		state_time = 0.0
	world.damage_number(global_position + Vector2(0, -_size_px() * 0.35), str(damage), Color(1, 0.95, 0.6))
	world.burst(global_position, Color(1, 1, 1), 5)
	if hp <= 0:
		_die()
		world.hitstop(0.07)
	else:
		Sound.play("hit", -2.0, randf_range(0.9, 1.1))
		world.hitstop(0.035)


func break_guard() -> void:
	if data.behavior=="hb_root":
		HabitatAI.interrupt(self,true)
		return
	if data["behavior"] != "lw_guard": return
	guard_broken = 1.8
	world.ring(global_position, 32, Color(1, 0.7, 0.3))
	Sound.play("hit", -3.0, 0.65)


func _die() -> void:
	dead = true
	remove_from_group("enemies")
	if not has_meta("practice"): GameState.register_kill(kind)
	Sound.play("die", -2.0, randf_range(0.9, 1.1))
	world.burst(global_position, data.get("death_color", Color(0.7, 1.0, 0.7)), 16)
	if unique_flag != "":
		GameState.set_flag(unique_flag)
	for drop: Array in ([] if has_meta("practice") else data["drops"]):
		if randf() < drop[1]:
			var amount := GameState.ng_coins(int(drop[2])) if drop[0] == "coin" else int(drop[2]) # Nieuw spel+: meer munten
			for i in amount:
				world.spawn_pickup(drop[0], global_position + Vector2(randf_range(-12, 12), randf_range(-6, 12)), "", true)
	died.emit()
	if kind == "king":
		_king_defeated()
	else:
		queue_free()


func _king_defeated() -> void:
	# De minions verdwijnen, de baas ontploft in een vuurwerk en dan begint het einde.
	for enemy: Node in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		enemy.queue_free()
	world.shake(10.0)
	for i in 8:
		world.burst(global_position + Vector2(randf_range(-40, 40), randf_range(-30, 30)), Color(0.5, 1.0, 0.6), 14)
	var tween := create_tween()
	tween.tween_property(self, "modulate:a", 0.0, 1.6)
	tween.tween_callback(func() -> void:
		GameState.run(["ending"])
		queue_free())


# --- Tekenen ------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _draw() -> void:
	var size := _size_px()
	var scale: float = data["scale"]
	var cell := Vector2i(int(data["cell"]), int(data["cell"]))
	var tint := Color(3, 3, 3) if flash > 0.0 else Color.WHITE
	var sheet := Art.tex(data["sheet"])
	var shadow: float = data["shadow"]
	var chasing: bool = player != null and active and _to_player().length() < float(data["sight"])

	match data["behavior"]:
		"ad_crab", "ad_wisp", "ad_keeper":
			CoastalAI.draw(self,sheet,tint)
		"hb_root", "hb_moth":
			HabitatAI.draw(self,sheet,tint)
		"cv_ram", "cv_slinger":
			CombatAI.draw(self,sheet,tint)
		"rf_ambush", "rf_listen":
			preload("res://scripts/entities/route_enemy.gd").draw(self,sheet,tint)
		"lw_guard", "lw_flank", "lw_support":
			LivingAI.draw(self, sheet, tint)
		"echo_charge", "echo_volley":
			EchoAI.draw(self, sheet, tint)
		"animal":
			# Wild dier: twee stapplaatjes, twee vluchtplaatjes (het kijkt naar rechts, net als de slijmen)
			DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, size * 0.44), Vector2(shadow, shadow * 0.35), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
			var column := int(anim * 0.9) % 2 + (2 if fleeing else 0)
			DrawUtil.sprite(self, sheet, column, 0, Vector2.ZERO, cell, scale, tint)
		"chase":
			DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, size * 0.44), Vector2(shadow, shadow * 0.35), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
			var column := int(anim * 0.6) % 2 + (2 if chasing else 0)
			DrawUtil.sprite(self, sheet, column, 0, Vector2.ZERO, cell, scale, tint)
		"bat":
			var hover := -6.0 + sin(t * 6.0) * 3.0
			DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, size * 0.44), Vector2(shadow, shadow * 0.35), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.25))
			var column := 2 if state == "dash" else int(t * 12.0) % 2
			if state == "telegraph" and int(t * 20.0) % 2 == 0:
				tint = Color(2.5, 1.2, 1.2)
			DrawUtil.sprite(self, sheet, column, 0, Vector2(0, hover), cell, scale, tint)
		"archer":
			DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, size * 0.44), Vector2(shadow, shadow * 0.35), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
			var face := _to_player() if player else Vector2.DOWN
			var row := 0
			if absf(face.y) > absf(face.x):
				row = 0 if face.y > 0.0 else 1
			else:
				row = 2 if face.x > 0.0 else 3
			var column := 3 if state == "aim" else (1 + int(anim * 0.8) % 2 if desired != Vector2.ZERO else 0)
			DrawUtil.sprite(self, sheet, column, row, Vector2.ZERO, cell, scale, tint)
			if state == "aim":
				DrawUtil.prompt(self, Vector2(0, -size * 0.55), t, "!")
		"mage":
			var hover := -5.0 + sin(t * 3.0) * 2.0
			var puffing := state == "vanish" or state == "appear"
			DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, size * 0.44), Vector2(shadow * (0.6 if puffing else 1.0), shadow * 0.3), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.2))
			var column := int(t * 2.2) % 2
			var sprite_scale := scale
			if puffing:
				# Het wolkje zwelt aan en vervaagt bij het verdwijnen en krimpt weer bij het verschijnen.
				var p := clampf(state_time / float(data["vanish_time" if state == "vanish" else "appear_time"]), 0.0, 1.0)
				column = 3
				hover = -2.0
				sprite_scale = scale * ((1.0 + 0.4 * p) if state == "vanish" else (1.4 - 0.4 * p))
				tint.a = (1.0 - 0.5 * p) if state == "vanish" else (0.5 + 0.5 * p)
			elif state == "cast" or action_flash > 0.0:
				column = 2 # handen omhoog, ook nog heel even na het schot
			DrawUtil.sprite(self, sheet, column, 0, Vector2(0, hover), cell, sprite_scale, tint)
			if state == "cast":
				_draw_mage_charge(hover)
		"spitter":
			DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, size * 0.44), Vector2(shadow * (1.0 - air_height / 40.0), shadow * 0.35), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
			var column := int(anim * 0.6) % 2
			var offset := Vector2(0, -air_height)
			var sprite_scale := scale
			if state == "windup":
				# Hij blaast zich op en trilt: nu komt er een waaier aan.
				var p := clampf(state_time / float(data["windup"]), 0.0, 1.0)
				column = 2
				offset.x = randf_range(-1.0, 1.0) * p * 1.5
				sprite_scale = scale * (1.0 + 0.12 * p)
				_draw_fan_hint(p)
			elif state == "hop":
				column = 4
			elif action_flash > 0.0:
				column = 3
			DrawUtil.sprite(self, sheet, column, 0, offset, cell, sprite_scale, tint)
		"golem":
			DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, size * 0.44), Vector2(shadow, shadow * 0.35), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
			var column := int(anim * 0.4) % 2
			if state == "windup":
				column = 2
			elif state == "recover" and state_time < 0.4:
				column = 3
			var offset := Vector2.ZERO
			if state == "windup":
				offset = Vector2(randf_range(-1.0, 1.0), 0.0) * 1.5
				draw_arc(Vector2(0, size * 0.3), 56.0 * clampf(state_time / 0.9, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0, TAU, 32, Color(1, 0.3, 0.3, 0.6), 3.0)
			DrawUtil.sprite(self, sheet, column, 0, offset, cell, scale, tint)
		"king":
			var lift := air_height
			DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, size * 0.44), Vector2(shadow * (1.0 - lift / 160.0), shadow * 0.35), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
			var column := int(anim * 0.5) % 2
			if state == "crouch" or state == "land":
				column = 2
			elif state == "hop":
				column = 3
			if _king_phase() == 3 and active and int(t * 6.0) % 2 == 0 and flash <= 0.0:
				tint = Color(1.5, 0.8, 0.8)
			DrawUtil.sprite(self, sheet, column, 0, Vector2(0, -lift), cell, scale, tint)


## De aanloop van de Magiër: zijn handen gloeien en boven zijn hoofd groeit een bol.
func _draw_mage_charge(hover: float) -> void:
	var p := clampf(state_time / float(data["cast_time"]), 0.0, 1.0)
	var pulse := 0.6 + 0.4 * sin(t * 40.0)
	for side: float in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		draw_circle(Vector2(side * 11.0, -12.0 + hover), 5.0 + 3.0 * p, Color(1.0, 0.6, 1.0, (0.25 + 0.3 * p) * pulse))
	var center := Vector2(0, MAGE_ORB_HEIGHT - 8.0 + hover)
	var radius_now := 2.0 + 6.0 * p
	draw_circle(center, radius_now + 3.0, Color(MAGE_COLOR, 0.25))
	draw_circle(center, radius_now, Color(0.75, 0.5, 1.0, 0.9))
	draw_circle(center, radius_now * 0.5, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.95))
	for i in 4:
		var angle := t * 9.0 + TAU * float(i) / 4.0
		draw_rect(Rect2(center + Vector2.from_angle(angle) * (radius_now + 4.0) - Vector2(1, 1), Vector2(2, 2)), Color(1, 0.8, 1, 0.9))


## Streepjes laten zien waar de slijmballen heen gaan. Tijdens de aanloop worden ze langer en feller, en met hun
## donkere rand zie je ze ook goed op gras.
func _draw_fan_hint(progress: float) -> void:
	var fan: int = data["fan"]
	var alpha := 0.5 + 0.5 * progress
	var tip := 26.0 + 16.0 * progress
	for i in fan:
		var direction := aim_dir.rotated((float(i) - float(fan - 1) / 2.0) * float(data["fan_spread"]))
		var from := Vector2(0, 6) + direction * 16.0
		var to := Vector2(0, 6) + direction * tip

static func prepare(data: Dictionary, map: String) -> void:
	# Alleen eigenschappen wijzigen: indexen van bestaande kisten/pickups blijven gelijk.
	for spec: Dictionary in data.objects:
		if spec.type!="enemy": continue
		if map=="forest":
			if spec.pos in [[8,17],[31,24]]: spec.kind="rf_bramble"
			# Let the west entrance/altar breathe; the first ambush belongs in a side clearing.
			if spec.pos==[8,17]: spec.pos=[20,11]
			# De kattenplek is een adempauze; gevechten liggen langs het pad ernaartoe.
			if spec.pos==[7,31]: spec.pos=[8,24]
			if spec.pos==[14,29]: spec.pos=[19,26]
			if spec.pos==[12,28]: spec.pos=[20,25]
		elif map=="cave":
			if spec.pos in [[14,18],[19,20],[16,10]]: spec.kind="rf_listener"
			# Het luisterpad moet echt stil te passeren zijn. Gewone jagers bewaken de oostelijke route.
			if spec.pos==[13,22]: spec.pos=[38,10]
			if spec.pos==[20,17]: spec.pos=[36,24]
			if spec.pos==[12,20]: spec.pos=[32,15]

func _draw() -> void:
	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2(footprint.size) / 2.0)
	# De brede vierkante sokkel staat geheel binnen de botsingsvoetafdruk.
	_r(-32, -32, 64, 64, INK)
	_r(-30, -30, 60, 56, STONE)
	_r(-30, 26, 60, 4, Color("536f7e"))
	_r(-28, -30, 56, 4, LIGHT)
	_r(-30, -26, 4, 48, Color("9fbac3"))
	_r(26, -26, 4, 48, Color("647f90"))
	# Open water, schaduw onder de rand en de voorwand met steenvoegen.
	_r(-24, -24, 48, 40, Color("235975"))
	_r(-22, -22, 44, 36, WATER)
	_r(-22, 10, 44, 4, Color("2c739a"))
	_r(-26, 16, 52, 8, Color("8da7b3"))
	_r(-26, 16, 52, 2, LIGHT)
	for x in [-20, -6, 8, 22]:
		_r(x, 20, 2, 6, Color("587584"))
	for y in [-22, -8, 6]:
		_r(-30, y, 6, 2, Color("587584"))
		_r(24, y + 6, 6, 2, Color("587584"))
	# Kringetjes en lichtjes bewegen los van elkaar.
	var phase := float(animation_frame) / 12.0
	for i in 5:
		var p := fmod(phase * 0.9 + i * 0.21, 1.0)
		var x := -18.0 + float((i * 11) % 36)
		var y := -16.0 + float((i * 7) % 24)
		var radius := 2.0 + floorf(p * 3.0) * 2.0
		_r(x - radius, y, radius * 2.0, 2, Color(FOAM, (1.0 - p) * 0.7))
	# Native-pixel chisel marks, damp seams and specular edge accents.
	for p in [Vector2(-25,-27),Vector2(18,-28),Vector2(-29,11),Vector2(27,-7),Vector2(-13,20),Vector2(13,21)]:
		_r(p.x,p.y,3,1,Color("d5ddd0"))
		_r(p.x+1,p.y+1,3,1,Color("6c8990"))
	for x in [-18,-2,14]:
		_r(x,-23,8,1,Color("315c70"))
	_r(-27,17,53,1,Color("e0e3cd"))
	_r(-29,24,58,2,Color("5b7884"))
	# Centrale zuil en schaal; de fontein spuit boven het bassin uit.
	_r(-8, -12, 16, 22, INK)
	_r(-6, -12, 12, 20, STONE)
	_r(-6, -12, 4, 18, LIGHT)
	_r(-12, -18, 24, 8, INK)
	_r(-10, -18, 20, 4, LIGHT)
	_r(-8, -16, 16, 2, Color("64b9d1"))
	var jet_height := floorf(18*water_strength/2)*2
	_r(-2, -16-jet_height, 4, jet_height, Color("5cc5df"))
	_r(0, -16-jet_height, 2, jet_height, FOAM)
	for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		for i in 5:
			if water_strength<0.5 and (i>0 or animation_frame%24>7): continue
			var p := fmod(phase * 0.85 + i * 0.2, 1.0)
			var drop := Vector2(side * (2.0 + p * 16.0*water_strength), -16.0-jet_height - sin(p * PI) * 8.0*water_strength + p * p * (16+jet_height))
			drop = (drop / 2.0).floor() * 2.0
			_r(drop.x, drop.y, 2, 4, FOAM if i % 2 == 0 else Color("74d8e8"))
		var splash := 2.0 + float(animation_frame % 3) * 2.0
		_r(side * 18.0 - splash, 2, splash * 2.0, 2, FOAM)
	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	t += delta
	anim += delta * 5.0
	flash = maxf(flash - delta, 0.0)
	touch_cooldown = maxf(touch_cooldown - delta, 0.0)
	if player == null:
		player = Util.player(self)
	if player == null or GameState.ended:
		velocity = Vector2.ZERO
		queue_redraw()
		return
	if not active:
		if GameState.flag(STARTED_FLAG):
			activate()
		queue_redraw()
		return

	state_time += delta
	desired = Vector2.ZERO
	match state:
		"waking":
			if state_time >= WAKE_TIME:
				_enter("idle")
		"idle":
			_step_idle()
		"charge_windup":
			_step_charge_windup()
		"charge_dash":
			desired = aim_dir * _p()["charge_speed"]
		"stunned":
			if state_time >= _p()["stun"]:
				_enter("idle")
		"recover":
			if state_time >= _p()["recover"]:
				_after_attack()
		"slam_windup":
			if state_time >= _p()["slam_windup"]:
				_slam()
		"slam_recover":
			if state_time >= _p()["slam_recover"]:
				_after_attack()
		"phase_shift":
			if state_time >= SHIFT_TIME:
				phase = shift_to
				volley_timer = 1.5
				_enter("idle")
		"dying":
			_step_dying(delta)
			queue_redraw()
			return
	_update_volleys(delta)

	var before := global_position
	velocity = desired + knockback
	knockback = knockback.move_toward(Vector2.ZERO, 700.0 * delta)
	move_and_slide()
	if state == "charge_dash":
		_step_dash(before)

	var touch_range := radius + 9.0
	if state in ["idle", "charge_windup", "charge_dash", "slam_windup"] and touch_cooldown <= 0.0 \
			and global_position.distance_to(player.global_position) < touch_range:
		touch_cooldown = 0.8
		if state == "charge_dash":
			player.hurt(global_position, 2, data["name"] + " (storm)")
		else:
			player.hurt(global_position, int(data["damage"]), data["name"])
	queue_redraw()

func _choose_attack(distance: float) -> void:
	var pick := "slam" if distance < SLAM_TRIGGER else "charge"
	# Niet steeds hetzelfde, dat is saai en voorspelbaar. (Een klap uit de verte heeft wel geen zin.)
	if pick == last_attack and repeat_count >= 2:
		var other := "charge" if pick == "slam" else "slam"
		if other == "charge" or distance < SLAM_TRIGGER * 1.6:
			pick = other
	repeat_count = repeat_count + 1 if pick == last_attack else 1
	last_attack = pick
	if pick == "charge":
		aim_dir = _to_player().normalized()
		line_length = _charge_length()
		_enter("charge_windup")
		Sound.play("guardian_charge")
	else:
		# In zijn woede schiet de klap ook een ring scherven weg. De rode lijnen laten alvast zien waar ze heen gaan.
		slam_angles.clear()
		if phase == 3:
			slam_angles = _ring_angles(randf() * TAU, 1)
		_enter("slam_windup")
		Sound.play("pillar_charge", -4.0)

func _step_charge_windup() -> void:
	var windup: float = _p()["charge_windup"]
	# Eerst volgt de rode baan jou, de laatste tijd ligt hij vast: één stap opzij of een rol en hij mist.
	if state_time < windup * 0.6:
		# Hij mikt een beetje vooruit: wie rechtdoor blijft rennen wordt geraakt.
		var player_velocity: Vector2 = player.velocity
		var lead := _to_player() + player_velocity * (windup - state_time) * 0.6
		aim_dir = aim_dir.lerp(lead.normalized(), 0.18).normalized()
		line_length = _charge_length()
	if state_time >= windup:
		dash_left = line_length
		_enter("charge_dash")
		world.shake(2.5)

func hurt(damage: int, direction: Vector2) -> void:
	if dead or not active:
		return
	if state == "waking" or state == "phase_shift":
		# Beschermd: er springen alleen een paar vonken af, en je ziet dat je klap niet telt.
		world.burst(global_position + direction.normalized() * 18.0, GLOW, 4)
		world.damage_number(global_position + Vector2(0, -_size_px() * 0.35), tr("Beschermd!"), Color(0.75, 0.8, 0.95))
		Sound.play("hit", -10.0, 1.8)
		return
	hp -= damage
	flash = 0.15
	world.damage_number(global_position + Vector2(0, -_size_px() * 0.35), str(damage), Color(1, 0.95, 0.6))
	world.burst(global_position, Color(1, 1, 1), 5)
	if hp <= 0:
		_die()
		world.hitstop(0.09)
		return
	Sound.play("hit", -2.0, randf_range(0.8, 0.95))
	var new_phase := _phase_for_hp()
	if new_phase > phase:
		_begin_phase_shift(mini(new_phase, phase + 1)) # nooit een fase overslaan, ook niet bij een enorme klap
	world.hitstop(0.04)

	var center := global_position

func _frame() -> int:
	match state:
		"dormant":
			return 6
		"waking":
			return 6 if state_time < WAKE_TIME * 0.35 else 7
		"charge_windup":
			return 2
		"charge_dash":
			return 3
		"stunned":
			return 6
		"slam_windup":
			return 4
		"slam_recover":
			return 5 if state_time < 0.4 else 0
		"phase_shift":
			return 7
		"dying":
			return 6 if int(state_time * 8.0) % 2 == 0 else 7
	return int(anim * 0.4) % 2

func _draw_charge_lane() -> void:
	var windup: float = _p()["charge_windup"]
	var progress := clampf(state_time / windup, 0.0, 1.0)
	var locked := state_time >= windup * 0.6
	var half := radius + 9.0
	var from := Vector2(0, FOOT)
	var to := from + aim_dir * line_length
	var side := aim_dir.orthogonal() * half
	var alpha := 0.12 + progress * 0.3
	if locked and int(state_time * 16.0) % 2 == 0:
		alpha += 0.2
	draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([from + side, to + side, to - side, from - side]), Color(WARNING, alpha))
	draw_line(from + side, to + side, Color(WARNING, 0.5 + progress * 0.4), 2.0)
	draw_line(from - side, to - side, Color(WARNING, 0.5 + progress * 0.4), 2.0)
	draw_line(from, to, Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.6, 0.5 + progress * 0.4), 3.0 if locked else 1.5)
	# pijlpunten die laten zien welke kant hij op gaat
	var step := 44.0
	var at := step
	while at < line_length:
		var p := from + aim_dir * at
		draw_line(p - aim_dir * 8.0 + aim_dir.orthogonal() * 8.0, p, Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6), 2.0)
		draw_line(p - aim_dir * 8.0 - aim_dir.orthogonal() * 8.0, p, Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6), 2.0)
		at += step

extends Node2D
## Een kristalscherf van De Vergeten Wachter of zijn pilaren. Vliegt rechtdoor, verdwijnt tegen een muur en doet
## schade aan de speler (rollen maakt je even onraakbaar, net als bij pijlen).

const DrawUtil := preload("res://scripts/core/draw_util.gd")
const Art := preload("res://scripts/core/art.gd")
const Util := preload("res://scripts/core/util.gd")

const HIT_RANGE := 11.0 # hoe dichtbij de speler moet zijn om geraakt te worden (zoals projectile.gd)
const MAX_AGE := 6.0
const GLOW := Color(0.7, 0.45, 1.0)

var velocity := Vector2.ZERO
var damage := 1
var source := "De Vergeten Wachter (scherf)"
var world: Node
var age := 0.0
var player: Node2D


func _ready() -> void:
	add_to_group("guardian_shards")


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	age += delta
	position += velocity * delta
	if age > MAX_AGE or world.is_solid(global_position):
		world.burst(global_position, GLOW, 4)
		queue_free()
		return
	if player == null:
		player = Util.player(self)
	if player and not GameState.ended and global_position.distance_to(player.global_position + Vector2(0, 4)) < HIT_RANGE:
		player.hurt(global_position - velocity.normalized() * 8.0, damage, source)
		world.burst(global_position, GLOW, 5)
		queue_free()
		return
	queue_redraw()


func _draw() -> void:
	draw_circle(Vector2.ZERO, 9.0, Color(GLOW, 0.18))
	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, velocity.angle(), Vector2.ONE)
	DrawUtil.sprite(self, Art.tex("depths_objects"), 3 + int(age * 10.0) % 2, 0)
	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2.ONE)

static func clipped_length(foe: Node2D, requested: float, half_width: float) -> float:
 var origin: Vector2=foe.habitat_origin
 var side: Vector2=foe.aim_dir.orthogonal()*half_width
 var length:=0.0
 for step in range(4,int(requested)+1,4):
  var at: Vector2=origin+foe.aim_dir*step
  if not within_home(foe,at) or protected(foe,at):break
  var clear:=true
  for offset: Vector2 in [-side,Vector2.ZERO,side]:
   if protected(foe,at+offset) or not within_home(foe,at+offset) or not foe._clear_line(origin+offset,at+offset):clear=false;break
  if not clear:break
  length=step
 return length

func interact() -> void:
	if GameState.input_locked() or active:
		return
	match kind:
		"board":
			GameState.start_quest("prisma_herstel")
			GameState.say(label(), [tr("De drie spiegels horen één lichtpad te vormen: oost, zuid, west. Draai ze naar hun ontvangers en activeer daarna de kern."), tr("Greta zoekt deze kern voor haar oude werkplaats. Aardingspoeder uit de bibliotheek biedt een rustige oplossing; de bewakers verslaan kan ook.")])
		"mirror":
			GameState.start_quest("prisma_herstel")
			if GameState.flag("lw_mine"):
				return
			Living.turn(id)
			Sound.play("door", -9.0, 1.2)
			GameState.set_flag("lw_beams", Living.beams_ready())
			GameState.save_requested.emit()
		"core":
			GameState.start_quest("prisma_herstel")
			if GameState.flag("lw_mine"):
				GameState.toast.emit(tr("De kern is stabiel. Greta wacht bij haar prismabank."))
			elif not Living.beams_ready():
				GameState.toast.emit(tr("Volg het lichtpad: richt eerst alle drie de spiegels op de ontvangers."))
			else:
				GameState.set_flag("lw_beams")
				Living.open(self, obj["talk"])
		"forge":
			if not GameState.flag("lw_mine"):
				GameState.start_quest("prisma_herstel")
				GameState.say("Greta", [tr("Mijn prismabank mist zijn kern. Zoek in de Prismamijn, via de Echo-grot. Een ijzeren zwaard opent die zijroute.")])
			else:
				if Living.mark("lw_workshop"):
					GameState.start_quest("prisma_herstel")
					GameState.finish_quest("prisma_herstel")
					GameState.start_quest("lichtwerk")
					world.burst(global_position, Color(0.5, 0.9, 1), 20)
					GameState.save_requested.emit()
				Living.open(self, obj["talk"])
		"rune":
			_rune()
		"brazier":
			GameState.start_quest("warmte")
			if GameState.flag(id):
				GameState.toast.emit(tr("Dit huis blijft warm. De bewoners zijn terug."))
			elif GameState.flag(id + "_fuel"):
				begin()
			else:
				Living.open(self, obj["talk"])
		"sluice":
			GameState.start_quest("wilgentwijgen")
			if GameState.flag("lw_drained"):
				GameState.toast.emit(tr("De waterstand is veilig. De sluizen blijven zo staan."))
				return
			GameState.set_flag(id + "_seen")
			GameState.set_flag(id, not GameState.flag(id))
			if GameState.flag("lw_sluice_west_seen") and GameState.flag("lw_sluice_east_seen") and GameState.flag("lw_sluice_west") and not GameState.flag("lw_sluice_east"):
				Living.mark("lw_drained")
				GameState.toast.emit(tr("Het water zakt. De oostelijke oever en het Rietarchief vallen droog."))
			else:
				GameState.toast.emit(tr("Sluis: open") if GameState.flag(id) else tr("Sluis: dicht"))
			Sound.play("door", -5.0, 0.7)
			GameState.save_requested.emit()
		"bridge":
			GameState.start_quest("wilgentwijgen")
			if GameState.flag("lw_bridge"):
				GameState.toast.emit(tr("De oversteek is hersteld. Vertel het aan Mees in het oostelijke rietland."))
			else:
				Living.open(self, obj["talk"])

functions.name: choose
functions.source:
func choose(action: String) -> void:
	if active:
		return
	match action:
		"core_fight", "core_powder":
			if kind != "core" or GameState.flag("lw_mine") or not Living.beams_ready(): return
			if action == "core_powder":
				if not pay("lw_powder", 1): return
				finish()
			else: begin()
		"buy_lantern":
			if kind != "forge" or not GameState.flag("lw_workshop") or GameState.coins < 40 or GameState.count("lw_lens") < 1 or GameState.count("lw_lantern") > 0: return
			GameState.take("lw_lens")
			GameState.add_coins(-40)
			GameState.give("lw_lantern", 1, true)
			Living.lantern_made()
		"bridge_kit", "bridge_resin", "bridge_fight":
			if kind != "bridge" or GameState.flag("lw_bridge"): return
			if not GameState.flag("lw_drained"):
				GameState.toast.emit(tr("Eerst de waterdruk verlagen: west open, oost dicht. Je materialen blijven in je tas."))
				return
			if action == "bridge_fight": begin()
			elif pay("lw_bridge_kit" if action == "bridge_kit" else "lw_resin", 1): finish()
		"heat_wood", "heat_food", "heat_prism":
			if kind != "brazier" or GameState.flag(id): return
			if not GameState.flag(id + "_fuel"):
				if action == "heat_prism" and not GameState.flag("lw_workshop"): return
				if action == "heat_wood" and not pay("prof_branch", 3): return
				if action == "heat_food" and not pay("prof_winter_gloed", 1): return
				Living.mark(id + "_fuel")
			begin()

func _collect() -> void:
	if collected or is_queued_for_deletion():
		return
	# Claim before inventory signals fire: synchronous listeners cannot award
	# a coin or a unique object twice before queue_free takes effect.
	if item == "heart" and GameState.hp >= GameState.max_hp():
		return
	if item != "coin" and item != "heart" and GameState.room(item) <= 0:
		_warn_full(Items.info(item))
		return
	collected = true
	match item:
		"coin":
			GameState.add_coins(1)
			Sound.play("coin", -4.0)
		"heart":
			GameState.heal(1)
			Sound.play("heart", -3.0)
		_:
			var info := Items.info(item)
			if info.get("type", "") == "ammo":
				# Pijlen vallen vaak een voor een: geen melding maar een klein plusje.
				GameState.give(item, 1, true)
				Sound.play("select", -2.0, 1.3)
				world.damage_number(global_position + Vector2(0, -14), "+1", Color(1.0, 0.9, 0.6))
			else:
				GameState.give(item)
				Sound.play("crystal" if info.get("type", "") == "crystal" else "chest", -2.0)
			if info.get("type", "") == "crystal":
				world.shake(3.0)
	if unique_key != "":
		GameState.set_flag(unique_key)
	world.burst(global_position, Color(1, 0.95, 0.6), 8)
	queue_free()

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	combat.update(self, delta)
	time += delta
	combo_window = maxf(combo_window - delta, 0.0)
	if combo_window <= 0.0:
		combo_step = 0
	var dir := Vector2.ZERO
	var locked := GameState.input_locked()
	if not locked:
		dir = Input.get_vector("move_left", "move_right", "move_up", "move_down")
	moving = dir != Vector2.ZERO
	if moving or locked:
		cancel_work_animation()
	if work_active:
		work_elapsed = minf(work_elapsed + delta, work_duration)
	drink_anim = maxf(drink_anim - delta, 0.0)
	var rolling := roll_timer > 0.0
	var pushed := knockback.length_squared() > 1.0
	var tile_name := ground_tile()
	var wants_sprint: bool = moving and not locked and not rolling and not pushed \
		and attack_timer <= 0.0 and bow_anim <= 0.0 and Input.is_action_pressed("sprint") \
		and GameState.movement.can_sprint() and not combat.busy()
	var run_multiplier: float = GameState.movement.sprint_multiplier(delta) if wants_sprint else 1.0
	if rolling:
		velocity = roll_dir * ROLL_SPEED
	else:
		if moving:
			facing = dir.normalized()
		velocity = dir * SPEED * GameState.speed_multiplier() * Tiles.movement_multiplier(tile_name) * run_multiplier + knockback
	knockback = knockback.move_toward(Vector2.ZERO, 900.0 * delta)
	var before := global_position
	if combat.phase in ["prepare","guard","counter"]:
		velocity *= 0.35
		sprinting = false
	move_and_slide()
	var distance := (global_position - before).length()
	var walking := moving and not locked and not rolling and not pushed and distance > 4.0 * delta
	sprinting = wants_sprint and walking
	if not locked:
		GameState.movement.advance(delta, sprinting)
	if walking:
		walk_time += distance / SPEED
	_update_footsteps(distance, walking, ground_tile())
	roll_timer = maxf(roll_timer - delta, 0.0)
	roll_cooldown = maxf(roll_cooldown - delta, 0.0)
	attack_timer = maxf(attack_timer - delta, 0.0)
	cooldown = maxf(cooldown - delta, 0.0)
	invuln = maxf(invuln - delta, 0.0)
	bow_cooldown = maxf(bow_cooldown - delta, 0.0)
	bow_anim = maxf(bow_anim - delta, 0.0)
	no_arrows_toast = maxf(no_arrows_toast - delta, 0.0)
	_update_aim()
	_update_target()
	_update_shake(delta)
	queue_redraw()

func _shoot(allow_technique := true, precise := false, locked_direction := Vector2.ZERO) -> void:
	if allow_technique and combat.busy(): return
	if allow_technique and Input.is_action_pressed("technique"):
		combat.begin(self, true)
		return
	if world == null or bow_cooldown > 0.0 or roll_timer > 0.0:
		return
	if GameState.count("bow") <= 0:
		if no_arrows_toast <= 0.0:
			no_arrows_toast = NO_ARROWS_TOAST_TIME
			GameState.toast.emit(tr("Je hebt een boog nodig. Tobias verkoopt er een."))
			Sound.play("error", -5.0)
		return
	cancel_work_animation()
	_update_aim()
	bow_cooldown = 0.8 if precise else BOW_COOLDOWN
	var lent := _lent_arrow()
	if GameState.count("arrow") <= 0 and not lent:
		Sound.play("error", -3.0)
		if no_arrows_toast <= 0.0:
			no_arrows_toast = NO_ARROWS_TOAST_TIME
			GameState.toast.emit(tr("Geen pijlen!"))
		return
	if not lent:
		GameState.take("arrow")
	bow_anim = BOW_ANIM_TIME
	bow_direction = locked_direction if precise else aim_direction
	var arrow: Node2D = ArrowScript.new()
	arrow.world = world
	arrow.direction = bow_direction
	arrow.precise = precise
	if precise:
		arrow.damage = 3
		arrow.speed = 420.0
		arrow.max_range = 400.0
	arrow.position = global_position + ARROW_HEIGHT
	world.entities.add_child(arrow)
	arrow.launch(ARROW_START)
	Sound.play("boog_twang", -3.0, randf_range(0.95, 1.05))
	world.burst(arrow.position, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8), 3)

	if invuln > 0.0 or GameState.ended or (roll_timer > ROLL_TIME - ROLL_SAFE_TIME):
		return
	if combat.try_block(self,from_pos):return
	cancel_work_animation()
	combat.cancel()
	GameState.last_damage_source = source
	GameState.damage_log[source] = int(GameState.damage_log.get(source, 0)) + GameState.damage_after_armor(amount)
	GameState.hurt(amount)
	Sound.play("hurt")
	invuln = INVULN_TIME
	knockback = (global_position - from_pos).normalized() * 260.0
	shake(5.0)
	if world:
		world.hitstop(0.07)

	var weapon: Dictionary = Items.WEAPONS[GameState.weapon]
	var reach: float = weapon["reach"]
	var color: Color = weapon["color"]

	var tip := Vector2.from_angle(angle) * (reach - 6.0)
	draw_line(Vector2.ZERO, hilt, Color(0.45, 0.3, 0.15), 4.0)
	draw_line(hilt, tip, color, 4.0)
	draw_line(hilt, tip, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.7), 1.5)
	draw_line(hilt + Vector2.from_angle(angle + PI / 2.0) * 4.0, hilt + Vector2.from_angle(angle - PI / 2.0) * 4.0,

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	advance(delta)
	queue_redraw()
	if status==null: return
	panel.visible=not GameState.input_locked() and not GameState.ended
	if not panel.visible: return
	if GameState.map_id=="sunwell":
		status.text=tr("De bron stroomt — de kloof is koel") if GameState.flag("ra_spring") else tr("Water: %d/3 • %s") % [water,tr("In de schaduw") if sheltered(world.player.position) else tr("Zoek de volgende blauwe luifel")]
		gauge.value=0 if GameState.flag("ra_spring") else heat*100/6
	else:
		status.text=tr("Touw vast — veilige oversteek") if GameState.flag("ra_rope") else [tr("Windstil — steek nu over"),tr("Wimpels spannen — zoek dekking"),tr("Windstoot — wacht naast de pas")][wind_phase()]
		gauge.value=fmod(time,10)*10
	var viewport_size:=get_viewport_rect().size
	var right_edge: float=world.hud.tracker_panel.position.x-12.0
	var left_edge:=250.0
	panel.size.x=minf(410,maxf(200,right_edge-left_edge))
	panel.size.y=0
	panel.position=Vector2(left_edge+maxf(0,(right_edge-left_edge-panel.size.x)/2),110)

Steek bovenlangs over: slappe wimpels betekenen rust, gele wimpels waarschuwen, witte sneeuwstrepen betekenen wind.") ,tr("Een windstoot brengt je terug naar de veilige kant. Zet het touw vast aan de oostelijke paal om voortaan beschermd over te steken. Je verliest geen hartjes of spullen.")])
		"anchor":
			if not GameState.flag("ra_rope_kit"):

func choose(choice: String) -> void:
	if kind=="spring" and choice in ["wild","caravan"]:
		if not GameState.flag("ra_prepared") and not GameState.flag("ra_spring"): return
		GameState.set_flag("ra_spring")
		GameState.set_flag("ra_water_wild",choice=="wild")
		GameState.set_flag("ra_water_caravan",choice=="caravan")
		GameState.start_quest("cactusvijgen")
		GameState.save_requested.emit()
		Sound.play("ra_water",-6)
		GameState.toast.emit(tr("De bron stroomt weer. Vertel Sana bij de oase waar het water naartoe gaat."))
	elif kind=="desk" and choice in ["correct","wrong"] and not GameState.flag("ra_archive_done"):
		if not GameState.flag("ra_folio_reed") or not GameState.flag("ra_folio_port") or not GameState.flag("ra_folio_flood"): return
		if choice=="wrong":
			GameState.toast.emit(tr("Kijk naar wat er bijkomt: eerst riet zonder huizen, dan de aanlegplaats, pas daarna het hoge water boven diezelfde palen."))
			return
		GameState.set_flag("ra_archive_done")
		GameState.set_flag("ra_exhibit_routes")
		GameState.finish_quest("ra_archive")
		GameState.give("gear_ra_compass",1,true)
		GameState.save_requested.emit()
		Sound.play("ra_pages",-6)
	elif kind in ["desk","exhibit"] and GameState.flag("ra_archive_done") and choice in ["routes","stories"]:
		GameState.set_flag("ra_exhibit_routes",choice=="routes")
		GameState.save_requested.emit()
		GameState.toast.emit(tr("De tentoonstelling bij Mees is bijgewerkt. Je kunt je keuze hier later veranderen."))

extends StaticBody2D
## Een blauw altaar: je wordt genezen en je voortgang wordt opgeslagen. Zo ontdek je het ook: daarna kun je
## er snel naartoe reizen via de kaart in het menu (zie scripts/core/fast_travel.gd).

const DrawUtil := preload("res://scripts/core/draw_util.gd")
const Art := preload("res://scripts/core/art.gd")
const Util := preload("res://scripts/core/util.gd")
const FastTravel := preload("res://scripts/core/fast_travel.gd")

const LIGHT_ENERGY := 0.9

var world: Node
var t := randf() * TAU
var flash := 0.0
var player: Node2D
var light: PointLight2D


func _ready() -> void:
	add_to_group("interactable")
	collision_layer = 1
	var shape := CollisionShape2D.new()
	var rect := RectangleShape2D.new()
	rect.size = Vector2(18, 12)
	shape.shape = rect
	shape.position = Vector2(0, 6)
	add_child(shape)
	light = PointLight2D.new()
	light.texture = Art.light_texture()
	light.color = Color(0.4, 0.75, 1.0)
	light.texture_scale = 1.6
	light.energy = LIGHT_ENERGY
	light.enabled = false
	add_child(light)


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	t += delta
	flash = maxf(flash - delta, 0.0)
	if player == null:
		player = Util.player(self)
	# Het altaar gloeit in donkere gebieden, en buiten 's avonds en 's nachts.
	var need: float = world.light_need() if world != null else 0.0
	light.enabled = need > 0.02
	light.energy = LIGHT_ENERGY * need
	queue_redraw()


## De vlag die onthoudt dat dit altaar ontdekt is (opgeslagen met de rest van de vlaggen).
func discovery_key() -> String:
	return FastTravel.altar_key(GameState.map_id, Vector2i(int(position.x / 32.0), int(position.y / 32.0)))


func interact() -> void:
	GameState.full_rest()
	var first_time := not GameState.flag(discovery_key())
	GameState.set_flag(discovery_key())
	world.autosave()
	Sound.play("save")
	flash = 0.6
	world.burst(global_position + Vector2(0, -6), Color(0.5, 0.85, 1.0), 16)
	GameState.toast.emit(tr("Voortgang opgeslagen. Je bent genezen!"))
	if first_time:
		Sound.play("wereld_altaar", -2.0)
		world.ring(global_position + Vector2(0, -6), 54.0, Color(0.5, 0.85, 1.0))
		GameState.toast.emit(tr("Altaar ontdekt! Via de kaart (N) reis je er later snel naartoe."))


func _draw() -> void:
	DrawUtil.ellipse(self, Vector2(0, 12), Vector2(11, 3.5), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
	draw_circle(Vector2(0, -4), 16.0 + sin(t * 2.0) * 2.0 + flash * 14.0, Color(0.3, 0.7, 1.0, 0.14 + flash * 0.25))
	DrawUtil.sprite(self, Art.tex("altar"), int(t * 1.1) % 2, 0)
	if player and player.target == self:
		DrawUtil.prompt(self, Vector2(0, -28.0), t)

extends Node2D
## De schietbaan: houdt de tijd bij tijdens een poging en telt hoeveel doelwitten je raakt. Tessa (scripts/data/ext/boog.gd)
## start een poging met de actie ["boog_range_start"]. Tijdens een poging (aftellen en lopende tijd) schiet je met
## Tessa's pijlen: een schot kost dan niets (zie lends_arrows() en player.gd).
##
##   {"type": "boog_baan", "pos": [31, 15], "size": [1, 3], "id": "schietbaan"}
##
## `pos` en `size` (in tegels) zijn de schietlijn: een vlonder met een witte streep, de doelwitten staan rechts ervan.
## Alle doelwitten met "range": "schietbaan" horen bij deze baan. `time` (seconden) is de tijd voor een poging,
## standaard 20.

const Util := preload("res://scripts/core/util.gd")

const DEFAULT_TIME := 20.0
const READY_TIME := 3.0 # aftellen (3, 2, 1) voordat de tijd begint: genoeg om naar de schietlijn te lopen
const END_TIME := 2.5 # zo lang blijft het resultaat staan voordat de doelwitten weer recht staan
const PRACTICE_RESET := 1.6 # een oefenschot: het doelwit staat daarna vanzelf weer recht
const WON_FLAG := "boog_range_won"
const QUEST := "boog_schietbaan"
const LOW_TIME := 5.0 # onder deze tijd kleurt de teller rood
const BOX_HEIGHT := 44.0 # de teller staat zo hoog boven het middelpunt van de speler
const ABOVE_BOX := Vector2(0, -78) # "Af!" zweeft boven de teller, zodat ze niet over elkaar heen vallen
const ABOVE_TARGET := Vector2(0, -26) # "1/3" zweeft boven het doelwit dat je net raakte
const DECK_WIDTH := 28.0 # de vlonder van de schietlijn (een tegel is 32)
const PLANK := 8.0 # hoogte van een plank

var world: Node
var obj: Dictionary = {}
var key := ""
var range_id := "schietbaan"
var time_limit := DEFAULT_TIME
var state := "idle" # idle, ready, run, won of lost
var time_left := 0.0
var ready_left := 0.0
var count_shown := 0 # het getal dat nu wordt afgeteld (voor het tikje bij elk nieuw getal)
var end_left := 0.0
var elapsed := 0.0
var hits := 0
var player: Node2D
var floor_node: Node2D # de planken op de grond (onder de personages getekend)
var overlay: Node2D # de teller boven je hoofd (boven alles getekend)


func _ready() -> void:
	add_to_group("boog_range")
	range_id = obj.get("id", "schietbaan")
	time_limit = float(obj.get("time", DEFAULT_TIME))
	floor_node = Node2D.new()
	floor_node.position = position
	floor_node.draw.connect(_draw_floor)
	world.ground.add_child(floor_node) # de grondlaag wordt bij een nieuwe kaart vanzelf opgeruimd
	overlay = Node2D.new()
	overlay.z_index = 45
	overlay.draw.connect(_draw_overlay)
	add_child(overlay)


func _exit_tree() -> void:
	if is_instance_valid(floor_node):
		floor_node.queue_free()


func targets() -> Array[Node2D]:
	var found: Array[Node2D] = []
	for target: Node2D in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("boog_target"):
		if target.range_id == range_id:
			found.append(target)
	return found


func _count_hits() -> int:
	var total := 0
	for target in targets():
		if target.hit:
			total += 1
	return total


func _reset_targets() -> void:
	for target in targets():
		target.reset()


## Begint een poging (door Tessa). Tijdens een lopende poging doet dit niets.
func start_run() -> void:
	if lends_arrows():
		return
	_reset_targets()
	state = "ready"
	ready_left = READY_TIME
	count_shown = 0
	hits = 0


## Loopt er een poging (aftellen of tijd)? Dan schiet je met Tessa's pijlen.
func lends_arrows() -> bool:
	return state == "ready" or state == "run"


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if player == null:
		player = Util.player(self)
	match state:
		"idle":
			for target in targets():
				if target.hit and target.hit_age > PRACTICE_RESET:
					target.reset()
		"ready":
			if ceili(ready_left) != count_shown:
				count_shown = ceili(ready_left)
				Sound.play("select", -2.0)
			ready_left -= delta
			if ready_left <= 0.0:
				_go()
		"run":
			elapsed += delta
			time_left -= delta
			var now := _count_hits()
			if now > hits:
				hits = now
				var newest := _newest_hit()
				if newest:
					world.damage_number(newest.hit_center() + ABOVE_TARGET, "%d/%d" % [hits, targets().size()], Color(1.0, 0.9, 0.4))
			if hits >= targets().size():
				_win()
			elif time_left <= 0.0:
				_lose()
		"won", "lost":
			end_left -= delta
			if end_left <= 0.0:
				_reset_targets()
				state = "idle"
	overlay.queue_redraw()


func _go() -> void:
	_reset_targets()
	state = "run"
	time_left = time_limit
	elapsed = 0.0
	hits = 0
	Sound.play("select", -2.0, 1.6)
	_floating_text(tr("Af!"), Color(0.6, 1.0, 0.7))


func _win() -> void:
	state = "won"
	end_left = END_TIME
	Sound.play("quest")
	var seconds := decimal(elapsed)
	if GameState.quest_state(QUEST) == "active" and not GameState.flag(WON_FLAG):
		GameState.set_flag(WON_FLAG)
		# Vertalers: %s is een tijd met één cijfer achter de komma (zie het decimaalteken)
		GameState.toast.emit(tr("Gehaald in %s seconden! Ga naar Tessa voor je beloning.") % seconds)
	else:
		GameState.toast.emit(tr("Gehaald in %s seconden!") % seconds)


func _lose() -> void:
	state = "lost"
	end_left = END_TIME
	Sound.play("error")
	GameState.toast.emit(tr("Tijd om! Je raakte %d van de %d. Praat met Tessa voor een nieuwe poging.") % [hits, targets().size()])


## Een getal met één cijfer achter de komma, met het decimaalteken van de taal: "12,3" in het Nederlands.
func decimal(value: float) -> String:
	# Vertalers: het decimaalteken in jouw taal (in het Engels een punt: ".")
	return ("%.1f" % value).replace(".", tr(",", "decimaalteken"))


## Het doelwit dat het laatst geraakt is.
func _newest_hit() -> Node2D:
	var newest: Node2D = null
	for target in targets():
		if target.hit and (newest == null or target.hit_age < newest.hit_age):
			newest = target
	return newest


func _floating_text(text: String, color: Color) -> void:
	if player and is_instance_valid(player):
		world.damage_number(player.global_position + ABOVE_BOX, text, color)


# --- Tekenen -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _draw_floor() -> void:
	var size: Array = obj.get("size", [1, 1])
	var length := float(size[1]) * 32.0 - 4.0
	# Een vlonder van dwarse planken met een witte streep aan de kant van de doelwitten: dit is de schietlijn.
	var left := -DECK_WIDTH / 2.0
	var top := -14.0
	floor_node.draw_rect(Rect2(left - 1.0, top - 1.0, DECK_WIDTH + 2.0, length + 2.0), Color(0.16, 0.1, 0.05))
	var y := top
	var row := 0
	while y < top + length:
		var plank := minf(PLANK, top + length - y)
		var shade := Color(0.6, 0.42, 0.23) if row % 2 == 0 else Color(0.53, 0.36, 0.19)
		floor_node.draw_rect(Rect2(left, y, DECK_WIDTH, plank), shade)
		floor_node.draw_rect(Rect2(left, y, DECK_WIDTH, 1.0), Color(0.72, 0.53, 0.31)) # licht randje bovenop
		floor_node.draw_rect(Rect2(left, y + plank - 1.0, DECK_WIDTH, 1.0), Color(0.33, 0.21, 0.1)) # naad
		# Spijkertjes, om en om een beetje verschoven.
		var nail_x := left + (5.0 if row % 2 == 0 else 8.0)
		floor_node.draw_rect(Rect2(nail_x, y + 3.0, 1.0, 1.0), Color(0.25, 0.2, 0.16))
		floor_node.draw_rect(Rect2(left + DECK_WIDTH - nail_x + left - 1.0, y + 3.0, 1.0, 1.0), Color(0.25, 0.2, 0.16))
		y += PLANK
		row += 1
	floor_node.draw_rect(Rect2(left + DECK_WIDTH - 4.0, top, 3.0, length), Color(0.95, 0.94, 0.88))


func _draw_overlay() -> void:
	if state == "idle" or player == null or not is_instance_valid(player):
		return
	var text := ""
	var color := Color.WHITE
	match state:
		"ready":
			# Vertalers: aftellen voor de schietbaan: "Klaar? 3"
			text = tr("Klaar? %d") % maxi(ceili(ready_left), 1)
		"run":
			text = "%s  %d/%d" % [decimal(maxf(time_left, 0.0)), hits, targets().size()]
			if time_left < LOW_TIME:
				color = Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.45)
		"won":
			text = tr("Gehaald!")
			color = Color(0.6, 1.0, 0.7)
		"lost":
			text = tr("Te laat!")
			color = Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.45)
	var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
	var width := font.get_string_size(text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 14).x
	var center := to_local(player.global_position) + Vector2(0, -BOX_HEIGHT)
	overlay.draw_rect(Rect2(center.x - width / 2.0 - 6.0, center.y - 14.0, width + 12.0, 22.0), Color(0.04, 0.06, 0.14, 0.85))
	overlay.draw_rect(Rect2(center.x - width / 2.0 - 6.0, center.y - 14.0, width + 12.0, 22.0), Color(color, 0.8), false, 1.0)
	overlay.draw_string(font, center + Vector2(-width / 2.0, 2.0), text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 14, color)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	time+=delta
	velocity=Vector2.ZERO
	if not is_instance_valid(director): return
	var dark: bool=GameState.day_time<0.12 or GameState.day_time>0.78
	if evening!=dark and GameState.map_id=="lake":
		evening=dark
		path.clear()
		route_index=0
		wait_time=1
	# A dialogue already pauses the world. Merely being the nearest interactable
	# must not freeze a passer-by beside a stationary player forever.
	if wait_time>0:
		wait_time-=delta
	elif path.is_empty():
		var points:=route()
		task_index=route_index%points.size() if GameState.map_id=="lake" else mini(route_index,points.size()-1)
		path=director.walk_path(self,Vector2i(points[task_index]))
		if not path.is_empty(): path.remove_at(0)
		route_index+=1
		if path.is_empty(): wait_time=0.2 if GameState.map_id=="inn" and route_index<points.size() else 8
	else:
		var offset:=path[0]-position
		if offset.length()<2:
			path.remove_at(0)
			if path.is_empty(): wait_time=0.2 if GameState.map_id=="inn" and route_index<route().size() else 8
		else:
			var before:=position
			velocity=offset.normalized()*(36 if GameState.map_id=="inn" else 24)
			move_and_slide()
			stuck=stuck+delta if position.distance_to(before)<0.05 else 0.0
			if stuck>1.0:
				stuck=0
				path.clear()
				route_index=maxi(0,route_index-1)
				wait_time=0.2
	queue_redraw()

func interact() -> void:
	if GameState.input_locked() or pulling: return
	match kind:
		"notice": GameState.start_dialogue("ls_invite")
		"basket":
			if GameState.flag("ls_basket"): return
			if GameState.count("fishing_rod")==0:
				GameState.say(label(),[tr("De mand zit vast tussen de palen. Leen een hengel van Joris en haal hem vanaf de steiger rustig naar je toe.")])
				return
			GameState.start_quest("ls_supper")
			pulling=true
			progress=0
			origin=world.player.position
			health=GameState.hp
			GameState.toast.emit(tr("De lijn zit vast. Blijf even staan om de mand binnen te halen."))
		"net":
			if GameState.flag("ls_net"):
				GameState.say(label(),[tr("Het net is weer heel. Joris kan zijn vangst nu veilig bewaren.")])
			else:
				Supper.pending=weakref(self)
				GameState.start_dialogue("ls_net")
		"stove":
			var ui:=world.get_node_or_null("SupperKitchen")
			if ui==null:
				ui=load("res://scripts/ui/supper_kitchen.gd").new()
				ui.name="SupperKitchen"
				world.add_child(ui)
			ui.open(self)
		"table":
			if GameState.flag("ls_served"):
				GameState.say(label(),[tr("De tafel blijft gedekt. Jouw gerecht staat op Mila's kaart. Met verse baars kun je bij het fornuis opnieuw koken; de recepten staan ook bij Beroepen.")])
			elif not GameState.flag("ls_cooked") or GameState.count("ls_chowder")+GameState.count("ls_broth")==0:
				GameState.start_quest("ls_supper")
				GameState.say(label(),[tr("Hier komt iedereen samen zodra het eten klaar is. Bereid een portie bij het fornuis links van de eetkamer. De maaltijd kan op elk moment beginnen.")])
			else:
				Supper.pending=weakref(self)
				GameState.start_dialogue("ls_share")

func weave(side: String) -> void:
	if GameState.flag("ls_net"): return
	if side != ["over","under","over"][stitch]:
		stitch=0
		GameState.toast.emit(tr("De draad schiet los. Volg opnieuw: boven, onder, boven."))
		return
	stitch+=1
	Sound.play("ls_chop",-12)
	if stitch==3:
		GameState.set_flag("ls_net")
		GameState.give("meer_baars",2,true)
		GameState.give("prof_herb",1,true)
		Supper.Professions.add_xp("fishing",8)
		GameState.save_requested.emit()

func share(dish: String) -> void:
	if GameState.flag("ls_served") or not GameState.flag("ls_cooked") or dish not in Supper.DISHES or GameState.count(dish)<1: return
	GameState.set_flag("ls_served") # commit before inventory/quest signals
	GameState.set_flag("ls_favorite_broth",dish=="ls_broth")
	GameState.take(dish,1)
	GameState.start_quest("ls_supper")
	GameState.finish_quest("ls_supper")
	Sound.play("ls_serve",-6)
	GameState.toast.emit(tr("Er is een plek voor iedereen. Praat met de gasten; beide recepten zijn nu blijvend beschikbaar."))
	GameState.save_requested.emit()

functions.name: refresh
functions.source:
func refresh() -> void:
	if is_queued_for_deletion(): return
	# Existing flags may change while this map stays open.
	for role: String in Memory.PLACES:
		var spec: Dictionary = Memory.PLACES[role]
		if spec.map != GameState.map_id: continue
		if Memory.enabled(role) and not actors.has(role):
			build_grid()
			var actor := Actor.new()
			actor.world = world; actor.director = self; actor.role = role
			actor.rest = Memory.resting(world.map_data.get("weather",""))
			var at: Array = actor.route()[0]
			actor.position = safe_spawn(Vector2i(at[0],at[1]))
			world.entities.add_child(actor)
			actors[role] = actor
		elif not Memory.enabled(role) and actors.has(role):
			actors[role].queue_free(); actors.erase(role)
