func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if get_tree().paused:
		root.modulate.a=0 # hide immediately, but keep the timer and queue untouched
		return
	if time>0 and _screen_is_busy():root.modulate.a=0;return
	if time <= 0.0:
		root.modulate.a = 0.0
		if GameState.achievement_queue.is_empty() or _screen_is_busy():
			return
		duration = SHOW_TIME if GameState.achievement_queue.size() <= 2 else SHOW_TIME_RUSH
		shown_id = GameState.achievement_queue.pop_front()
		name_label.text = tr(Achievements.info(shown_id)["name"])
		time = duration
		Sound.play("wereld_prestatie", -3.0)
		if not hinted:
			hinted = true
			GameState.toast.emit(hint_text())
	time -= delta
	var shown := minf(duration - time, time) / SLIDE_TIME
	root.modulate.a = clampf(shown * 1.5, 0.0, 1.0)
	var view:=get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	root.position.x=(view.x-PANEL_SIZE.x)*0.5
	var world:=get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("world")
	if world!=null:
		# A side entrance keeps the centre/player and the right-hand goals clear.
		# Leave the bottom strip for ordinary toasts.
		root.position.y=maxf(TOP,view.y-PANEL_SIZE.y-140)
		root.position.x=lerpf(-PANEL_SIZE.x,20,ease(clampf(shown,0,1),0.4))
	else:
		root.position.y = lerpf(-PANEL_SIZE.y, TOP, ease(clampf(shown, 0.0, 1.0), 0.4))

## en haalt ze pas uit de rij als hij ze echt toont. Zo gaat er niets verloren als er even geen beeld is (bijvoorbeeld
## tijdens het zwart worden bij het einde): de volgende melding in een volgend scherm toont ze alsnog.
## Bij de eerste melding vertellen we ook waar je al je prestaties en het beestenboek vindt.

func _process(delta: float):
	if not active:return
	if not valid_source(not crossing):close();return
	elapsed+=delta
	if crossing:
		if GameState.count("td_line")<1:
			close();return
		world.player.position=start.lerp(landing,clampf(elapsed/1.1,0,1))+Vector2(0,sin(clampf(elapsed/1.1,0,1)*PI)*2)
		world.player.queue_redraw()
		if elapsed>=1.1:
			# A moving resident or restored prop can occupy the landing meanwhile.
			if not world.spawn_fits(landing):close();return
			world.player.position=landing;world.player.velocity=Vector2.ZERO;world.player.knockback=Vector2.ZERO
			world.player.camera.reset_smoothing();world.player.invuln=maxf(world.player.invuln,1.25)
			crossing=false;close();GameState.save_requested.emit()
		return
	if sailing:steer(delta)
	layout();preview.queue_redraw()

func depart():
	if committing or not active:return
	if not valid_source():close();return
	var maps: Script=load("res://scripts/maps/registry.gd")
	if not maps.MAPS.has(target) or not maps.get_map(target).spawns.has(spawn):close();return
	committing=true;active=false;root.hide();GameState.set_ui("ce_voyage",false)
	Sound.play("ce_water",-15.0)
	world.travel(target,spawn,"")

func _process(delta: float):
 if not active:return
 if not valid_source():close();return
 if repairing:
  if Input.get_vector("move_left","move_right","move_up","move_down").length()>0.2:close();return
  elapsed+=delta;progress.value=elapsed
  world.player.work_elapsed=elapsed;world.player.queue_redraw()
  if elapsed>=1.8:
   repairing=false;world.player.cancel_work_animation();Adventure.finish("ad_wheel");Sound.play("ad_water",-7)
   var position: Vector2=world.player.position
   close();world.load_map("tidal_hollow","start",position);GameState.save_requested.emit();return
 layout()

func _build() -> void:
	controls_root = Control.new()
	controls_root.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	add_child(controls_root)
	var dim := ColorRect.new()
	dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.86)
	controls_root.add_child(dim)
	panel = PanelContainer.new()
	panel.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(920, 600)
	UiStyle.style_panel(panel)
	controls_root.add_child(panel)
	var box := VBoxContainer.new()
	box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	panel.add_child(box)
	title_label = UiStyle.make_label("", 32, Color(0.65, 0.9, 1))
	box.add_child(title_label)
	var tabs := HBoxContainer.new()
	tabs.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	box.add_child(tabs)
	keyboard_button = _button(tabs, "", func() -> void: _select_device("keyboard"))
	controller_button = _button(tabs, "", func() -> void: _select_device("controller"))
	help_label = UiStyle.make_label("", 18)
	box.add_child(help_label)
	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(860, 280)
	scroll.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	scroll.follow_focus = true
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	box.add_child(scroll)
	list = VBoxContainer.new()
	list.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	list.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 5)
	scroll.add_child(list)
	for action: String in Controls.ACTION_NAMES:
		var row := HBoxContainer.new()
		row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 16)
		list.add_child(row)
		var label := UiStyle.make_label("", 21)
		label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
		label.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(260, 40)
		label.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
		row.add_child(label)
		action_labels[action] = label
		var button := _button(row, "", func() -> void: _begin_capture(action))
		button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		button.custom_minimum_size.y = 42
		button.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
		binding_buttons[action] = button
	status = UiStyle.make_label("", 18, Color(1, 0.88, 0.5))
	status.custom_minimum_size.y = 48
	status.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	box.add_child(status)
	var footer := HBoxContainer.new()
	footer.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	box.add_child(footer)
	reset_button = _button(footer, "", func() -> void:
		Controls.reset_bindings(device)
		status.text = tr("Standaardbediening hersteld voor dit apparaat."))
	close_button = _button(footer, "", _close)
	_refresh()

functions.name: _button
functions.source:
func _button(parent: Node, text: String, callback: Callable) -> Button:
	var button := Button.new()
	UiStyle.style_button(button, 21)
	button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(300, 44)
	button.text = text
	button.pressed.connect(callback)
	parent.add_child(button)
	return button

func _refresh() -> void:
	title_label.text = tr("Bediening")
	help_label.text = tr("Klik een koppeling en druk de nieuwe invoer. Bestaande koppelingen wisselen om.")
	reset_button.text = tr("Standaard herstellen")
	close_button.text = tr("Terug")
	keyboard_button.text = ("● " if device == "keyboard" else "") + tr("Toetsenbord + muis")
	controller_button.text = ("● " if device == "controller" else "") + tr("Controller")
	for action: String in binding_buttons:
		action_labels[action].text = tr(Controls.ACTION_NAMES[action])
		binding_buttons[action].text = Controls.binding_label(action, device)

extends CanvasLayer
## Bereikbaar vanaf titel en pauze; toetsen en controller worden apart bewaard.

signal closed

const UiStyle := preload("res://scripts/core/ui_style.gd")

var device := "keyboard"
var capture_action := ""
var capture_time := 0.0
var status: Label
var list: VBoxContainer
var keyboard_button: Button
var controller_button: Button
var close_button: Button
var binding_buttons: Dictionary = {}
var controls_root: Control
var panel: PanelContainer
var title_label: Label
var help_label: Label
var reset_button: Button
var action_labels: Dictionary = {}


func _ready() -> void:
	layer = 60
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	device = "controller" if Controls.controller_active else "keyboard"
	GameState.set_ui("controls", true)
	_build()
	Controls.bindings_changed.connect(_refresh)
	Controls.device_changed.connect(_device_changed)
	Lang.changed.connect(func(_locale: String) -> void: _refresh())
	(keyboard_button if device == "keyboard" else controller_button).grab_focus()


func _exit_tree() -> void:
	Controls.capture_active = false
	GameState.set_ui("controls", false)


func _build() -> void:
	controls_root = Control.new()
	controls_root.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	add_child(controls_root)
	var dim := ColorRect.new()
	dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.86)
	controls_root.add_child(dim)
	panel = PanelContainer.new()
	panel.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(920, 600)
	UiStyle.style_panel(panel)
	controls_root.add_child(panel)
	var box := VBoxContainer.new()
	box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	panel.add_child(box)
	title_label = UiStyle.make_label("", 32, Color(0.65, 0.9, 1))
	box.add_child(title_label)
	var tabs := HBoxContainer.new()
	tabs.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	box.add_child(tabs)
	keyboard_button = _button(tabs, "", func() -> void: _select_device("keyboard"))
	controller_button = _button(tabs, "", func() -> void: _select_device("controller"))
	help_label = UiStyle.make_label("", 18)
	box.add_child(help_label)
	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(860, 280)
	scroll.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	scroll.follow_focus = true
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	box.add_child(scroll)
	list = VBoxContainer.new()
	list.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	list.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 5)
	scroll.add_child(list)
	for action: String in Controls.ACTION_NAMES:
		var row := HBoxContainer.new()
		row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 16)
		list.add_child(row)
		var label := UiStyle.make_label("", 21)
		label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
		label.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(260, 40)
		label.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
		row.add_child(label)
		action_labels[action] = label
		var button := _button(row, "", func() -> void: _begin_capture(action))
		button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		button.custom_minimum_size.y = 42
		button.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
		binding_buttons[action] = button
	status = UiStyle.make_label("", 18, Color(1, 0.88, 0.5))
	status.custom_minimum_size.y = 48
	status.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	box.add_child(status)
	var footer := HBoxContainer.new()
	footer.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	box.add_child(footer)
	reset_button = _button(footer, "", func() -> void:
		Controls.reset_bindings(device)
		status.text = tr("Standaardbediening hersteld voor dit apparaat."))
	close_button = _button(footer, "", _close)
	_refresh()


func _button(parent: Node, text: String, callback: Callable) -> Button:
	var button := Button.new()
	UiStyle.style_button(button, 21)
	button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(300, 44)
	button.text = text
	button.pressed.connect(callback)
	parent.add_child(button)
	return button


func _select_device(next_device: String) -> void:
	device = next_device
	_refresh()


func _refresh() -> void:
	title_label.text = tr("Bediening")
	help_label.text = tr("Klik een koppeling en druk de nieuwe invoer. Bestaande koppelingen wisselen om.")
	reset_button.text = tr("Standaard herstellen")
	close_button.text = tr("Terug")
	keyboard_button.text = ("● " if device == "keyboard" else "") + tr("Toetsenbord + muis")
	controller_button.text = ("● " if device == "controller" else "") + tr("Controller")
	for action: String in binding_buttons:
		action_labels[action].text = tr(Controls.ACTION_NAMES[action])
		binding_buttons[action].text = Controls.binding_label(action, device)
		binding_buttons[action].tooltip_text = Controls.binding_label(action, device)
	status.text = tr("Menu: WASD / pijlen / linkerstick / D-pad · Enter / A kiezen · Esc / B terug\nRichten: muis / rechterstick · Actief apparaat wisselt automatisch.")
	if not capture_action.is_empty():
		_capture_prompt()


func _device_changed(_using_controller: bool) -> void:
	if not capture_action.is_empty():
		return
	if get_viewport().gui_get_focus_owner() == null:
		close_button.grab_focus()


func _begin_capture(action: String) -> void:
	capture_action = action
	capture_time = 8.0
	Controls.capture_active = true
	_capture_prompt()


func _capture_prompt() -> void:
	status.text = tr("Nieuwe invoer voor %s (%s). Esc of 8 seconden wachten annuleert.") % [tr(Controls.ACTION_NAMES[capture_action]), tr("controller") if device == "controller" else tr("toetsenbord / muis")]
	binding_buttons[capture_action].text = tr("Druk de gewenste invoer…")


func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not capture_action.is_empty():
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and (event.physical_keycode == KEY_ESCAPE or event.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE):
			_end_capture(tr("Wijzigen geannuleerd."))
			return
		if event is InputEventMouseMotion or not event.is_pressed() or (event is InputEventKey and event.echo):
			return
		var controller_event := event is InputEventJoypadButton or event is InputEventJoypadMotion
		if controller_event != (device == "controller"):
			return
		if event is InputEventJoypadMotion and absf(event.axis_value) < 0.6:
			return
		var error := Controls.rebind(capture_action, device, event)
		if error.is_empty():
			_end_capture(tr("Bediening opgeslagen. Een bezette koppeling is automatisch omgewisseld."))
		else:
			status.text = error + "  " + tr("Esc of wachten annuleert.")
		return
	if not Controls.allows_event(event):
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		return
	if event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel") or (event.is_action_pressed("pause") and not Controls.is_ui_navigation_event(event)):
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		_close()
	elif event.is_action_pressed("ui_prev_tab") or event.is_action_pressed("ui_next_tab"):
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		_select_device("controller" if device == "keyboard" else "keyboard")
		(keyboard_button if device == "keyboard" else controller_button).grab_focus()


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	_layout()
	if capture_action.is_empty():
		return
	capture_time -= delta
	if capture_time <= 0.0:
		_end_capture(tr("Geen nieuwe invoer ontvangen; je koppeling is behouden."))


func _end_capture(message: String) -> void:
	var button: Button = binding_buttons[capture_action]
	capture_action = ""
	Controls.capture_active = false
	_refresh()
	status.text = message
	button.grab_focus()


func _close() -> void:
	Controls.capture_active = false
	GameState.set_ui("controls", false)
	closed.emit()
	queue_free()


func _layout() -> void:
	var wanted := panel.get_combined_minimum_size()
	var viewport := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	var factor := minf(1.0, minf((viewport.x - 32) / wanted.x, (viewport.y - 32) / wanted.y))
	panel.size = wanted
	panel.scale = Vector2.ONE * factor
	panel.position = (viewport - wanted * factor) * 0.5

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if not active:
		return
	garden_button.text=tr("Tuinstanden")+" ["+Controls.action_label("potion")+"]"
	hint.text = tr("↑ ↓ ← → kiezen  ·  %s bevestigen  ·  %s / %s recepten/voorraad  ·  %s sluiten") % [Controls.action_label("ui_accept"), Controls.action_label("ui_prev_tab"), Controls.action_label("ui_next_tab"), Controls.action_label("ui_cancel")]
	intro_label.text = Identity.intro(selected_skill) if selected_skill!="" and not supplies else tr("Verzamel met %s. Vindplaatsen staan bij het recept; stel een materiaaldoel in. Gereedschap slijt niet.") % Controls.action_label("interact")
	# Font metrics, translations and window sizes can differ. Fit the complete
	# panel before centering so the footer and every control stay on-screen.
	panel.size = panel.get_combined_minimum_size()
	var view: Vector2 = root.size
	var factor := minf(1.0, minf((view.x - 24.0) / panel.size.x, (view.y - 24.0) / panel.size.y))
	panel.scale = Vector2.ONE * maxf(factor, 0.1)
	panel.position = (view - panel.size * panel.scale) * 0.5

func open(recipe_id: String = "") -> void:
	if active or GameState.input_locked():
		return
	if Data.RECIPES.has(recipe_id):
		selected_entry=recipe_id;selected_skill=Data.RECIPES[recipe_id].skill;supplies=false;filter.select(Data.SKILLS.keys().find(selected_skill)+1)
	elif Journal.goal() != "":
		selected_entry = Journal.goal()
		selected_skill = Data.RECIPES[selected_entry].skill
		supplies = false
		filter.select(Data.SKILLS.keys().find(selected_skill)+1)
	active = true
	opened_frame = Engine.get_process_frames()
	root.show()
	GameState.set_ui("crafting", true)
	_populate()

func _populate() -> void:
	_population_version += 1
	filter.select(Data.SKILLS.keys().find(selected_skill)+1)
	Identity.style_panel(panel,"cooking" if supplies else selected_skill)
	title_label.text=tr("Proviand · eten en drinken") if supplies else Identity.title(selected_skill)
	title_label.modulate=Identity.accent("cooking" if supplies else selected_skill).lightened(.15)
	recipes_button.text=Identity.tab(selected_skill)
	profession_banner.queue_redraw()
	scroll.scroll_vertical = 0
	_clear(skill_list)
	_clear(rows)
	detail.text = ""
	for skill: String in Data.SKILLS:
		var lv := Professions.level(skill)
		var button := _button(tr(Data.TEXT["skill_line"]) % [tr(Data.SKILLS[skill]["name"]), lv])
		_compact(button)
		Identity.style_button(button,skill)
		button.custom_minimum_size.y = 34
		button.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
		button.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
			supplies = false
			selected_skill = skill
			filter.select(Data.SKILLS.keys().find(skill) + 1)
			_populate())
		var xp_text: String = tr(Data.TEXT["master"]) if lv == Professions.MAX_LEVEL else tr(Data.TEXT["xp"]) % [Professions.xp(skill) - Professions.threshold(lv), Professions.threshold(lv + 1) - Professions.threshold(lv)]
		button.focus_entered.connect(func() -> void: detail.text = tr(Data.SKILLS[skill]["desc"]) + "\n" + xp_text)
		skill_list.add_child(button)
		var progress := ProgressBar.new()
		progress.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 7)
		progress.show_percentage = false
		progress.add_theme_stylebox_override("fill",UiStyle.flat(Identity.accent(skill),Identity.accent(skill),0))
		progress.max_value = 1.0 if lv == Professions.MAX_LEVEL else float(Professions.threshold(lv + 1) - Professions.threshold(lv))
		progress.value = 1.0 if lv == Professions.MAX_LEVEL else float(Professions.xp(skill) - Professions.threshold(lv))
		progress.tooltip_text = tr(Data.TEXT["master"]) if lv == Professions.MAX_LEVEL else tr(Data.TEXT["xp"]) % [int(progress.value), int(progress.max_value)]
		skill_list.add_child(progress)
	filter.visible = not supplies
	recipes_button.modulate = Color.WHITE if not supplies else Color(0.65, 0.65, 0.65)
	supplies_button.modulate = Color.WHITE if supplies else Color(0.65, 0.65, 0.65)
	var focus: Button = null
	if supplies:
		for item: String in Professions.CONSUMABLES:
			if GameState.count(item) <= 0:
				continue
			var button := _button(tr(Data.TEXT["use"]) % [Professions.item_name(item), GameState.count(item)])
			button.icon = Items.icon_tex(item)
			button.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
			button.pressed.connect(_use.bind(item))
			button.focus_entered.connect(func() -> void:
				selected_entry = item
				detail.text = tr(Items.info(item)["desc"]) + "\n" + Professions.use_reason(item))
			button.focus_entered.connect(_scroll_to_entry.bind(button))
			rows.add_child(button)
			if focus == null or selected_entry == item:
				focus = button
		if focus == null:
			rows.add_child(_wrapped(tr(Data.TEXT["none"]), 20))
	else:
		if selected_skill != "":
			rows.add_child(_wrapped(tr(Data.SKILLS[selected_skill]["desc"]), 18))
			var lv := Professions.level(selected_skill)
			rows.add_child(_wrapped(tr(Data.TEXT["master"]) if lv == Professions.MAX_LEVEL else tr(Data.TEXT["xp"]) % [Professions.xp(selected_skill) - Professions.threshold(lv), Professions.threshold(lv + 1) - Professions.threshold(lv)], 17))
		if selected_skill=="fishing":
			for item: String in ["meer_baars","meer_snoek","meer_gouden_karper"]:
				var card:=_button(tr("%s · bij je: %d") % [Professions.item_name(item),GameState.count(item)])
				card.icon=Items.icon_tex(item);card.alignment=HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT;card.custom_minimum_size.y=64
				card.focus_entered.connect(func() -> void:
					selected_entry=item;detail.text=tr(Items.info(item).desc);_refresh_goal_button())
				card.pressed.connect(func() -> void:detail.grab_focus())
				card.focus_entered.connect(_scroll_to_entry.bind(card))
				rows.add_child(card)
				if focus==null or selected_entry==item:focus=card
		for recipe_id: String in Data.RECIPES:
			var recipe: Dictionary = Data.RECIPES[recipe_id]
			if selected_skill != "" and recipe["skill"] != selected_skill:
				continue
			var button := _recipe_button(recipe_id)
			rows.add_child(button)
			if focus == null or selected_entry == recipe_id:
				focus = button
	_link_focus()
	_refresh_goal_button()
	if focus:
		_focus_after_layout.call_deferred(focus, _population_version)
	else:
		UiStyle.focus_if_visible.call_deferred(recipes_button)

func _focus_after_layout(button: Button, version: int) -> void:
	# Containers need to lay out replacement rows before follow_focus can find
	# their real bounds. A generation guard ignores an older filter/craft refresh.
	await get_tree().process_frame
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not active or version != _population_version or not is_instance_valid(button) or not button.is_inside_tree() or not button.is_visible_in_tree():
		return
	button.grab_focus()
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not is_instance_valid(button) or version != _population_version: return
	_scroll_to_entry(button)

func _recipe_button(recipe_id: String) -> Button:
	var recipe: Dictionary = Data.RECIPES[recipe_id]
	var ingredients: Array[String] = []
	for item: String in recipe["inputs"]:
		ingredients.append("%s %d/%d" % [Professions.item_name(item), Stock.available(item), int(recipe["inputs"][item])])
	var reason := Professions.craft_reason(recipe_id)
	var title: String = tr(Data.TEXT["recipe_line"]) % [Professions.item_name(recipe["output"]), int(recipe.get("amount", 1)), tr(Data.SKILLS[recipe["skill"]]["name"]), recipe["level"]]
	var ready := 0
	for item: String in recipe.inputs:
		if Stock.available(item) >= int(recipe.inputs[item]): ready += 1
	var button := _button(title + "\n" + tr("Materialen compleet: %d/%d") % [ready,recipe.inputs.size()] + "\n" + (tr(Data.TEXT["ready"]) if reason == "" else reason))
	button.custom_minimum_size.y = 90
	button.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
	button.icon = Items.icon_tex(recipe["output"])
	button.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
	button.modulate = Color.WHITE if reason == "" else Color(0.7, 0.75, 0.82)
	button.pressed.connect(_craft.bind(recipe_id))
	button.focus_entered.connect(func() -> void:
		selected_entry = recipe_id
		profession_banner.queue_redraw()
		detail.text = Journal.recipe_text(recipe_id)
		detail.get_v_scroll_bar().value = 0
		_refresh_goal_button())
	button.focus_entered.connect(_scroll_to_entry.bind(button))
	return button

func _link_focus() -> void:
	var skills: Array[Control] = []
	var entries: Array[Control] = []
	for child: Node in skill_list.get_children():
		if child is Button:
			skills.append(child)
	for child: Node in rows.get_children():
		if child is Button:
			entries.append(child)
	UiStyle.link_vertical(skills, false)
	UiStyle.link_vertical(entries, false)
	var header: Array[Control] = [recipes_button, supplies_button]
	if filter.visible:
		header.append(filter)
	header.append(close_button)
	var entry: Control = entries[0] if not entries.is_empty() else recipes_button
	for i in header.size():
		var button := header[i]
		button.focus_neighbor_left = button.get_path_to(header[posmod(i - 1, header.size())])
		button.focus_neighbor_right = button.get_path_to(header[(i + 1) % header.size()])
		button.focus_neighbor_bottom = button.get_path_to(entry)
		button.focus_neighbor_top = button.get_path_to(entry)
	for button: Control in skills:
		button.focus_neighbor_left = button.get_path_to(button)
		button.focus_neighbor_right = button.get_path_to(entry)
	for button: Control in entries:
		var skill_index := maxi(Data.SKILLS.keys().find(selected_skill), 0)
		button.focus_neighbor_left = button.get_path_to(skills[skill_index])
		button.focus_neighbor_right = button.get_path_to(detail)
	if not entries.is_empty():
		entries[0].focus_neighbor_top = entries[0].get_path_to(recipes_button)
		entries[-1].focus_neighbor_bottom = entries[-1].get_path_to(detail)
	if not skills.is_empty():
		skills[0].focus_neighbor_top = skills[0].get_path_to(recipes_button)
		skills[-1].focus_neighbor_bottom = skills[-1].get_path_to(close_button)
	# Tab/Shift+Tab traverses the complete menu in a predictable order.
	detail.focus_neighbor_bottom = detail.get_path_to(goal_button)
	detail.focus_neighbor_top = detail.get_path_to(entry)
	detail.focus_neighbor_left = detail.get_path_to(entry)
	detail.focus_neighbor_right = detail.get_path_to(goal_button)
	goal_button.focus_neighbor_top = goal_button.get_path_to(detail)
	goal_button.focus_neighbor_bottom = goal_button.get_path_to(close_button)
	var cycle: Array[Control] = header + skills + entries
	cycle.append(detail)
	cycle.append(goal_button)
	cycle.append(garden_button)
	goal_button.focus_neighbor_right=goal_button.get_path_to(garden_button)
	garden_button.focus_neighbor_left=garden_button.get_path_to(goal_button)
	garden_button.focus_neighbor_top=garden_button.get_path_to(detail)
	garden_button.focus_neighbor_bottom=garden_button.get_path_to(close_button)
	for i in cycle.size():
		cycle[i].focus_next = cycle[i].get_path_to(cycle[(i + 1) % cycle.size()])
		cycle[i].focus_previous = cycle[i].get_path_to(cycle[posmod(i - 1, cycle.size())])

extends CanvasLayer
## C opens a keyboard/controller-accessible profession journal and crafting menu.

const Identity:=preload("res://scripts/core/craft_identity.gd")
const Stock:=preload("res://scripts/core/stockroom.gd")
const Data := preload("res://scripts/data/ext/beroepen.gd")
const Professions := preload("res://scripts/core/professions.gd")
const Items := preload("res://scripts/data/items.gd")
const UiStyle := preload("res://scripts/core/ui_style.gd")
const Journal := preload("res://scripts/core/craft_journal.gd")

var root: Control
var panel: PanelContainer
var scroll: ScrollContainer
var skill_list: VBoxContainer
var rows: VBoxContainer
var detail: RichTextLabel
var garden_button: Button
var goal_button: Button
var filter: OptionButton
var recipes_button: Button
var supplies_button: Button
var close_button: Button
var hint: Label
var title_label: Label
var intro_label: Label
var active := false
var opened_frame := -1
var supplies := false
var selected_skill := ""
var selected_entry := ""
var _population_version := 0
var profession_banner: Control


func _ready() -> void:
	layer = 12
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	_build_ui()
	root.hide()
	Lang.changed.connect(_refresh_language)


func _build_ui() -> void:
	root = Control.new()
	root.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	add_child(root)
	var dim := ColorRect.new()
	dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.72)
	root.add_child(dim)
	panel = PanelContainer.new()
	UiStyle.style_panel(panel)
	panel.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(1050, 580)
	root.add_child(panel)
	var box := VBoxContainer.new()
	box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	panel.add_child(box)
	title_label = UiStyle.make_label(tr(Data.TEXT["title"]), 30, Color(0.73, 0.91, 0.67))
	box.add_child(title_label)
	intro_label = _wrapped("", 17)
	intro_label.custom_minimum_size.x = 985
	box.add_child(intro_label)
	var content := HBoxContainer.new()
	content.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 16)
	box.add_child(content)
	skill_list = VBoxContainer.new()
	skill_list.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(245, 0)
	skill_list.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 3)
	content.add_child(skill_list)
	var right := VBoxContainer.new()
	right.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(740, 0)
	content.add_child(right)
	profession_banner=Control.new()
	profession_banner.custom_minimum_size=Vector2(740,64)
	profession_banner.mouse_filter=Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	profession_banner.draw.connect(_draw_identity)
	right.add_child(profession_banner)
	var nav := HBoxContainer.new()
	right.add_child(nav)
	recipes_button = _button(tr(Data.TEXT["recipes"]))
	recipes_button.pressed.connect(func() -> void: supplies = false; _populate())
	nav.add_child(recipes_button)
	supplies_button = _button(tr(Data.TEXT["supplies"]))
	supplies_button.pressed.connect(func() -> void: supplies = true; _populate())
	nav.add_child(supplies_button)
	filter = OptionButton.new()
	UiStyle.style_button(filter, 18)
	filter.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(180, 38)
	filter.add_item(tr(Data.TEXT["skills"]))
	for skill: String in Data.SKILLS:
		filter.add_item(tr(Data.SKILLS[skill]["name"]))
	filter.item_selected.connect(func(index: int) -> void:
		selected_skill = "" if index == 0 else str(Data.SKILLS.keys()[index - 1])
		_populate())
	nav.add_child(filter)
	close_button = _button(tr("Sluiten"))
	close_button.custom_minimum_size.x = 100
	close_button.pressed.connect(close)
	nav.add_child(close_button)
	scroll = ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(740, 240)
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	# Scroll in local coordinates: native follow_focus overshoots inside a scaled panel.
	scroll.follow_focus = false
	right.add_child(scroll)
	rows = VBoxContainer.new()
	rows.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	rows.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	scroll.add_child(rows)
	detail = RichTextLabel.new()
	detail.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0,100)
	detail.add_theme_font_size_override("normal_font_size",16)
	detail.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_ALL
	detail.scroll_active = true
	detail.gui_input.connect(_detail_input)
	box.add_child(detail)
	goal_button = _button("")
	_compact(goal_button)
	goal_button.custom_minimum_size.y = 32
	goal_button.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
		Journal.toggle_goal(selected_entry)
		_refresh_goal_button())
	var footer:=HBoxContainer.new()
	box.add_child(footer)
	goal_button.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	footer.add_child(goal_button)
	garden_button=_button(tr("Tuinstanden"))
	_compact(garden_button)
	garden_button.custom_minimum_size=Vector2(230,32)
	garden_button.pressed.connect(_open_garden)
	footer.add_child(garden_button)
	hint = UiStyle.make_label("", 16, Color(0.72, 0.77, 0.85))
	box.add_child(hint)


func _button(text: String) -> Button:
	var button := Button.new()
	UiStyle.style_button(button, 18)
	Identity.style_button(button,selected_skill)
	button.text = text
	button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(160, 38)
	return button


func _wrapped(text: String, font_size: int) -> Label:
	var label := Label.new()
	label.text = text
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	return label

func _compact(button: Button) -> void:
	button.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size",16)
	for state in ["normal","hover","pressed","focus","disabled"]:
		var style: StyleBox = button.get_theme_stylebox(state).duplicate()
		style.content_margin_top = 4
		style.content_margin_bottom = 4
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override(state,style)


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if not active:
		return
	garden_button.text=tr("Tuinstanden")+" ["+Controls.action_label("potion")+"]"
	hint.text = tr("↑ ↓ ← → kiezen  ·  %s bevestigen  ·  %s / %s recepten/voorraad  ·  %s sluiten") % [Controls.action_label("ui_accept"), Controls.action_label("ui_prev_tab"), Controls.action_label("ui_next_tab"), Controls.action_label("ui_cancel")]
	intro_label.text = Identity.intro(selected_skill) if selected_skill!="" and not supplies else tr("Verzamel met %s. Vindplaatsen staan bij het recept; stel een materiaaldoel in. Gereedschap slijt niet.") % Controls.action_label("interact")
	# Font metrics, translations and window sizes can differ. Fit the complete
	# panel before centering so the footer and every control stay on-screen.
	panel.size = panel.get_combined_minimum_size()
	var view: Vector2 = root.size
	var factor := minf(1.0, minf((view.x - 24.0) / panel.size.x, (view.y - 24.0) / panel.size.y))
	panel.scale = Vector2.ONE * maxf(factor, 0.1)
	panel.position = (view - panel.size * panel.scale) * 0.5


func open(recipe_id: String = "") -> void:
	if active or GameState.input_locked():
		return
	if Data.RECIPES.has(recipe_id):
		selected_entry=recipe_id;selected_skill=Data.RECIPES[recipe_id].skill;supplies=false;filter.select(Data.SKILLS.keys().find(selected_skill)+1)
	elif Journal.goal() != "":
		selected_entry = Journal.goal()
		selected_skill = Data.RECIPES[selected_entry].skill
		supplies = false
		filter.select(Data.SKILLS.keys().find(selected_skill)+1)
	active = true
	opened_frame = Engine.get_process_frames()
	root.show()
	GameState.set_ui("crafting", true)
	_populate()


func close() -> void:
	active = false
	root.hide()
	GameState.set_ui("crafting", false)


func _clear(container: Node) -> void:
	for child: Node in container.get_children():
		container.remove_child(child)
		child.queue_free()


func _populate() -> void:
	_population_version += 1
	filter.select(Data.SKILLS.keys().find(selected_skill)+1)
	Identity.style_panel(panel,"cooking" if supplies else selected_skill)
	title_label.text=tr("Proviand · eten en drinken") if supplies else Identity.title(selected_skill)
	title_label.modulate=Identity.accent("cooking" if supplies else selected_skill).lightened(.15)
	recipes_button.text=Identity.tab(selected_skill)
	profession_banner.queue_redraw()
	scroll.scroll_vertical = 0
	_clear(skill_list)
	_clear(rows)
	detail.text = ""
	for skill: String in Data.SKILLS:
		var lv := Professions.level(skill)
		var button := _button(tr(Data.TEXT["skill_line"]) % [tr(Data.SKILLS[skill]["name"]), lv])
		_compact(button)
		Identity.style_button(button,skill)
		button.custom_minimum_size.y = 34
		button.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
		button.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
			supplies = false
			selected_skill = skill
			filter.select(Data.SKILLS.keys().find(skill) + 1)
			_populate())
		var xp_text: String = tr(Data.TEXT["master"]) if lv == Professions.MAX_LEVEL else tr(Data.TEXT["xp"]) % [Professions.xp(skill) - Professions.threshold(lv), Professions.threshold(lv + 1) - Professions.threshold(lv)]
		button.focus_entered.connect(func() -> void: detail.text = tr(Data.SKILLS[skill]["desc"]) + "\n" + xp_text)
		skill_list.add_child(button)
		var progress := ProgressBar.new()
		progress.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 7)
		progress.show_percentage = false
		progress.add_theme_stylebox_override("fill",UiStyle.flat(Identity.accent(skill),Identity.accent(skill),0))
		progress.max_value = 1.0 if lv == Professions.MAX_LEVEL else float(Professions.threshold(lv + 1) - Professions.threshold(lv))
		progress.value = 1.0 if lv == Professions.MAX_LEVEL else float(Professions.xp(skill) - Professions.threshold(lv))
		progress.tooltip_text = tr(Data.TEXT["master"]) if lv == Professions.MAX_LEVEL else tr(Data.TEXT["xp"]) % [int(progress.value), int(progress.max_value)]
		skill_list.add_child(progress)
	filter.visible = not supplies
	recipes_button.modulate = Color.WHITE if not supplies else Color(0.65, 0.65, 0.65)
	supplies_button.modulate = Color.WHITE if supplies else Color(0.65, 0.65, 0.65)
	var focus: Button = null
	if supplies:
		for item: String in Professions.CONSUMABLES:
			if GameState.count(item) <= 0:
				continue
			var button := _button(tr(Data.TEXT["use"]) % [Professions.item_name(item), GameState.count(item)])
			button.icon = Items.icon_tex(item)
			button.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
			button.pressed.connect(_use.bind(item))
			button.focus_entered.connect(func() -> void:
				selected_entry = item
				detail.text = tr(Items.info(item)["desc"]) + "\n" + Professions.use_reason(item))
			button.focus_entered.connect(_scroll_to_entry.bind(button))
			rows.add_child(button)
			if focus == null or selected_entry == item:
				focus = button
		if focus == null:
			rows.add_child(_wrapped(tr(Data.TEXT["none"]), 20))
	else:
		if selected_skill != "":
			rows.add_child(_wrapped(tr(Data.SKILLS[selected_skill]["desc"]), 18))
			var lv := Professions.level(selected_skill)
			rows.add_child(_wrapped(tr(Data.TEXT["master"]) if lv == Professions.MAX_LEVEL else tr(Data.TEXT["xp"]) % [Professions.xp(selected_skill) - Professions.threshold(lv), Professions.threshold(lv + 1) - Professions.threshold(lv)], 17))
		if selected_skill=="fishing":
			for item: String in ["meer_baars","meer_snoek","meer_gouden_karper"]:
				var card:=_button(tr("%s · bij je: %d") % [Professions.item_name(item),GameState.count(item)])
				card.icon=Items.icon_tex(item);card.alignment=HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT;card.custom_minimum_size.y=64
				card.focus_entered.connect(func() -> void:
					selected_entry=item;detail.text=tr(Items.info(item).desc);_refresh_goal_button())
				card.pressed.connect(func() -> void:detail.grab_focus())
				card.focus_entered.connect(_scroll_to_entry.bind(card))
				rows.add_child(card)
				if focus==null or selected_entry==item:focus=card
		for recipe_id: String in Data.RECIPES:
			var recipe: Dictionary = Data.RECIPES[recipe_id]
			if selected_skill != "" and recipe["skill"] != selected_skill:
				continue
			var button := _recipe_button(recipe_id)
			rows.add_child(button)
			if focus == null or selected_entry == recipe_id:
				focus = button
	_link_focus()
	_refresh_goal_button()
	if focus:
		_focus_after_layout.call_deferred(focus, _population_version)
	else:
		UiStyle.focus_if_visible.call_deferred(recipes_button)


func _focus_after_layout(button: Button, version: int) -> void:
	# Containers need to lay out replacement rows before follow_focus can find
	# their real bounds. A generation guard ignores an older filter/craft refresh.
	await get_tree().process_frame
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not active or version != _population_version or not is_instance_valid(button) or not button.is_inside_tree() or not button.is_visible_in_tree():
		return
	button.grab_focus()
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not is_instance_valid(button) or version != _population_version: return
	_scroll_to_entry(button)

func _scroll_to_entry(button: Control) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(button) or button.get_parent() != rows: return
	var top := button.position.y
	var bottom := top + button.size.y
	if top < scroll.scroll_vertical: scroll.scroll_vertical = floori(top)
	elif bottom > scroll.scroll_vertical+scroll.size.y: scroll.scroll_vertical = ceili(bottom-scroll.size.y)+1


func _recipe_button(recipe_id: String) -> Button:
	var recipe: Dictionary = Data.RECIPES[recipe_id]
	var ingredients: Array[String] = []
	for item: String in recipe["inputs"]:
		ingredients.append("%s %d/%d" % [Professions.item_name(item), Stock.available(item), int(recipe["inputs"][item])])
	var reason := Professions.craft_reason(recipe_id)
	var title: String = tr(Data.TEXT["recipe_line"]) % [Professions.item_name(recipe["output"]), int(recipe.get("amount", 1)), tr(Data.SKILLS[recipe["skill"]]["name"]), recipe["level"]]
	var ready := 0
	for item: String in recipe.inputs:
		if Stock.available(item) >= int(recipe.inputs[item]): ready += 1
	var button := _button(title + "\n" + tr("Materialen compleet: %d/%d") % [ready,recipe.inputs.size()] + "\n" + (tr(Data.TEXT["ready"]) if reason == "" else reason))
	button.custom_minimum_size.y = 90
	button.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
	button.icon = Items.icon_tex(recipe["output"])
	button.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
	button.modulate = Color.WHITE if reason == "" else Color(0.7, 0.75, 0.82)
	button.pressed.connect(_craft.bind(recipe_id))
	button.focus_entered.connect(func() -> void:
		selected_entry = recipe_id
		profession_banner.queue_redraw()
		detail.text = Journal.recipe_text(recipe_id)
		detail.get_v_scroll_bar().value = 0
		_refresh_goal_button())
	button.focus_entered.connect(_scroll_to_entry.bind(button))
	return button


func _craft(recipe_id: String) -> void:
	if not active:
		return
	selected_entry = recipe_id
	var made := Professions.craft(recipe_id)
	Sound.play(("pg_forge" if Data.RECIPES[recipe_id].skill == "smithing" else "buy") if made else "error", -5.0)
	_populate()


func _use(item_id: String) -> void:
	if not active:
		return
	selected_entry = item_id
	Sound.play("drink" if Professions.use_item(item_id) else "error", -5.0)
	_populate()


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not Controls.allows_event(event):
		return
	if not active or Engine.get_process_frames() == opened_frame or event.is_echo():
		return
	if UiStyle.shortcut(event, "pause") or event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel") or UiStyle.shortcut(event, "crafting"):
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		close()
	elif UiStyle.shortcut(event,"potion"):
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		_open_garden()
	elif event.is_action_pressed("ui_prev_tab") or event.is_action_pressed("ui_next_tab"):
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		supplies = not supplies
		selected_entry = ""
		_populate()
	elif UiStyle.activate_focused(root, event):
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()


func _link_focus() -> void:
	var skills: Array[Control] = []
	var entries: Array[Control] = []
	for child: Node in skill_list.get_children():
		if child is Button:
			skills.append(child)
	for child: Node in rows.get_children():
		if child is Button:
			entries.append(child)
	UiStyle.link_vertical(skills, false)
	UiStyle.link_vertical(entries, false)
	var header: Array[Control] = [recipes_button, supplies_button]
	if filter.visible:
		header.append(filter)
	header.append(close_button)
	var entry: Control = entries[0] if not entries.is_empty() else recipes_button
	for i in header.size():
		var button := header[i]
		button.focus_neighbor_left = button.get_path_to(header[posmod(i - 1, header.size())])
		button.focus_neighbor_right = button.get_path_to(header[(i + 1) % header.size()])
		button.focus_neighbor_bottom = button.get_path_to(entry)
		button.focus_neighbor_top = button.get_path_to(entry)
	for button: Control in skills:
		button.focus_neighbor_left = button.get_path_to(button)
		button.focus_neighbor_right = button.get_path_to(entry)
	for button: Control in entries:
		var skill_index := maxi(Data.SKILLS.keys().find(selected_skill), 0)
		button.focus_neighbor_left = button.get_path_to(skills[skill_index])
		button.focus_neighbor_right = button.get_path_to(detail)
	if not entries.is_empty():
		entries[0].focus_neighbor_top = entries[0].get_path_to(recipes_button)
		entries[-1].focus_neighbor_bottom = entries[-1].get_path_to(detail)
	if not skills.is_empty():
		skills[0].focus_neighbor_top = skills[0].get_path_to(recipes_button)
		skills[-1].focus_neighbor_bottom = skills[-1].get_path_to(close_button)
	# Tab/Shift+Tab traverses the complete menu in a predictable order.
	detail.focus_neighbor_bottom = detail.get_path_to(goal_button)
	detail.focus_neighbor_top = detail.get_path_to(entry)
	detail.focus_neighbor_left = detail.get_path_to(entry)
	detail.focus_neighbor_right = detail.get_path_to(goal_button)
	goal_button.focus_neighbor_top = goal_button.get_path_to(detail)
	goal_button.focus_neighbor_bottom = goal_button.get_path_to(close_button)
	var cycle: Array[Control] = header + skills + entries
	cycle.append(detail)
	cycle.append(goal_button)
	cycle.append(garden_button)
	goal_button.focus_neighbor_right=goal_button.get_path_to(garden_button)
	garden_button.focus_neighbor_left=garden_button.get_path_to(goal_button)
	garden_button.focus_neighbor_top=garden_button.get_path_to(detail)
	garden_button.focus_neighbor_bottom=garden_button.get_path_to(close_button)
	for i in cycle.size():
		cycle[i].focus_next = cycle[i].get_path_to(cycle[(i + 1) % cycle.size()])
		cycle[i].focus_previous = cycle[i].get_path_to(cycle[posmod(i - 1, cycle.size())])

func _refresh_goal_button() -> void:
	goal_button.disabled = not Data.RECIPES.has(selected_entry) or supplies
	goal_button.text = tr("Materiaaldoel verwijderen") if Journal.goal() == selected_entry and selected_entry != "" else tr("Dit recept als materiaaldoel volgen")
	goal_button.tooltip_text = tr("Vindplaatsen staan in de uitleg. Rechts gaat naar de uitleg; omhoog/omlaag scrolt, rechts gaat naar Materiaaldoel.")

func _detail_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not Controls.allows_event(event) or event.is_echo(): return
	if event.is_action_pressed("ui_up") or event.is_action_pressed("ui_down"):
		detail.get_v_scroll_bar().value += -48 if event.is_action_pressed("ui_up") else 48
		detail.accept_event()

	if not active:return

	var ui: CanvasLayer=load("res://scripts/ui/home_ui.gd").new()

func _draw_identity():
	var id: String="cooking" if supplies else selected_skill
	var color:=Identity.accent(id)
	profession_banner.draw_style_box(UiStyle.flat(Color(color,.07),Color(color,.38),1),Rect2(Vector2.ZERO,profession_banner.size))
	if id=="":
		for i in Data.SKILLS.size():Identity.emblem(profession_banner,Data.SKILLS.keys()[i],Vector2(58+i*100,32),.7)
	else:
		Identity.emblem(profession_banner,id,Vector2(40,34),.75)
		var has_recipe: bool=Data.RECIPES.has(selected_entry) and not supplies and Data.RECIPES[selected_entry].skill==id
		var text_width: float=350 if has_recipe else 630
		var text: String=Identity.title(id)
		var font:=ThemeDB.fallback_font
		profession_banner.draw_string(font,Vector2(83,26),text,HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT,text_width,18,color.lightened(.2))
		var description: String=""
		if id in ["foraging","woodcutting","mining"]:
			var names: Array[String]=[]
			for key: String in Data.RESOURCES:
				if Data.RESOURCES[key].skill==id and names.size()<3:names.append(tr(Data.RESOURCES[key].name))
			description=" · ".join(names)
		elif id=="fishing":
			description=tr("Hengel: aanwezig") if GameState.count("fishing_rod")>0 else tr("Haal je hengel bij Joris aan het Zilvermeer.")
		elif id=="smithing":description=tr("Erts + brandstof → metaal en gereedschap")
		elif id=="alchemy":description=tr("Kruiden + ingrediënten → elixers en hulpmiddelen")
		else:description=tr("Ingrediënten → hartjes en uithoudingsvermogen")
		profession_banner.draw_string(font,Vector2(83,50),description,HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT,text_width,16,Color("dce4d7"))
		if has_recipe:
			var recipe: Dictionary=Data.RECIPES[selected_entry]
			var i:=0
			for item: String in recipe.inputs:
				if i>=3:break
				var at:=Vector2(470+i*38,10)
				profession_banner.draw_texture_rect(Items.icon_tex(item),Rect2(at,Vector2(28,28)),false)
				profession_banner.draw_string(font,at+Vector2(0,44),str(Stock.available(item))+"/"+str(recipe.inputs[item]),HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT,36,12,Color("dce4d7"))
				i+=1
			profession_banner.draw_line(Vector2(598,28),Vector2(624,28),color,2)
			profession_banner.draw_line(Vector2(624,28),Vector2(618,22),color,2)
			profession_banner.draw_line(Vector2(624,28),Vector2(618,34),color,2)
			profession_banner.draw_texture_rect(Items.icon_tex(recipe.output),Rect2(Vector2(654,10),Vector2(36,36)),false)

extends CanvasLayer
## Het dialoogvenster. Speelt gesprekken af uit scripts/data/dialogue.gd, inclusief keuzes,
## vertakkingen en acties. Het spel staat stil zolang het venster open is.
## Gesprekken staan in het Nederlands in de data: dit venster vertaalt spreker, regels en keuzes op het moment van
## tonen, en vult daarna pas de {tekens} in. Losse berichtjes (borden, GameState.say) zijn al vertaald.

const UiStyle := preload("res://scripts/core/ui_style.gd")
const Dialogue := preload("res://scripts/data/dialogue.gd")

var panel: PanelContainer
var speaker_label: Label
var text_label: Label
var hint_label: Label
var choices_box: VBoxContainer

var active := false
var node: Dictionary = {}
var lines: Array = []
var line_idx := 0
var opened_frame := -1
var shown_chars := 0.0
var buttons: Array[Button] = []
var from_data := true # het huidige stuk komt uit dialogue.gd (nog vertalen), of uit say() (al vertaald)


func _ready() -> void:
	layer = 11
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	_build_ui()
	panel.visible = false
	panel.gui_input.connect(_pointer_input)
	GameState.dialogue_requested.connect(start)
	GameState.text_dialogue_requested.connect(start_text)


func _build_ui() -> void:
	panel = PanelContainer.new()
	panel.anchor_left = 0.0
	panel.anchor_right = 1.0
	panel.anchor_top = 1.0
	panel.anchor_bottom = 1.0
	panel.grow_vertical = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BEGIN
	panel.offset_left = 60.0
	panel.offset_right = -60.0
	panel.offset_top = -190.0
	panel.offset_bottom = -26.0
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", UiStyle.flat(Color(0.06, 0.1, 0.22, 0.95), Color(0.45, 0.75, 1.0), 3))
	add_child(panel)

	var box := VBoxContainer.new()
	box.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
	box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	panel.add_child(box)
	speaker_label = Label.new()
	speaker_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	speaker_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.55, 0.85, 1.0))
	box.add_child(speaker_label)
	text_label = Label.new()
	text_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 24)
	text_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	text_label.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 76)
	box.add_child(text_label)
	choices_box = VBoxContainer.new()
	choices_box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
	box.add_child(choices_box)
	hint_label = Label.new()
	hint_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
	hint_label.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.6)
	hint_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	box.add_child(hint_label)


# --- Gesprek starten en afspelen --------------------------------------------------------------

func start(talk_id: String) -> void:
	if active:
		return
	_open()
	_enter(talk_id)


## Een los berichtje zonder gesprek in dialogue.gd (borden).
func start_text(speaker: String, new_lines: Array) -> void:
	if active:
		return
	_open()
	node = {"speaker": speaker, "lines": new_lines}
	from_data = false
	_begin_node()


func _open() -> void:
	active = true
	GameState.dialogue_open = true
	GameState.set_ui("dialogue", true)
	panel.visible = true
	# Dezelfde toetsdruk die het gesprek opende mag het niet meteen doorklikken.
	opened_frame = Engine.get_process_frames()
	Sound.play("select", -6.0)


func _enter(talk_id: String) -> void:
	node = Dialogue.get_talk(talk_id)
	from_data = true
	_begin_node()


## Tekst uit het gesprek in de taal van de speler (tekst uit say() is al vertaald).
func _text(source: String) -> String:
	return tr(source) if from_data and source != "" else source


func _begin_node() -> void:
	speaker_label.text = _text(node.get("speaker", ""))
	lines = node.get("lines", [])
	line_idx = 0
	_clear_choices()
	if lines.is_empty():
		_finish_node()
	else:
		_show_line()


func _show_line() -> void:
	text_label.text = GameState.fmt(_text(lines[line_idx]))
	text_label.visible_characters = 0
	shown_chars = 0.0
	hint_label.text = Controls.action_label("ui_accept") + ("  ▼" if line_idx < lines.size() - 1 else "  ✓")


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if active:
		hint_label.text = tr("↑ ↓ kiezen  ·  %s bevestigen  ·  %s sluiten") % [Controls.action_label("ui_accept"), Controls.action_label("ui_cancel")] if not buttons.is_empty() else tr("%s / klik  verder  ·  %s sluiten") % [Controls.action_label("ui_accept"), Controls.action_label("ui_cancel")]
	if active and text_label.visible_characters >= 0 and text_label.visible_characters < text_label.text.length():
		shown_chars += delta * 60.0
		text_label.visible_characters = int(shown_chars)


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not Controls.allows_event(event):
		return
	if not active or Engine.get_process_frames() == opened_frame or event.is_echo():
		return
	if UiStyle.shortcut(event, "pause") or event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		_close()
	elif not buttons.is_empty():
		if UiStyle.activate_focused(panel, event):
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
	elif UiStyle.confirm(event) or UiStyle.shortcut(event, "attack"):
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		_advance()


func _pointer_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not active or Controls.controller_active or Engine.get_process_frames() == opened_frame:
		return
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed:
		panel.accept_event()
		if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT:
			_close()
		elif event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and buttons.is_empty():
			_advance()

func _advance() -> void:
	if text_label.visible_characters >= 0 and text_label.visible_characters < text_label.text.length():
		text_label.visible_characters = -1 # alles in één keer tonen
		shown_chars = text_label.text.length()
		return
	Sound.play("select", -6.0)
	line_idx += 1
	if line_idx < lines.size():
		_show_line()
	else:
		_finish_node()


func _finish_node() -> void:
	if node.has("do"):
		GameState.run_all(node["do"])
	if node.has("choices"):
		_show_choices(node["choices"])
		return
	if node.has("branch"):
		for option: Dictionary in node["branch"]:
			if not option.has("if") or GameState.check_all(option["if"]):
				_enter(option["next"])
				return
	if node.has("next"):
		_enter(node["next"])
		return
	_close()


func _show_choices(choices: Array) -> void:
	_clear_choices()
	for choice: Dictionary in choices:
		if choice.has("if") and not GameState.check_all(choice["if"]):
			continue
		var button := Button.new()
		button.text = GameState.fmt(_text(choice["text"]))
		button.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
		UiStyle.style_button(button, 22)
		button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 40)
		button.pressed.connect(_choose.bind(choice))
		choices_box.add_child(button)
		buttons.append(button)
	hint_label.text = tr("↑ ↓ kiezen  ·  %s bevestigen") % Controls.action_label("ui_accept")
	if buttons.is_empty():
		_close()
	else:
		var controls: Array[Control] = []
		controls.assign(buttons)
		UiStyle.link_vertical(controls)
		buttons[0].grab_focus()


func _choose(choice: Dictionary) -> void:
	if not active:
		return
	Sound.play("select", -4.0)
	_clear_choices()
	if choice.has("do"):
		GameState.run_all(choice["do"])
	if choice.has("next"):
		_enter(choice["next"])
	else:
		_close()


func _clear_choices() -> void:
	for button in buttons:
		choices_box.remove_child(button)
		button.queue_free()
	buttons.clear()


func _close() -> void:
	_clear_choices()
	panel.visible = false
	active = false
	GameState.dialogue_open = false
	GameState.set_ui("dialogue", false)


func _exit_tree() -> void:
	if active:
		GameState.dialogue_open = false
		GameState.set_ui("dialogue", false)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	t += delta
	var current := pages[page]
	match current["type"]:
		"text":
			typed += delta * 40.0
		"map":
			var times := [0.8, 2.6, 4.4]
			for i in 3:
				if not lit[i] and t > times[i]:
					lit[i] = true
					Sound.play("crystal", -2.0)
			if t > 6.2 and t - delta <= 6.2:
				Sound.play("upgrade", -2.0)
		"credits":
			credits_scroll += delta * 55.0
			if credits_scroll > Credits.LINES.size() * 40.0 + H:
				_next_page()

func _draw() -> void:
	# Keep the original composition together at small and large window sizes.
	draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), Color(0.03, 0.05, 0.14))
	var factor := minf(size.x / W, size.y / H)
	draw_set_transform((size - Vector2(W, H) * factor) * 0.5, 0.0, Vector2.ONE * factor)
	draw_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(0, 0), Vector2(W, 0), Vector2(W, H), Vector2(0, H)]),
		PackedColorArray([Color(0.03, 0.05, 0.14), Color(0.03, 0.05, 0.14), Color(0.1, 0.18, 0.38), Color(0.1, 0.18, 0.38)]))
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = 5
	for i in 60:
		var p := Vector2(rng.randf() * W, rng.randf() * H * 0.8)
		var twinkle := 0.3 + 0.7 * absf(sin(t * rng.randf_range(0.8, 2.2) + rng.randf() * TAU))
		draw_rect(Rect2(p, Vector2(3, 3)), Color(1, 1, 1, twinkle))
	var current := pages[page]
	match current["type"]:
		"text":
			_draw_text_page(current)
		"map":
			_draw_map_page()
		"stats":
			_draw_stats()
		"credits":
			_draw_credits()
		"end":
			_draw_end()

extends CanvasLayer
## Een zwart scherm voor zachte overgangen tussen kaarten.

var rect: ColorRect
var tween: Tween


func _ready() -> void:
	layer = 100

	rect.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	rect.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)

	add_child(rect)


func set_alpha(alpha: float) -> void:
	rect.color.a = alpha


func fade_out(duration: float) -> void:
	await _fade(1.0, duration)


func fade_in(duration: float) -> void:
	await _fade(0.0, duration)


func _fade(target: float, duration: float) -> void:
	if tween and tween.is_valid():
		tween.kill()
	tween = create_tween().set_pause_mode(Tween.TWEEN_PAUSE_PROCESS)
	tween.tween_property(rect, "color:a", target, duration)
	await tween.finished

	rng = random
	zone_size = params["zone"]
	fish_speed = params["speed"]
	fill_time = params["fill_time"]

functions.name: update
functions.source:
func update(delta: float, holding: bool) -> void:
	if state != "bezig":
		return
	elapsed += delta
	# De zone: E ingedrukt trekt omhoog, anders zakt hij.
	var accel := LIFT if holding else -GRAVITY
	zone_vel += (accel - zone_vel * DRAG) * delta
	zone_pos += zone_vel * delta
	var half := zone_size / 2.0
	if zone_pos < half:
		zone_pos = half
		zone_vel = absf(zone_vel) * BOUNCE
	elif zone_pos > 1.0 - half:
		zone_pos = 1.0 - half
		zone_vel = -absf(zone_vel) * BOUNCE
	# De vis zwemt naar een willekeurig punt en kiest na een tijdje een nieuw punt. Hoe langer het duurt, hoe moeier.
	var strength := lerpf(1.0, TIRED, minf(elapsed / TIRE_TIME, 1.0))
	_retarget_in -= delta
	if _retarget_in <= 0.0:
		_retarget_in = rng.randf_range(0.5, 1.4) / (fish_speed * strength)
		fish_target = rng.randf_range(FISH_MARGIN, 1.0 - FISH_MARGIN)
	fish_pos = move_toward(fish_pos, fish_target, FISH_SPEED * fish_speed * strength * delta)
	in_zone = absf(fish_pos - zone_pos) <= half
	progress += delta / fill_time if in_zone else -delta * strength / DRAIN_TIME
	if progress >= 1.0:
		progress = 1.0
		state = "gevangen"
	elif progress <= 0.0:
		progress = 0.0
		state = "ontsnapt"

extends RefCounted
## Het binnenhalen van een vis (het laatste deel van het visspel), zonder tekenwerk zodat het te testen is.
##
## De balk loopt van 0 (onderaan) tot 1 (bovenaan). Jij bestuurt de groene zone met E: ingedrukt stijgt hij,
## losgelaten zakt hij. De vis zwemt zelf heen en weer. Zit hij in de zone, dan vult de voortgangsbalk;
## zit hij ernaast, dan loopt de balk langzaam leeg. Vol = gevangen, leeg = ontsnapt.
## Hoe langer het duurt, hoe moeier de vis: hij zwemt trager en trekt minder hard, zodat het nooit eindeloos duurt.

const START_PROGRESS := 0.3
const DRAIN_TIME := 14.0 # seconden om van vol tot leeg te lopen als de vis buiten de zone zit
const LIFT := 7.0 # versnelling omhoog met E ingedrukt (balklengtes per seconde per seconde)
const GRAVITY := 6.0 # versnelling omlaag als je loslaat
const DRAG := 7.0 # wrijving: de zone reageert snel en wordt nooit sneller dan 1 balklengte per seconde
const BOUNCE := 0.35 # hoeveel snelheid de zone terugkaatst tegen de rand
const FISH_SPEED := 0.4 # balklengtes per seconde van een rustige vis
const FISH_MARGIN := 0.08 # de vis blijft zo ver van de rand
const TIRE_TIME := 30.0 # na zoveel seconden is de vis zo moe als hij kan worden
const TIRED := 0.4 # een moeie vis zwemt en trekt nog maar zo hard (deel van zijn eigen kracht)

var rng: RandomNumberGenerator
var zone_size := 0.3
var zone_pos := 0.5 # midden van de zone
var zone_vel := 0.0
var fish_pos := 0.5
var fish_target := 0.5
var fish_speed := 1.0
var fill_time := 8.0
var progress := START_PROGRESS
var in_zone := false
var state := "bezig" # "bezig", "gevangen" of "ontsnapt"
var elapsed := 0.0
var _retarget_in := 0.0


## `params` heeft "zone", "speed" en "fill_time" (zie meer_vis.gd).
func _init(random: RandomNumberGenerator, params: Dictionary) -> void:
	rng = random
	zone_size = params["zone"]
	fish_speed = params["speed"]
	fill_time = params["fill_time"]
	fish_pos = rng.randf_range(0.25, 0.75)
	fish_target = fish_pos
	zone_pos = fish_pos # je begint met de vis in de zone


func update(delta: float, holding: bool) -> void:
	if state != "bezig":
		return
	elapsed += delta
	# De zone: E ingedrukt trekt omhoog, anders zakt hij.
	var accel := LIFT if holding else -GRAVITY
	zone_vel += (accel - zone_vel * DRAG) * delta
	zone_pos += zone_vel * delta
	var half := zone_size / 2.0
	if zone_pos < half:
		zone_pos = half
		zone_vel = absf(zone_vel) * BOUNCE
	elif zone_pos > 1.0 - half:
		zone_pos = 1.0 - half
		zone_vel = -absf(zone_vel) * BOUNCE
	# De vis zwemt naar een willekeurig punt en kiest na een tijdje een nieuw punt. Hoe langer het duurt, hoe moeier.
	var strength := lerpf(1.0, TIRED, minf(elapsed / TIRE_TIME, 1.0))
	_retarget_in -= delta
	if _retarget_in <= 0.0:
		_retarget_in = rng.randf_range(0.5, 1.4) / (fish_speed * strength)
		fish_target = rng.randf_range(FISH_MARGIN, 1.0 - FISH_MARGIN)
	fish_pos = move_toward(fish_pos, fish_target, FISH_SPEED * fish_speed * strength * delta)
	in_zone = absf(fish_pos - zone_pos) <= half
	progress += delta / fill_time if in_zone else -delta * strength / DRAIN_TIME
	if progress >= 1.0:
		progress = 1.0
		state = "gevangen"
	elif progress <= 0.0:
		progress = 0.0
		state = "ontsnapt"

func _finish(result: String) -> void:
	phase = "result"
	phase_time = 0.0
	outcome = result
	reel = null
	if result == "gevangen":
		GameState.give(catch_id, 1, true)
		Logic.record_catch(catch_id, bool(spot.get("deep")))
		Sound.play("meer_vangst")
		_splash(spot.global_position, 30.0, 14)
		if catch_id == Vis.GOLDEN:

	else:
		Sound.play("meer_ontsnapt")

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if phase == "idle":
		return
	phase_time += delta
	match phase:
		"cast":
			if phase_time >= CAST_TIME:
				_land()
		"wait":
			if phase_time >= wait_time:
				_bite()
		"bite":
			if phase_time >= BITE_WINDOW:
				_finish("te_laat")
		"reel":
			_update_reel(delta)
	root.queue_redraw()

func _draw_reel() -> void:
	var panel := REEL_PANEL
	_panel(panel)
	_text(Vector2(panel.position.x, 160), tr("Binnenhalen!"), 26, GOLD, panel.size.x, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER)
	# De balk met de groene zone en de vis
	root.draw_rect(BAR, Color(0.07, 0.13, 0.3))
	for i in range(1, 10):
		root.draw_line(Vector2(BAR.position.x, BAR.position.y + BAR.size.y * i / 10.0),
			Vector2(BAR.position.x + 10, BAR.position.y + BAR.size.y * i / 10.0), Color(0.3, 0.45, 0.7), 2.0)
	var zone_h: float = reel.zone_size * BAR.size.y
	var zone_y: float = BAR.position.y + BAR.size.y * (1.0 - reel.zone_pos) - zone_h / 2.0
	var zone := Rect2(BAR.position.x + 4, zone_y, BAR.size.x - 8, zone_h)
	root.draw_rect(zone, Color(0.3, 0.9, 0.45, 0.9 if reel.in_zone else 0.6))
	root.draw_rect(zone, Color(0.8, 1.0, 0.85), false, 3.0)
	root.draw_rect(BAR, Color(0.45, 0.75, 1.0), false, 3.0)
	var fish_y: float = BAR.position.y + BAR.size.y * (1.0 - reel.fish_pos)
	var wiggle := sin(phase_time * 14.0) * 2.0
	var icon: int = int(Items.info(catch_id)["icon"])
	root.draw_texture_rect_region(Art.tex(Items.sheet_of(catch_id)), Rect2(BAR.position.x + 16 + wiggle, fish_y - 16, 32, 32),
		Rect2(Vector2(icon * 16, 0), Vector2(16, 16)))
	# De voortgangsbalk: vult zich als de vis in de zone zit
	root.draw_rect(PROGRESS, Color(0.07, 0.13, 0.3))
	var filled: float = PROGRESS.size.y * reel.progress
	var fill_color := Color(0.3, 0.9, 0.45) if reel.in_zone else Color(0.95, 0.55, 0.3)
	root.draw_rect(Rect2(PROGRESS.position.x, PROGRESS.position.y + PROGRESS.size.y - filled, PROGRESS.size.x, filled), fill_color)
	root.draw_rect(PROGRESS, Color(0.45, 0.75, 1.0), false, 3.0)
	_text(Vector2(panel.position.x, 498), tr("Houd %s ingedrukt: omhoog") % Controls.action_label("interact"), 16, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.75), panel.size.x, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if get_tree().paused:
		access_panel.hide()
		toast_panel.modulate.a=0
		return # modal input already pauses the world; keep HUD timers/queues intact
	refresh_opening()
	stamina_bar.queue_redraw()
	# Meldingen komen een voor een, en wachten tot een gesprek klaar is.
	if GameState.dialogue_open or GameState.ui_owners.has("work_together"):
		toast_panel.modulate.a=0 # keep queued/current notices for after the collaboration
	elif toast_time > 0.0:
		toast_time -= delta
		toast_panel.modulate.a = clampf(toast_time * 2.0, 0.0, 1.0) if toast_time < 0.5 else 1.0
	elif not toast_queue.is_empty() and not GameState.dialogue_open:
		toast_label.text = toast_queue.pop_front()
		toast_time = 3.2
		toast_panel.modulate.a = 1.0
	else:
		toast_panel.modulate.a = 0.0

	if banner_time > 0.0:
		banner_time -= delta
		banner.modulate.a = clampf(minf(banner_time, 2.8 - banner_time) * 2.5, 0.0, 1.0)
	else:
		banner.modulate.a = 0.0

	_refresh_access()
	if access_panel.visible and toast_time>0:toast_time+=delta
	_update_clock()
	_update_boss()

func _refresh_access() -> void:
	access_panel.hide()
	if GameState.input_locked():return
	var world: Node=get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("world")
	if world==null:return
	var hint: Dictionary=preload("res://scripts/core/access_points.gd").nearby(world)
	if hint.is_empty():return
	access_text.text=hint.title+("\n"+hint.detail if hint.detail!="" else "")
	access_text.modulate=Color("f2d299") if hint.locked else Color("e9e4cf")
	var view:=get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	access_text.custom_minimum_size=Vector2(minf(600,view.x-80),0)
	access_panel.size=access_panel.get_combined_minimum_size()
	access_panel.position=Vector2((view.x-access_panel.size.x)*.5,view.y-106-access_panel.size.y)
	# Edge-clamped cameras can put the character low in the viewport. Keep the hint clear.
	var actor_screen: Vector2=world.player.get_global_transform_with_canvas().origin
	var actor_bounds:=Rect2(actor_screen-Vector2(40,40),Vector2(80,80))
	if access_panel.get_global_rect().intersects(actor_bounds):
		access_panel.position.y=maxf(24,actor_bounds.position.y-access_panel.size.y-16)
	access_panel.show()
	toast_panel.modulate.a=0 # doorway information has immediate priority; notices resume after leaving
	opening_hint.hide()

	Controls.device_changed.connect(func(_pad: bool) -> void: _refresh_controls())
	Controls.bindings_changed.connect(_refresh_controls)
	GameState.progression_changed.connect(func() -> void: xp_bar.queue_redraw())
	GameState.hp_changed.connect(func() -> void: hearts.queue_redraw())
	GameState.items_changed.connect(func() -> void: stats.queue_redraw(); _refresh_tracker())
	GameState.quests_changed.connect(_refresh_tracker)
	GameState.toast.connect(_queue_toast)
	GameState.game_over.connect(_show_game_over)
	_refresh_tracker()
	if not Opening.quiet_hud():
		_queue_toast(tr("%s zwaard  ·  %s praten  ·  %s menu  ·  %s pauze en besturing") % [Controls.action_label("attack"), Controls.action_label("interact"), Controls.action_label("menu"), Controls.action_label("pause")])
	# Boog: de pijlenteller (met "[F]") staat in beeld zodra je een boog hebt, en bij het krijgen ervan komt een melding.
	had_bow = GameState.count("bow") > 0
	GameState.items_changed.connect(_check_bow)
	Lang.changed.connect(_on_language_changed)
	get_tree().process_frame.connect(_refresh_combat)

func _exit_tree() -> void:
	if get_tree().process_frame.is_connected(_refresh_combat):
		get_tree().process_frame.disconnect(_refresh_combat)


func _ignore_mouse(node: Node) -> void:
	if node is Control:
		node.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	for child in node.get_children():
		_ignore_mouse(child)


func _refresh_controls() -> void:
	stats.queue_redraw()
	stamina_bar.queue_redraw()
	xp_bar.queue_redraw()
	if GameState.ended:
		_show_game_over()

func _draw_stats() -> void:
	var items_tex := Art.tex("items")
	var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
	var x := 0.0
	var entries := [
		[Items.ITEMS["coin"]["icon"], str(GameState.coins), Color(1, 0.9, 0.4)],
		[Items.ITEMS["crystal_bos"]["icon"], "%d/3" % (3 if GameState.flag("gate_temple") else GameState.crystal_count()), Color(0.6, 0.85, 1.0)],
		[Items.ITEMS["potion"]["icon"], "%d [%s]" % [GameState.count("potion"), Controls.action_label("potion")], Color(1, 0.6, 0.7)],

func _queue_toast(text: String) -> void:
	if item_receipts!=null and item_receipts.accepts(text):
		item_receipts.push(text)
	else:
		toast_queue.append(text)


## Grote tekst midden bovenin: de naam van een gebied, of "Goedemorgen!". `text_of` geeft de tekst in de huidige taal,
## bijvoorbeeld func() -> String: return tr("Goedemorgen!"). Zo verandert de banner meteen mee als je in het pauzemenu
## een andere taal kiest terwijl hij in beeld is.
func show_banner(text_of: Callable) -> void:
	banner_text = text_of
	banner.text = text_of.call()
	banner_time = 2.8


## De taal is gewisseld (pauzemenu): alles wat in beeld staat opnieuw invullen. Een melding die al in beeld is blijft
## in de oude taal staan tot hij verdwijnt; nieuwe meldingen komen in de nieuwe taal.
func _on_language_changed(_locale: String) -> void:
	_refresh_tracker()
	if banner_text.is_valid():
		banner.text = banner_text.call()
	overlay_title.text = tr("Game over")
	if overlay.visible:
		_show_game_over()
	stats.queue_redraw()
	xp_bar.queue_redraw()
	clock_state = ""
	clock.queue_redraw()
	boss_bar.queue_redraw()


func refresh_opening() -> void:
	var quiet := Opening.quiet_hud()
	if quiet != opening_quiet:
		opening_quiet = quiet
		stats.queue_redraw()
	clock.visible = not quiet
	xp_bar.visible = not quiet or GameState.hero_xp>0
	stamina_bar.visible = not quiet or GameState.flag("op_sprint_seen") or GameState.movement.stamina<GameState.movement.capacity()
	stats.visible = not quiet or GameState.coins>0 or GameState.count("potion")>0
	opening_hint.visible = quiet and not GameState.input_locked() and toast_time<=0
	if quiet:
		if GameState.flag("op_water"):
			opening_hint.text = tr("Rennen: %s vasthouden   ·   Je spullen bekijken: %s") % [Controls.action_label("sprint"),Controls.action_label("menu")]
		elif GameState.count("op_rake")>0:
			opening_hint.text = tr("%s: gereedschap gebruiken bij het rooster. Blijf even staan tijdens het harken.") % Controls.action_label("interact")
		else:
			opening_hint.text = tr("Lopen: %s / %s / %s / %s   ·   Praten: %s") % [Controls.action_label("move_up"),Controls.action_label("move_left"),Controls.action_label("move_down"),Controls.action_label("move_right"),Controls.action_label("interact")]
	_refresh_tracker()


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if get_tree().paused:
		access_panel.hide()
		toast_panel.modulate.a=0
		return # modal input already pauses the world; keep HUD timers/queues intact
	refresh_opening()
	stamina_bar.queue_redraw()
	# Meldingen komen een voor een, en wachten tot een gesprek klaar is.
	if GameState.dialogue_open or GameState.ui_owners.has("work_together"):
		toast_panel.modulate.a=0 # keep queued/current notices for after the collaboration
	elif toast_time > 0.0:
		toast_time -= delta
		toast_panel.modulate.a = clampf(toast_time * 2.0, 0.0, 1.0) if toast_time < 0.5 else 1.0
	elif not toast_queue.is_empty() and not GameState.dialogue_open:
		toast_label.text = toast_queue.pop_front()
		toast_time = 3.2
		toast_panel.modulate.a = 1.0
	else:
		toast_panel.modulate.a = 0.0

	if banner_time > 0.0:
		banner_time -= delta
		banner.modulate.a = clampf(minf(banner_time, 2.8 - banner_time) * 2.5, 0.0, 1.0)
	else:
		banner.modulate.a = 0.0

	_refresh_access()
	if access_panel.visible and toast_time>0:toast_time+=delta
	_update_clock()
	_update_boss()

func _refresh_combat() -> void:
	combat_hint.visible = false
	if GameState.input_locked() or opening_quiet: return
	var player: Node2D = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player")
	if player == null: return
	var nearby: bool = GameState.map_id == "watchyard" or player.combat.busy()
	if not nearby:
		for foe: Node2D in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
			if foe.data.behavior != "animal" and foe.global_position.distance_to(player.global_position) < 170:
				nearby = true
				break
	if not nearby: return
	var profile: Dictionary = player.combat.effective_profile(GameState.weapon)
	var bow: Dictionary = player.combat.effective_profile(GameState.weapon,true)
	combat_hint.text = tr("%s + %s: %s (%d stamina)\n%s + %s: %s (%d)") % [Controls.action_label("technique"),Controls.action_label("attack"),player.combat.display_name(GameState.weapon),int(profile.cost),Controls.action_label("technique"),Controls.action_label("bow"),tr(str(bow.name)),int(bow.cost)]
	if player.combat.phase=="counter":combat_hint.text=tr("Nu: %s voor de tegenstoot") % Controls.action_label("attack")
	elif bow.get("mode","")=="cw_fan":combat_hint.text+=" · "+tr("3 pijlen")
	combat_hint.visible = true


func _update_boss() -> void:
	boss = null
	var player := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player")
	for candidate: Node2D in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("boss"):
		# Een baas kan met `bar_range` zeggen dat zijn balk vanaf verder weg te zien is (een grote arena).
		var show_range: float = float(candidate.get("bar_range")) if candidate.get("bar_range") != null else 360.0
		if candidate.active and not candidate.dead and player and candidate.global_position.distance_to(player.global_position) < show_range:
			boss = candidate
			break
	boss_bar.visible = boss != null
	if boss:
		boss_bar.queue_redraw()


func _draw_boss_bar() -> void:
	if boss == null:
		return
	var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
	var ratio := clampf(float(boss.hp) / float(boss.max_hp), 0.0, 1.0)
	var boss_name := tr(boss.data["name"])
	boss_bar.draw_string_outline(font, Vector2(0, 16), boss_name, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 20, 5, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.9))
	boss_bar.draw_string(font, Vector2(0, 16), boss_name, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 20, Color(1, 0.85, 0.85))
	boss_bar.draw_rect(Rect2(0, 24, 340, 16), Color(0.05, 0.02, 0.05, 0.85))
	boss_bar.draw_rect(Rect2(2, 26, 336.0 * ratio, 12), Color(0.85, 0.2, 0.25))

## Wie je versloeg, in de taal van de speler. De bron van de schade (player.hurt) is de Nederlandse naam van de vijand,
## soms met de aanval erachter: "Kristalgolem (klap)". Naam en aanval worden los vertaald; de aanvallen staan in
## Enemies.ATTACKS (met de context "aanval", want "klap" of "steen" kan los ook iets anders betekenen).
static func damage_source_text(source: String) -> String:
	var open := source.rfind(" (")
	if open > 0 and source.ends_with(")"):
		var attack := source.substr(open + 2, source.length() - open - 3)
		# Vertalers: naam van een vijand en (tussen haakjes) zijn aanval, bijvoorbeeld "Kristalgolem (klap)"
		return TranslationServer.translate("%s (%s)") % [TranslationServer.translate(source.substr(0, open)),
			TranslationServer.translate(attack, "aanval")]
	return TranslationServer.translate(source)

	if world != null and world.atmosphere != null and world.atmosphere.rain_level > 0.3:
		# Vertalers: het dagdeel bij de klok als het regent: "Avond  ·  regen"
		label = tr("%s  ·  regen") % label
	return label

	var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
	xp_bar.draw_string_outline(font, Vector2(0, 15), xp_label(), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 16, 4, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.9))

func _refresh_access() -> void:
	access_panel.hide()
	if GameState.input_locked():return
	var world: Node=get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("world")
	if world==null:return
	var hint: Dictionary=preload("res://scripts/core/access_points.gd").nearby(world)
	if hint.is_empty():return
	access_text.text=hint.title+("\n"+hint.detail if hint.detail!="" else "")
	access_text.modulate=Color("f2d299") if hint.locked else Color("e9e4cf")
	var view:=get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	access_text.custom_minimum_size=Vector2(minf(600,view.x-80),0)
	access_panel.size=access_panel.get_combined_minimum_size()
	access_panel.position=Vector2((view.x-access_panel.size.x)*.5,view.y-106-access_panel.size.y)
	# Edge-clamped cameras can put the character low in the viewport. Keep the hint clear.
	var actor_screen: Vector2=world.player.get_global_transform_with_canvas().origin
	var actor_bounds:=Rect2(actor_screen-Vector2(40,40),Vector2(80,80))
	if access_panel.get_global_rect().intersects(actor_bounds):
		access_panel.position.y=maxf(24,actor_bounds.position.y-access_panel.size.y-16)
	access_panel.show()
	toast_panel.modulate.a=0 # doorway information has immediate priority; notices resume after leaving
	opening_hint.hide()

func _process(delta: float):
	visible=not GameState.input_locked() and not GameState.dialogue_open and not GameState.ended
	if not visible:return # menus cannot silently consume unread item receipts
	var removed:=false
	for entry in entries:entry.left-=delta
	while not entries.is_empty() and entries[0].left<=0:entries.pop_front();removed=true
	if removed:rebuild()
	var view:=get_viewport_rect().size
	var width:=minf(320,view.x*.34)
	var top:=maxf(100,tracker.get_global_rect().end.y+12) if is_instance_valid(tracker) and tracker.visible else 100.0
	stack.size.x=width
	var used:=0.0
	var budget:=maxf(90,view.y-210-top)
	for i in range(entries.size()-1,-1,-1):
		var entry: Dictionary=entries[i]
		var panel: PanelContainer=entry.panel
		var label: Label=panel.get_child(0);label.custom_minimum_size.x=maxf(160,width-22)
		var height:=maxf(42,panel.get_combined_minimum_size().y)+6
		panel.visible=used+height<=budget
		if panel.visible:used+=height
		panel.modulate.a=clampf(entry.left*2,0,1)
	stack.position=Vector2(view.x-width-16,top)
