static func draw_travel_panel(menu: Node, font: Font, altars: Array) -> void:
	var canvas: Control = menu.page
	var left := 660.0
	var width := SIZE.x - left - 24.0
	text(canvas, font, Vector2(left, 66), TranslationServer.translate("Snel reizen"), 24, Color(0.6, 0.88, 1.0))
	if altars.is_empty():
		text(canvas, font, Vector2(left, 106), TranslationServer.translate("Je hebt nog geen blauw altaar ontdekt. Gebruik een altaar, dan kun je er later snel naartoe reizen."), 18, Color(0.8, 0.86, 0.98), width)
		return
	menu.travel_selected = clampi(menu.travel_selected, 0, altars.size() - 1)
	menu.refresh_travel_scroll(altars.size())
	for i in range(menu.travel_scroll,mini(menu.travel_scroll+menu.TRAVEL_VISIBLE,altars.size())):
		var altar: Dictionary = altars[i]
		var rect := Rect2(left, 104 + (i-menu.travel_scroll) * 48.0, width, 42)
		var chosen: bool = i == menu.travel_selected
		canvas.draw_rect(rect, Color(0.18, 0.3, 0.55) if chosen else PANEL)
		canvas.draw_rect(rect, Color(1.0, 0.88, 0.35) if chosen else FRAME, false, 3.0 if chosen else 2.0)
		canvas.draw_texture_rect_region(Art.tex("wereld_ui"), Rect2(rect.position + Vector2(8, 5), Vector2(32, 32)), Rect2(Vector2(6 * 16, 0), Vector2(16, 16)))
		var label := TranslationServer.translate(altar["name"])
		var available := width-58.0
		var label_size:=20
		while label_size>15 and font.get_string_size(label,HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT,-1,label_size).x>available:label_size-=1
		text(canvas, font, rect.position + Vector2(50, 4), label, label_size, Color.WHITE)
		if altar["map"] == GameState.map_id:
			# Vertalers: in de lijst voor snel reizen achter het altaar in het gebied waar je nu bent
			var here := TranslationServer.translate("hier")
			var here_width := font.get_string_size(here, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 16).x
			text(canvas, font, rect.position + Vector2(rect.size.x - here_width - 10, 25), here, 12, DIM)
	if altars.size()>menu.TRAVEL_VISIBLE:
		text(canvas,font,Vector2(left+4,344),TranslationServer.translate("Altaren %d–%d / %d · ↑ ↓ bladeren") % [menu.travel_scroll+1,mini(menu.travel_scroll+menu.TRAVEL_VISIBLE,altars.size()),altars.size()],14,DIM)
	var box_y: float = menu.travel_box_y(altars.size())
	if menu.travel_confirm:
		var altar: Dictionary = altars[menu.travel_selected]
		var box := Rect2(left, box_y, width, 110) # ruimte voor een naam over twee regels
		canvas.draw_rect(box, Color(0.2, 0.18, 0.06))
		canvas.draw_rect(box, Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.3), false, 3.0)
		text(canvas, font, box.position + Vector2(12, 8), TranslationServer.translate("Reizen naar %s?") % TranslationServer.translate(in_sentence(altar["name"])), 20, GOLD, width - 24.0)
		canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(box.position + Vector2(12, 70), Vector2(142, 32)), Color(0.15, 0.36, 0.28))
		canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(box.position + Vector2(166, 70), Vector2(138, 32)), Color(0.3, 0.24, 0.25))
		text(canvas, font, box.position + Vector2(20, 74), TranslationServer.translate("%s  Reizen") % Controls.action_label("ui_accept"), 17, Color.WHITE)
		text(canvas, font, box.position + Vector2(174, 74), TranslationServer.translate("%s  Terug") % Controls.action_label("ui_cancel"), 17, Color.WHITE)
	elif menu.travel_message != "":
		text(canvas, font, Vector2(left, box_y), menu.travel_message, 18, Color(1.0, 0.65, 0.55), width)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	stock_button.visible=active and tab==0
	stock_button.text=tr("Voorraad")+" ["+Controls.action_label("crafting")+"]"
	time += delta
	travel_message_time = maxf(travel_message_time - delta, 0.0)
	if travel_message_time <= 0.0:
		travel_message = ""
	if not active:
		return
	_fit()
	_repeat_navigation(delta)
	# De tabwissel: de markering glijdt naar het nieuwe tabblad, de bladzijde faden en schuift zacht mee.
	if tab_anim < 1.0:
		tab_anim = minf(tab_anim + delta / TAB_ANIM_TIME, 1.0)
	var eased := 1.0 - pow(1.0 - tab_anim, 3.0) # vlot beginnen, zacht landen
	tab_visual = lerpf(tab_from, float(tab), eased)
	page.modulate.a = eased
	page.position.y = PAGE_SLIDE * (1.0 - eased)
	# De muis licht tabbladen en de sluitknop op (met een controller is er geen aanwijzer).
	update_hover(content.get_local_mouse_position())
	content.queue_redraw()
	page.queue_redraw()

func _navigate(action: String) -> void:
	travel_confirm = false
	var step := -1 if action in ["ui_up", "ui_left"] else 1
	match tab:
		0:
			var count := _owned().size()
			if action in ["ui_up", "ui_down"]:
				step *= GRID_COLUMNS
			selected = clampi(selected + step, 0, maxi(count - 1, 0))
		TAB_QUESTS:
			if action=="ui_right":
				quest_detail_mode=true;quest_detail.grab_focus()
			elif action=="ui_left":
				quest_detail_mode=false;quest_detail.release_focus()
			elif quest_detail_mode:
				quest_detail.get_v_scroll_bar().value += step*48
			else:
				quest_selected = clampi(quest_selected + step, 0, maxi(_quest_order().size() - 1, 0))
		TAB_MAP:
			if atlas_mode:atlas_page.navigate(action)
			else:
				travel_selected = clampi(travel_selected + step, 0, maxi(FastTravel.discovered_altars().size() - 1, 0))
				refresh_travel_scroll()
		TAB_ACHIEVEMENTS:
			achievement_selected = clampi(achievement_selected + step, 0, Achievements.ACHIEVEMENTS.size() - 1)
		TAB_EQUIPMENT:
			equipment_page.navigate(action)
		TAB_APPEARANCE:
			appearance_page.navigate(action)
		TAB_PROGRESSION:
			progression_page.navigate(action)
		TAB_BESTIARY:
			bestiary_selected = clampi(bestiary_selected + step, 0, Enemies.ENEMIES.size() - 1)
	Sound.play("select", -12.0)

func map_legend_layout(legend: Dictionary,font: Font) -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var result: Array[Dictionary]=[]
	var x:=MARGIN
	var row:=0
	for label: String in legend:
		var text: String="◆ "+label
		var width:=font.get_string_size(text,HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT,-1,14).x
		if x+width>MARGIN+MAP_WIDTH:x=MARGIN;row+=1
		if row>1:break
		result.append({"text":text,"at":Vector2(x,478+row*22),"color":legend[label],"width":width})
		x+=width+16
	if result.size()==legend.size():return result
	# Balance long category names across both rows instead of dropping the last entry.
	var labels: Array=legend.keys()
	labels.sort_custom(func(a,b):return font.get_string_size(str(a),HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT,-1,14).x>font.get_string_size(str(b),HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT,-1,14).x)
	for font_size in [14,13,12]:
		result.clear()
		var used: Array[float]=[0.0,0.0]
		for label: String in labels:
			var text: String="◆ "+label
			var width:=font.get_string_size(text,HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT,-1,font_size).x
			var target:=0 if used[0]<=used[1] else 1
			if used[target]+width>MAP_WIDTH:target=1-target
			if used[target]+width>MAP_WIDTH:break
			result.append({"text":text,"at":Vector2(MARGIN+used[target],478+target*22),"color":legend[label],"width":width,"font_size":font_size})
			used[target]+=width+12
		if result.size()==legend.size():return result
	return result

extends CanvasLayer
## Pauzemenu (Esc of P). Zet het hele spel stil. Met de taalknop ("Taal: Nederlands") wissel je de taal: het menu,
## de HUD erachter en alles wat daarna komt staan meteen in de nieuwe taal.

const UiStyle := preload("res://scripts/core/ui_style.gd")

var root: Control
var panel: PanelContainer
var title_label: Label
var resume_button: Button
var load_button: Button
var sound_button: Button
var controls_button: Button
var language_button: Button
var music_label: Label
var effects_label: Label
var title_button: Button
var ng_row: HBoxContainer # "Nieuw spel+ ronde N" met een ster, alleen bij Nieuw spel+
var ng_label: Label
var open := false


func _ready() -> void:
	layer = 20
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS # moet blijven werken terwijl de rest pauzeert
	_build_ui()
	root.visible = false
	Sound.mute_changed.connect(func(_muted: bool) -> void: _refresh_sound_label())

func _build_ui() -> void:
	root = Control.new()
	root.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	add_child(root)

	var dim := ColorRect.new()
	dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6)
	root.add_child(dim)

	panel = PanelContainer.new()
	UiStyle.style_panel(panel)
	root.add_child(panel)

	var box := VBoxContainer.new()
	box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	panel.add_child(box)
	title_label = UiStyle.make_label("", 44, Color(0.6, 0.88, 1.0))
	box.add_child(title_label)
	_build_ng_row(box)

	resume_button = _button(box, toggle)
	load_button = _button(box, _load_save)
	sound_button = _button(box, Sound.toggle_mute)
	controls_button = _button(box, _open_controls)
	language_button = _button(box, _toggle_language)
	music_label = _slider(box, Sound.music_volume, Sound.set_music_volume)
	effects_label = _slider(box, Sound.sfx_volume, Sound.set_sfx_volume)
	title_button = _button(box, _to_title)
	_refresh_texts()


## Alle tekst in het menu in de huidige taal (bij het bouwen, en opnieuw als je de taal wisselt).
func _refresh_texts() -> void:
	title_label.text = tr("Pauze")
	resume_button.text = tr("Verder spelen")
	load_button.text = tr("Laatste opslag laden")
	language_button.text = Lang.button_text()
	music_label.text = tr("Muziek")

	_refresh_ng_row()

	Lang.toggle()

	_refresh_texts()

func _build_ng_row(parent: Node) -> void:
	ng_row = HBoxContainer.new()

	UiStyle.style_button(button)

	parent.add_child(button)
	return button


## Een schuifje met een naam ervoor. Geeft het Label met de naam terug (de tekst vult _refresh_texts in).
func _slider(parent: Node, value: float, setter: Callable) -> Label:
	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	var label := Label.new()
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	label.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(110, 0)
	row.add_child(label)
	var slider := HSlider.new()
	slider.min_value = 0.0
	slider.max_value = 1.0
	slider.step = 0.05
	slider.value = value
	slider.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(220, 36)

	slider.value_changed.connect(setter)
	row.add_child(slider)
	parent.add_child(row)
	return label


func _refresh_sound_label() -> void:
	sound_button.text = tr("Geluid: uit") if Sound.muted else tr("Geluid: aan")


func _open_controls() -> void:
	var menu := preload("res://scripts/ui/controls_menu.gd").new()
	menu.closed.connect(func() -> void: controls_button.grab_focus())
	add_child(menu)


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if Controls.capture_active or not Controls.allows_event(event):
		return
	if open and UiStyle.activate_focused(root, event):
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		return
	if open and event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		toggle()
		return
	if open and Controls.is_ui_navigation_event(event):
		return
	# Start is bij verlies ook de herstartknop; laat de wereld die afhandelen.
	if GameState.ended and event.is_action_pressed("restart"):
		return
	if not event.is_action_pressed("pause"):
		return
	# Geen pauzemenu bovenop een gesprek, winkel of ander menu, of tijdens een overgang.
	for owner_name: String in GameState.ui_owners:
		if owner_name != "pause":
			return
	if GameState.transitioning:
		return
	get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
	toggle()


func toggle() -> void:
	open = not open
	root.visible = open
	GameState.set_ui("pause", open)
	Sound.play("select")
	if open:
		_refresh_ng_row()
		load_button.disabled = not GameState.has_save()
		_refresh_sound_label()
		_layout()
		resume_button.grab_focus()


func _load_save() -> void:
	GameState.set_ui("pause", false)
	var world := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("world")
	if world:
		world.restart_from_save()


func _to_title() -> void:
	GameState.set_ui("pause", false)
	GameState.in_game = false
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/title.tscn")


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if open:
		_layout()


func _layout() -> void:
	var wanted := panel.get_combined_minimum_size()
	var viewport := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	var factor := minf(1.0, minf((viewport.x - 32) / wanted.x, (viewport.y - 32) / wanted.y))
	panel.size = wanted
	panel.scale = Vector2.ONE * factor
	panel.position = (viewport - wanted * factor) * 0.5

functions.name: _populate
functions.source:
func _populate(focus_index: int) -> void:
	for child in list.get_children():
		list.remove_child(child)
		child.queue_free()
	var controls: Array[Control] = []
	var first: Button = null
	var index := 0
	for entry: Dictionary in shop["items"]:
		if entry.has("if") and not GameState.check_all(entry["if"]):
			continue # nog niet te koop (bijvoorbeeld pijlen zonder boog)
		var info := Items.info(entry["item"])
		var owned: bool = entry.get("once", false) and GameState.count(entry["item"]) > 0
		var button := Button.new()
		var price: int = entry["price"]
		# Vertalers: achter iets in de winkel dat je maar één keer kunt kopen en al hebt; anders de prijs
		button.text = "%s   —   %s" % [_label(entry), tr("gekocht") if owned else tr_n("%d munt", "%d munten", price) % price]
		button.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
		UiStyle.style_button(button, 22)
		button.disabled = owned
		button.icon = Items.icon_tex(entry["item"])
		button.pressed.connect(_buy.bind(entry, index))
		button.focus_entered.connect(func() -> void: desc_label.text = tr(info["desc"]))
		list.add_child(button)
		if not owned:
			controls.append(button)
		if first == null or index == focus_index:
			if not owned:
				first = button
		index += 1
	controls.append(close_button)
	UiStyle.link_vertical(controls)
	if first:
		UiStyle.focus_if_visible.call_deferred(first)
	else:
		desc_label.text = tr("Je hebt alles gekocht!")
		UiStyle.focus_if_visible.call_deferred(close_button)

const UiStyle := preload("res://scripts/core/ui_style.gd")
const Art := preload("res://scripts/core/art.gd")
const Items := preload("res://scripts/data/items.gd")
const Shops := preload("res://scripts/data/shops.gd")

var root: Control
var panel: PanelContainer
var title_label: Label
var coins_label: Label
var list: VBoxContainer
var desc_label: Label
var hint: Label
var close_button: Button
var scroll: ScrollContainer
var shop: Dictionary = {}
var active := false
var opened_frame := -1


func _ready() -> void:
	layer = 12
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	_build_ui()
	root.visible = false
	GameState.shop_requested.connect(open)
	Lang.changed.connect(_refresh_language)
	GameState.items_changed.connect(func() -> void:
		if active:
			coins_label.text = tr("Munten: %d") % GameState.coins)


func _build_ui() -> void:
	root = Control.new()
	root.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	add_child(root)
	var dim := ColorRect.new()
	dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6)
	root.add_child(dim)
	panel = PanelContainer.new()
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", UiStyle.flat(Color(0.06, 0.1, 0.22, 0.97), Color(0.45, 0.75, 1.0), 3))
	root.add_child(panel)
	var box := VBoxContainer.new()
	box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	box.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(560, 0)
	panel.add_child(box)
	title_label = UiStyle.make_label("", 30, Color(0.6, 0.88, 1.0))
	box.add_child(title_label)
	coins_label = UiStyle.make_label("", 24, Color(1, 0.9, 0.4))
	box.add_child(coins_label)
	list = VBoxContainer.new()
	list.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	scroll = ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(560, 240)
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	scroll.follow_focus = true
	list.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	box.add_child(scroll)
	scroll.add_child(list)
	desc_label = Label.new()
	desc_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 18)
	desc_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	desc_label.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 54)
	box.add_child(desc_label)
	hint = Label.new()
	hint.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
	hint.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.6)
	hint.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	box.add_child(hint)
	close_button = Button.new()
	UiStyle.style_button(close_button, 20)
	close_button.custom_minimum_size.y = 38
	close_button.text = tr("Sluiten")
	close_button.pressed.connect(close)
	box.add_child(close_button)


func open(shop_id: String) -> void:
	shop = Shops.info(shop_id)
	title_label.text = tr(shop["name"])
	coins_label.text = tr("Munten: %d") % GameState.coins
	_populate(0)
	active = true
	root.visible = true
	opened_frame = Engine.get_process_frames()
	GameState.set_ui("shop", true)


func close() -> void:
	active = false
	root.visible = false
	GameState.set_ui("shop", false)


func _populate(focus_index: int) -> void:
	for child in list.get_children():
		list.remove_child(child)
		child.queue_free()
	var controls: Array[Control] = []
	var first: Button = null
	var index := 0
	for entry: Dictionary in shop["items"]:
		if entry.has("if") and not GameState.check_all(entry["if"]):
			continue # nog niet te koop (bijvoorbeeld pijlen zonder boog)
		var info := Items.info(entry["item"])
		var owned: bool = entry.get("once", false) and GameState.count(entry["item"]) > 0
		var button := Button.new()
		var price: int = entry["price"]
		# Vertalers: achter iets in de winkel dat je maar één keer kunt kopen en al hebt; anders de prijs
		button.text = "%s   —   %s" % [_label(entry), tr("gekocht") if owned else tr_n("%d munt", "%d munten", price) % price]
		button.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
		UiStyle.style_button(button, 22)
		button.disabled = owned
		button.icon = Items.icon_tex(entry["item"])
		button.pressed.connect(_buy.bind(entry, index))
		button.focus_entered.connect(func() -> void: desc_label.text = tr(info["desc"]))
		list.add_child(button)
		if not owned:
			controls.append(button)
		if first == null or index == focus_index:
			if not owned:
				first = button
		index += 1
	controls.append(close_button)
	UiStyle.link_vertical(controls)
	if first:
		UiStyle.focus_if_visible.call_deferred(first)
	else:
		desc_label.text = tr("Je hebt alles gekocht!")
		UiStyle.focus_if_visible.call_deferred(close_button)


## De naam van een winkelregel (vertaald): een eigen `label`, anders de naam van het voorwerp (met het aantal erbij).
func _label(entry: Dictionary) -> String:
	if entry.has("label"):
		return tr(entry["label"])
	var amount: int = entry.get("amount", 1)
	var item_name := tr(Items.info(entry["item"])["name"])
	return item_name if amount == 1 else "%s x%d" % [item_name, amount]


func _buy(entry: Dictionary, index: int) -> void:
	if not active:
		return
	var price: int = entry["price"]
	var amount: int = entry.get("amount", 1)
	if entry.get("once", false) and GameState.count(entry["item"]) > 0:
		return # eenmalige dingen koop je maar één keer
	if entry.has("if") and not GameState.check_all(entry["if"]):
		return # nog niet te koop
	if GameState.coins < price:
		Sound.play("error")
		GameState.toast.emit(tr("Je hebt niet genoeg munten."))
		return
	if GameState.room(entry["item"]) < amount:
		Sound.play("error")
		GameState.toast.emit(_no_room_text(entry["item"]))
		return
	GameState.add_coins(-price)
	GameState.give(entry["item"], amount, true)
	for extra: Array in entry.get("with", []):
		GameState.give(extra[0], int(extra[1]), true)
	Sound.play("buy")
	GameState.toast.emit(tr("Gekocht: %s") % _label(entry))
	_populate(index)


## Waarom iets niet meer past: helemaal vol, of bijna vol (dan met hoeveel je er hebt, bijvoorbeeld "38 van de 40").
func _no_room_text(item_id: String) -> String:
	var info := Items.info(item_id)
	if GameState.room(item_id) > 0 and info.has("almost_full_text"):
		# Vertalers: melding dat iets bijna vol is, met hoeveel je hebt en het maximum: "Je pijlenkoker zit bijna vol (38 van de 40)"
		return tr("%s (%d van de %d)") % [tr(info["almost_full_text"]), GameState.count(item_id), int(info["max"])]
	return GameState.full_text(item_id)


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not Controls.allows_event(event):
		return
	if not active or Engine.get_process_frames() == opened_frame or event.is_echo():
		return
	if UiStyle.shortcut(event, "pause") or event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		close()
	elif UiStyle.activate_focused(root, event):
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if active:
		panel.size = panel.get_combined_minimum_size()
		var factor := minf(1.0, minf((root.size.x - 24.0) / panel.size.x, (root.size.y - 24.0) / panel.size.y))
		panel.scale = Vector2.ONE * maxf(factor, 0.1)
		panel.position = (root.size - panel.size * panel.scale) * 0.5
		hint.text = tr("↑ ↓ kiezen  ·  %s kopen  ·  %s sluiten") % [Controls.action_label("ui_accept"), Controls.action_label("ui_cancel")]


func _exit_tree() -> void:
	if active:
		GameState.set_ui("shop", false)


func _refresh_language(_locale: String) -> void:
	close_button.text = tr("Sluiten")
	if active:
		var focused := get_viewport().gui_get_focus_owner()
		var index := focused.get_index() if focused != null and focused.get_parent() == list else 0
		title_label.text = tr(shop["name"])
		coins_label.text = tr("Munten: %d") % GameState.coins
		_populate(index)

extends CanvasLayer
## A short, cancellable preparation: ingredients commit only when plating finishes.
const Supper := preload("res://scripts/core/lake_supper.gd")
const UiStyle := preload("res://scripts/core/ui_style.gd")
const Items := preload("res://scripts/data/items.gd")
const Art := preload("res://scripts/core/art.gd")
const DrawUtil := preload("res://scripts/core/draw_util.gd")
var root: Control
var panel: PanelContainer
var box: VBoxContainer
var detail: Label
var progress: ProgressBar
var action_button: Button
var back: Button
var choices: Array[Button]=[]
var source: WeakRef
var active := false
var dish := ""
var stage := 0
var working := false
var elapsed := 0.0
var opened_frame := -1
var result := ""
var preview: Control
var time := 0.0

func _ready() -> void:
	layer=12
	process_mode=Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	root=Control.new()
	root.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	add_child(root)
	var dim:=ColorRect.new()
	dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.color=Color(0.02,0.04,0.07,0.8)
	root.add_child(dim)
	panel=PanelContainer.new()
	UiStyle.style_panel(panel)
	panel.custom_minimum_size=Vector2(740,460)
	root.add_child(panel)
	box=VBoxContainer.new()
	box.add_theme_constant_override("separation",12)
	panel.add_child(box)
	box.add_child(UiStyle.make_label(tr("Koken met Mila"),30,Color("edce98")))
	var subtitle:=UiStyle.make_label(tr("Kies je gerecht. Snijden → roeren → opscheppen."),20)
	box.add_child(subtitle)
	preview=Control.new()
	preview.custom_minimum_size=Vector2(0,72)
	preview.mouse_filter=Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	preview.draw.connect(draw_preparation)
	box.add_child(preview)
	for id: String in Supper.DISHES:
		var button:=Button.new()
		UiStyle.style_button(button,22)
		button.text=tr(Items.info(id).name)
		button.icon=Items.icon_tex(id)
		button.pressed.connect(select_dish.bind(id))
		box.add_child(button)
		choices.append(button)
	detail=UiStyle.make_label("",20)
	detail.autowrap_mode=TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	detail.custom_minimum_size=Vector2(680,92)
	box.add_child(detail)
	progress=ProgressBar.new()
	progress.custom_minimum_size=Vector2(0,18)
	progress.max_value=3
	progress.show_percentage=false
	box.add_child(progress)
	action_button=Button.new()
	UiStyle.style_button(action_button,22)
	action_button.pressed.connect(prepare_step)
	box.add_child(action_button)
	back=Button.new()
	UiStyle.style_button(back,20)
	back.text=tr("Sluiten — ongebruikte ingrediënten blijven in je tas")
	back.pressed.connect(close)
	box.add_child(back)
	root.hide()

func open(stove: Node2D) -> void:
	if active or GameState.input_locked(): return
	source=weakref(stove)
	active=true
	stage=0
	working=false
	dish=""
	result=""
	opened_frame=Engine.get_process_frames()
	root.show()
	GameState.set_ui("supper_kitchen",true)
	refresh()
	choices[0].grab_focus()

func select_dish(id: String) -> void:
	if working: return
	dish=id
	stage=0
	result=""
	refresh()
	if not action_button.disabled: action_button.grab_focus()

func refresh() -> void:
	for i in choices.size():
		choices[i].disabled=working
		choices[i].modulate=Color("ffe4ac") if dish==Supper.DISHES[i] else Color.WHITE
	progress.value=stage
	action_button.text=tr("Kies eerst een gerecht") if dish=="" else [tr("Snijden"),tr("Roeren"),tr("Opscheppen")][mini(stage,2)]
	var reason:=Supper.cook_reason(dish) if dish!="" else ""
	action_button.disabled=dish=="" or reason!="" or working
	if result!="":
		detail.text=result
	elif dish=="":
		detail.text=tr("Stoof geeft meer hartjes; bouillon meer uithoudingsvermogen. De eerste mand is goed voor twee porties. Eén voor de dorpstafel, één voor onderweg.")
	else:
		var ingredients: Array[String]=[]
		for item: String in Supper.inputs(dish): ingredients.append("%s ×%d" % [Supper.Professions.item_name(item),Supper.inputs(dish)[item]])
		detail.text=tr(Items.info(dish).desc)+"\n"+", ".join(ingredients)+("\n"+reason if reason!="" else "")
	var controls: Array[Control]=[]
	for button in choices: controls.append(button)
	controls.append(action_button)
	controls.append(back)
	UiStyle.link_vertical(controls)

func prepare_step() -> void:
	if not active or working or dish=="" or Supper.cook_reason(dish)!="": return
	working=true
	elapsed=0
	Sound.play(["ls_chop","ls_simmer","ls_serve"][stage],-10)
	refresh()
	back.grab_focus() # cancellation stays available during preparation

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not active: return
	time+=delta
	preview.queue_redraw()
	var stove: Variant=source.get_ref() if source!=null else null
	if not is_instance_valid(stove) or not stove.is_inside_tree() or stove.is_queued_for_deletion() or GameState.map_id!="inn" or stove.position.distance_to(stove.world.player.position)>66:
		close()
		return
	if working:
		elapsed+=delta
		progress.value=stage+minf(elapsed/0.9,1)
		if elapsed>=0.9:
			working=false
			stage+=1
			if stage==3:
				if Supper.cook(dish):
					result=tr("Klaar! Deel één portie aan de dorpstafel of neem je gerecht mee. Je ingrediënten zijn verwerkt.")
				else: result=Supper.cook_reason(dish)
				dish=""
				stage=0
			refresh()
			if dish!="" and not action_button.disabled: action_button.grab_focus()
			else: back.grab_focus()
	panel.size=panel.get_combined_minimum_size()
	var factor:=minf(1,minf((root.size.x-24)/panel.size.x,(root.size.y-24)/panel.size.y))
	panel.scale=Vector2.ONE*maxf(0.1,factor)
	panel.position=(root.size-panel.size*panel.scale)/2

func draw_preparation() -> void:
	var center:=Vector2(preview.size.x/2,36)
	DrawUtil.sprite(preview,Art.tex("ls_stove"),int(time*3)%2,0,center,Vector2i(24,24),2.5)
	DrawUtil.sprite(preview,Art.tex("ls_items"),2 if dish=="ls_broth" else 1,0,center+Vector2(100,12),Vector2i(16,16),2.5)
	preview.draw_rect(Rect2(center+Vector2(-130,10),Vector2(56,16)),Color("b18b5b"))
	for i in 3: preview.draw_circle(center+Vector2(-121+i*14,14),4,Color("8dae72"))
	if working and stage==0:
		var lift: float=absf(sin(time*12))*14
		preview.draw_line(center+Vector2(-111,-lift),center+Vector2(-95,-lift),Color("dae3d9"),5)
	elif working and stage==1:
		preview.draw_line(center+Vector2(10,-32),center+Vector2(sin(time*7)*8,-12),Color("dfbd87"),3)
	if dish!="":
		for i in 3:
			var rise:=fmod(time*15+i*9,28)
			preview.draw_circle(center+Vector2(-8+i*8,-18-rise),2,Color(0.9,0.9,0.8,(1-rise/28)*0.5))

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not active or not Controls.allows_event(event) or event.is_echo() or Engine.get_process_frames()==opened_frame: return
	if event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel") or UiStyle.shortcut(event,"pause"):
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		close()
	elif UiStyle.activate_focused(panel,event): get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()

func close() -> void:
	active=false
	working=false
	root.hide()

func _draw_scene() -> void:
	var w := 1152.0
	var h := 648.0
	content.draw_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(0, 0), Vector2(w, 0), Vector2(w, h), Vector2(0, h)]),
		PackedColorArray([SKY_TOP, SKY_TOP, SKY_BOTTOM, SKY_BOTTOM]))
	for star in stars:
		var twinkle := 0.35 + 0.65 * absf(sin(t * star["speed"] + star["phase"]))
		content.draw_rect(Rect2(star["pos"], Vector2(3, 3)), Color(1, 1, 1, twinkle))

	# Grond: twee rijen gras met wat afwisseling.
	var tiles := Art.tex("pixel_landscape")
	var tile := 16.0 * GROUND_SCALE
	var ground_y := h - tile * 2.0
	for row in 2:
		for col in int(ceil(w / tile)):
			var variant := 5 if (col * 3 + row * 5) % 7 == 0 else 6 if (col * 2 + row) % 5 == 0 else 0
			content.draw_texture_rect_region(tiles, Rect2(col * tile, ground_y + row * tile, tile, tile),
				Rect2(variant * 32.0, ((col+row)%8)*32, 32, 32))

	# De personages, op de grond.
	var feet_y := ground_y + 30.0
	var size_px := 16.0 * SPRITE_SCALE
	var center_y := feet_y - size_px * (14.5 / 16.0 - 0.5)
	var step := 1 + int(t * 4.0) % 2
	DrawUtil.sprite(content, Art.tex("npc_bram"), int(t * 1.6) % 2, 0, Vector2(190, center_y), Vector2i(16, 16), SPRITE_SCALE)
	DrawUtil.sprite(content, Art.tex("player"), step, 2, Vector2(330, center_y), Vector2i(16, 16), SPRITE_SCALE)
	DrawUtil.sprite(content, Art.tex("slime"), int(t * 1.6) % 2, 0, Vector2(900, center_y), Vector2i(16, 16), SPRITE_SCALE)

	# De zwevende kristal.
	var crystal := Vector2(w / 2.0, 238.0 + sin(t * 2.0) * 8.0)
	content.draw_circle(crystal, 100.0 + sin(t * 3.0) * 5.0, Color(0.3, 0.7, 1.0, 0.10))
	content.draw_circle(crystal, 66.0 + sin(t * 3.0) * 3.0, Color(0.4, 0.8, 1.0, 0.16))
	DrawUtil.sprite(content, Art.tex("crystal"), int(t * 1.4) % 2, 0, crystal, Vector2i(16, 16), 8.0)

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:

	preview=Control.new();preview.custom_minimum_size=Vector2(0,94);preview.mouse_filter=Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE;preview.draw.connect(draw_preview);box.add_child(preview)
	rail=HBoxContainer.new();rail.add_theme_constant_override("separation",10);box.add_child(rail)
	left=button("◀",rail,adjust.bind(-1));left.custom_minimum_size.x=70;left.focus_mode=Control.FOCUS_NONE
	value_label=Style.make_label("",20);value_label.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL;value_label.horizontal_alignment=HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER;rail.add_child(value_label)
	right=button("▶",rail,adjust.bind(1));right.custom_minimum_size.x=70;right.focus_mode=Control.FOCUS_NONE
	for arrow in [left,right]:

func hint_layout(text: String) -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var result: Array[Dictionary]=[]
	var font:=ThemeDB.fallback_font
	var baseline:=334.0
	for line: String in hint_lines(text):
		result.append({"text":line,"at":Vector2(648,baseline),"bottom":baseline+font.get_descent(14)})
		baseline+=font.get_height(14)
	return result

func _ready() -> void:
	add_to_group("world")
	if not GameState.in_game:
		GameState.new_game()
	GameState.in_game = true
	GameState.ui_owners = {}
	GameState.transitioning = false
	get_tree().paused = false

	ground = Node2D.new()
	add_child(ground)
	entities = Node2D.new()
	entities.y_sort_enabled = true
	add_child(entities)
	fx_layer = Node2D.new()
	fx_layer.z_index = 50
	add_child(fx_layer)
	canvas_mod = CanvasModulate.new()
	add_child(canvas_mod)
	_build_tile_set()

	player = PlayerScript.new()
	player.world = self
	atmosphere = AtmosphereScript.new()
	atmosphere.world = self
	add_child(atmosphere)

	hud = HudScript.new()
	add_child(hud)
	craft_goal = preload("res://scripts/ui/craft_goal.gd").new()
	craft_goal.world = self
	add_child(craft_goal)
	dialogue = DialogueScript.new()
	add_child(dialogue)
	shop_ui = ShopScript.new()
	add_child(shop_ui)
	menu_ui = MenuScript.new()
	add_child(menu_ui)
	crafting_ui = CraftingScript.new()
	add_child(crafting_ui)
	pause_menu = PauseScript.new()
	add_child(pause_menu)
	fader = FaderScript.new()
	add_child(fader)

	GameState.world_action.connect(_on_world_action)
	GameState.ending_requested.connect(_on_ending)
	GameState.save_requested.connect(autosave)

	if GameState.use_load_pos:
		GameState.use_load_pos = false
		load_map(GameState.map_id, "start", GameState.load_pos)
	else:
		load_map(GameState.map_id, GameState.spawn_name)
	fader.set_alpha(1.0)
	fader.fade_in(0.5)

func travel(map_id: String, spawn: String, cue: String="door") -> void:
	if GameState.transitioning:
		return
	GameState.transitioning = true
	player.stop_for_transition()
	if cue!="":Sound.play(cue, -4.0)
	await fader.fade_out(0.25)
	load_map(map_id, spawn)
	player.invuln = maxf(player.invuln,1.25) # arriving gives time to read the new area
	autosave()
	await fader.fade_in(0.25)
	GameState.transitioning = false

func _spawn_objects() -> void:
	var objects: Array = map_data.get("objects", [])
	for i in objects.size():
		var obj: Dictionary = objects[i]
		if not obj.get("enabled",true): continue # retained slots preserve existing save IDs
		if obj.has("if") and not GameState.check_all(obj["if"]):
			continue
		var pos := _tile_center(obj["pos"])
		var key := "%s:%s:%d" % [obj["type"], GameState.map_id, i]
		match obj["type"]:
			"npc":
				var npc: Node2D = load("res://scripts/entities/coast_resident.gd").new() if obj["id"] in ["rg_ise","rg_raf"] else load("res://scripts/entities/supper_actor.gd").new() if obj["id"]=="meer_joris" and GameState.map_id=="lake" else NpcScript.new()
				npc.setup(obj["id"])
				npc.world = self
				npc.exists_if = obj.get("exists_if", [])
				npc.position = pos
				entities.add_child(npc)
			"enemy":
				var flag: String = obj.get("flag", "")
				if flag == "" or not GameState.flag(flag):
					var enemy:=spawn_enemy(obj["kind"], pos, flag)
					enemy.patrol_radius=float(obj.get("patrol_radius",0.0))
			"pickup":
				var unique: bool = obj.get("unique", false)
				if not (unique and GameState.flag(key)):
					spawn_pickup(obj["item"], pos, key if unique else "")
			"chest":
				var chest: StaticBody2D = ChestScript.new()
				chest.contents = obj["contents"]
				chest.unique_key = key
				chest.world = self
				chest.position = pos
				entities.add_child(chest)
			"sign":
				var sign_node: StaticBody2D = SignScript.new()
				sign_node.lines = obj["lines"]
				sign_node.speaker = obj.get("speaker", "")
				sign_node.world = self
				sign_node.position = pos
				entities.add_child(sign_node)
			"portal":
				var portal: Node2D = PortalScript.new()
				var size: Array = obj.get("size", [1, 1])
				portal.rect = Rect2(Vector2(float(obj["pos"][0]), float(obj["pos"][1])) * TILE, Vector2(float(size[0]), float(size[1])) * TILE)
				portal.position = portal.rect.position # de node zelf staat op de plek, voor y-sortering van de gloed
				portal.target_map = obj["to"]
				portal.target_spawn = obj.get("spawn", "start")
				portal.conditions = obj.get("requires", [])
				portal.locked_text = obj.get("locked_text", "")
				portal.world = self
				entities.add_child(portal)
			"gate":
				var gate: StaticBody2D = GateScript.new()
				var gsize: Array = obj.get("size", [1, 1])
				gate.gate_id = obj["id"]
				gate.size_tiles = Vector2i(gsize[0], gsize[1])
				gate.block_if = obj.get("block_if", [])
				gate.key_item = obj.get("key", "")
				gate.locked_text = obj.get("locked_text", "")
				gate.world = self
				gate.position = pos
				entities.add_child(gate)
			"savepoint":
				var altar: StaticBody2D = SavepointScript.new()
				altar.world = self
				altar.position = pos
				entities.add_child(altar)
			"torch":
				var torch: Node2D = TorchScript.new()
				torch.world = self
				torch.cold = obj.get("glow", "") == "blue"
				torch.position = pos
				entities.add_child(torch)
			"trigger":
				var trigger: Node2D = TriggerScript.new()
				var rsize: Array = obj.get("size", [1, 1])
				trigger.rect = Rect2(Vector2(float(obj["pos"][0]), float(obj["pos"][1])) * TILE, Vector2(float(rsize[0]), float(rsize[1])) * TILE)
				trigger.conditions = obj.get("conditions", [])
				trigger.once_flag = obj.get("once", "")
				trigger.actions = obj["do"]
				trigger.world = self
				entities.add_child(trigger)
			_:
				var script: Script = object_types.get(obj["type"])
				if script == null:
					push_warning("Onbekend soort object op de kaart: %s" % obj["type"])
					continue
				var node: Node2D = script.new()
				node.set("world", self)
				node.set("obj", obj)
				node.set("key", key)
				node.position = pos
				entities.add_child(node)

	GameState.set_flag("game_completed")
	GameState.finish_quest("main")
	GameState.check_achievements() # meteen, zodat de prestaties van het einde ook in de opslag staan
	# De opslag begint na het einde weer in het dorp.
	GameState.map_id = "village"
	var spawns: Dictionary = Maps.get_map("village")["spawns"]
	GameState.save_game(_tile_center(spawns["start"]))
	Sound.stop_music()
	await fader.fade_out(1.2)
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/ending.tscn")
